Impact
  
  
Ever wondered how Amazon offers the Earth's biggest selection and still manages to offer lower prices every day to our customers? Our retail business teams work with a massive array of vendors and business financial performance metrics to expand selection and drive costs lower. Given the rapid growth of our business, this requires our category leaders, financial analysts, site merchandisers and vendor managers to quickly analyze vendors, categories and brands, diving deep into data showing business efficiency down to the unit sale level. The technology that enables this has huge visibility and impact and is critical to Amazon's continued profitability and growth.
  
  
Innovation
  
  
We're working on the future. If you are seeking an environment where you can drive innovation. If you want to apply state-of-the-art software technologies to solve real world problems. If you want the satisfaction of providing visible benefit to end-users in an iterative fast paced environment, this is your opportunity. The responsibilities of this role will be key in paving the future of Amazon Retail and transforming how we do business.
  
  
Opportunity
  
  
You will be part of a team of creative, top-notch engineers who work hard, have fun, and make history.
  
  
As a Support Engineer, you will build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like in-house Applications and external aplications ), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for crunching and providing support for petabytes of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.
  
  
Be part of a high performance, high profile team with a complete, entirely localized business charter to enhance business profitability for the Amazon Consumer business.
  
  
Platform runs entirely on AWS; high scale, engineering challenges.
  
  
Very successful team that has developed a reputation of delivering results within Amazon.
  
  
We regularly research new technologies and invest for the future of our scalability
  
  
This role is on the Chronicle team within Selling Partner Services. We own the Turismo product suite, which is powered by Ripple, a dynamic query engine. Turismo is a well loved product, with 15k+ users globally. Ripple is a PrestoDB based query engine that is built to scale, and processes 2M+ queries per week. We are a full stack team, with Product managers, UX designers, TPMs, SDEs, DEs and Data Scientists.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Provide support of incoming tickets, including extensive troubleshooting tasks, with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services
* Work on operations and maintenance driven coding projects
* Software deployment support in staging and production environments
* Develop tools to aid operations and maintenance
* System and Support status reporting
* Ownership of one or more ETL products or components
* Customer notification and workflow coordination and follow-up to maintain service level agreements
* Work with support team for handing-off or taking over active support issues and creating a team specific knowledge base and skill sets

**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of software development, or 2+ years of technical support experience
* Experience scripting in modern program languages
* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of web services, distributed systems, and web application development
* Experience troubleshooting & maintaining hardware & software RAID
* Experience with REST web services, XML, JSON

description:
**Director - Cell Therapy IT, Software Engineering - Salesforce**
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to build the digital backbone that delivers next‑generation cell therapies to patients at scale?In this role, you will build and deliver the software platforms that power end‑to‑end activities related to cell therapy across development, manufacturing, and supply. Your work will directly influence how quickly and safely therapies move from treatment sites to manufacturing lines and back to patients.
  
  
You will lead a global engineering organization to compose, build, and industrialize enterprise-grade systems—spanning a Cell Orchestration platform built on Salesforce, AWS- services, and agentic AI automation. Partnering closely with operational and technology leaders, you will define a modern, scalable stack and translate strategy into robust, compliant solutions that drive speed, quality, and reliability. Based in Chennai, India, you will be at the center of a high-impact mission with global reach. How will you scale intelligent automation to orchestrate one of the most complex supply chains in healthcare?
  
  

* Accountabilities:
* Technology Planning and Architecture: Define and evolve a scalable technology strategy and reference architecture that underpins cell therapy operations from vein-to-vein, aligning platform choices with business outcomes.
* Platform Leadership: Lead the build and delivery of the Salesforce-based cellular coordination system, ensuring it is robust, scalable, secure, and fit for regulated environments.
* SDLC Ownership and DevSecOps: Own end-to-end software delivery from design to deployment and support, embedding DevSecOps, automation, and built-in quality to accelerate releases and reduce risk.
* Integration and Interoperability: Orchestrate integrations across Salesforce Service & Life Sciences -Cloud, MuleSoft, mobile-first apps, AWS services, and event streaming (e.g., Kafka) to enable seamless data and workflow continuity.
* Regulatory and Compliance Readiness: Bake compliance into every phase (GxP, HIPAA, FDA, GDPR), establishing traceability, validation, and auditability without slowing down delivery.
* Agentic AI Development or similar Automation experience is essential. Support advancing agentic AI to build autonomous software agents. They complete complex operational tasks and make decisions safely and at scale.
* Technical Roadmap: Life Sciences Cloud: Guide the industrialization of Agent-force Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud and the Advanced Therapy Module to enable next-generation cell therapy delivery.
* Engineering Excellence and GenAI-Enabled SDLC: Establish best- practices for full-stack engineering and leverage GenAI for code generation, testing, and SDLC automation to boost productivity and quality.
* Talent Leadership and Culture: Build and mentor a high-performing global-team of engineers and solution architects, cultivating innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Vendor and Partner Management: Manage external partners to deliver quality, secure, and compliant solutions, optimizing for value and speed.
* Innovation and Future-Readiness: Stay ahead of LLMs, autonomous agents, and cloud-native advances; translate emerging tech into practical upgrades that modernize systems and unlock new capabilities.
* Essential Skills/Experience:
* Bachelor's - degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 12+ years of software development experience, including 5+ years in a leadership role within life sciences, biotech, or manufacturing IT environments.
* Experience managing sophisticated Salesforce environments and multi-cloud implementations.
* Experience in leading multiple Product Development teams globally with engineering and delivery ownership
* Experience building and deploying software solutions in regulated environments (GxP , HIPAA, FDA).
* Expertise in modern development tools and platforms: AWS, Azure, Python, Salesforce (Service Cloud and Life Sciences), MuleSoft, Confluent / Kafka.
* Expertise delivering digital solutions across patient engagement, R&D, and product commercialization.
* Desirable Skills/Experience:
* Salesforce certifications (e.g., Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, Platform Developer II).
* Familiarity with AI/ML features within Salesforce ecosystem (Einstein, predictive analytics).
* Understanding of GenAI use cases in software development and automated testing.
* Hands-on experience with Agentic AI tools and frameworks
* Solid background in system architecture, secure coding practices, and cloud-native design.
* Why AstraZeneca:

Join a purpose-led team where advanced technology meets scientific ambition to change what’s possible for patients. Here, unexpected teams—engineers, data scientists, and operational leaders—get in the same room to tackle problems that matter, with the investment and freedom to experiment through hackathons, prototypes, and scaled delivery. You will help build the digital capabilities that accelerate medicines to those who need them, supported by a collaborative culture that values kindness alongside ambition, rigorous standards alongside creativity, and continuous learning at every step.
  
  
When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

title: Software Dev Engineer II, Profit Intelligence
description:
**Description**
Are you interested in building intelligence systems from the ground up?
  
  
Are you interested in working with Applied Scientists, Big Data Engineers and Software Development Engineers to build large-scale data intelligence systems?
  
  
Are you interested to work in a team that positively impacts different key pillars of Amazon like Pricing, Promotions, Advertising, Auto inventory purchasing, Auto inventory removal, Inventory placement?
  
  
Are you interested in working for a team that builds cool systems yet has great work-life balance?
  
  
Profit intelligence systems measures, predicts true profit(/loss) for each item as a result of a specific shipment to an Amazon customer.
  
  
Prot Intelligence is all about providing intelligent ways for Amazon to understand profitability across retail business. What are the hidden factors driving the growth or profitability across millions of shipments each day?
  
  
Profit Intelligence provides these answers.
  
  
We compute the profitability of each and every shipment that gets shipped out of Amazon. Guess what, we predict the profitability of future possible shipments too. We are a team of agile, can-do engineers, who believe that not only are moon shots possible but that they can be done before lunch. All it takes is finding new ideas that challenge our preconceived notions of how things should be done. Process and procedure matter less than ideas and the practical work of getting stuff done. This is a place for exploring the new and taking risks.
  
  
We push the envelope in using cloud services in AWS as well as the latest in distributed systems, forecasting algorithms, and data mining.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to design and build AI-powered data platforms that transform large-scale business data into actionable insights. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and data engineering — owning end-to-end development of tools that help business leaders make faster, better decisions.
  
  
This is a high-impact role on a team where the software you ship directly shapes financial and operational strategy across Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Architect and build scalable platforms that ingest, process, and serve insights from petabyte-scale datasets
  
  
Integrate large language models and generative AI capabilities into internal analytics tools — enabling natural language querying, anomaly explanation, and automated reporting
  
  
Design ML pipelines for anomaly detection, forecasting, and trend analysis over structured and semi-structured business data
  
  
Partner with scientists, analysts, and PMs to translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped technical solutions
  
  
Drive engineering excellence: define coding standards, lead design reviews, and set the bar for operational health (monitoring, oncall, runbooks)
  
  
Mentor junior engineers; raise the technical capability of the team through clear documentation and code review
  
  
Own your services in production — you build it, you run it
  
  
Build and operate our foundational data infrastructure comprising of the entire spectrum of AWS Services - Storage (Redshift Data Shares, s3 data lakes), Orchestration (Step Functions, Glue and Internal Java Based Orchestration Tools), Processing (Spark & Flink - KDA), Streaming services (AWS Kinesis) and real-time large scale event aggregation stores.
  
  
Making it fully configurable and self-service for non-engineers.
  
  
Build and evolve tools that empower Amazonians to access data and build reliable, scalable and configurable way to generate Unit Economics for all Amazon Businesses. This includes UIs and frameworks for configuring rules, simulating their application, approval workows for rule changes, APIs and caching layers for high-throughput serving of Unit Economics Historicals and Predictions.
  
  
Build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like inhouse Reporting Applications and BI tools), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for designing and building platforms for crunching 100s of TB of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Staff Databricks Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering
description:
**About Kinaxis**
Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
  
  
In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
  
  
Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
  
  
Location
  
  
Chennai, India
  
  
**About The Team**
The Site Reliability Engineering team is responsible for the delivery, management, and monitoring of Kinaxis products and cloud infrastructure in our production offerings. We are responsible for ensuring service availability and performance to our customers globally, 7x24x365.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Staff Cloud Engineer, as a seasoned professional with extensive experience, is responsible for the design, implementation, operations, monitoring, automation, testing, and delivery of complex cloud infrastructure projects.
  
  
The incumbent will provide technical guidance and expertise as they support the cloud infrastructure solutions delivered in production environments and will act as a lead on interactions with Global Customer Care teams in management of critical escalations.
  
  
This role will be 50% SRE & 50% Data Analytics
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Transition legacy systems to a cloud-native, modern data stack leveraging tools such as Informatica, Airflow, Postgres and modern technologies like Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery, Looker, CI/CD, Git, Databricks, PowerBI, Datadog and Grafana.
* Deploy, upgrade and support numerous applications, services and operating systems.
* Apply software engineering principles to operational challenges with a focus on automation, self-healing and monitoring solutions.
* Deliver customer excellence, making sure we meet all SLAs.
* Translate architectural, technical and feature changes into operational plans.
* Advise and maintain a feedback loop with development and operations teams to ensure deliveries are in accordance with needs and expectations.
* Deliver cloud reference architectures to be used by teams across the enterprise as they work to modernize existing technologies and build new capabilities to deliver to Customers.
* Develop and manage cloud automation using cloud orchestration capabilities, scripting languages and APIs to design, code, test, implement and support production services.
* Participate in an on-call rotation to investigate incidents and provide root causes relating to production infrastructure, services and applications.
* Troubleshoot issues within the cloud platform, documenting resolutions and providing coaching and feedback to more junior employees on those resolutions
* Responsible for designing, implementing, and managing reporting solutions that support the cloud infrastructure; Optimize cloud resources to ensure cost effectiveness, and identify opportunities for cost savings in customer-facing infrastructure.
* Stay current with emerging cloud technologies and trends, evaluating and recommending new tools and services to enhance our cloud infrastructure.
* Support scalable and secure cloud environments using best practices and industry standards.

What we are looking for
  
  

* Bachelor’s/Master's degree in Engineering with specialization in Computer Science or related discipline or demonstrated equivalent experience.
* Prior experience in a site reliability engineering role.
* Deep, hands-on experience with tools such as Snowflake, Databricks, Informatica, dbt, BigQuery, Looker and/or Power BI.
* 10+ years of experience with deployment and monitoring of distributed systems , infrastructure and deployment of Cloud Services, public cloud platforms (both console and API) like GCP, Azure or AWS.
* Working with VMware ESXi is considered an asset.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and supportive Observability tooling (Logstash, Datadog, Grafana).
* Strong knowledge of system design to manage operational and reliability trade-offs.
* Extensive experience developing in a scription language (Ansible, PowerShell, Bash and Python).
* Proven practical experience in building and managing:
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
* Configuration management tools (Ansible)
* CI/CD solutions (Git, GitOps, Argo CD)
* Containers and orchestrators (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm)
* System monitoring and centralized logging platforms (Datadog, Prometheus, ELK)
* In-depth and proactive communication and documentation skills.

#Senior #Fulltime

title: Senior DevOps & Platform Engineering Lead
description:
An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives. Come join the excellence!
  
  
**Overview**
TNS Automation Development is seeking a senior, hands-on engineering leader to own and evolve the platforms, infrastructure, and software delivery capabilities behind our network automation strategy. Our automation ecosystem supports more than 70,000 network devices. This role combines deep technical ownership with leadership across platform reliability, cloud architecture, DevSecOps, release management, and operational excellence. You will partner with Automation Developers, Network Engineers, Security, Global Systems, cloud teams, and business stakeholders to build a scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable automation ecosystem.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**What You Will Own**
**Platform Engineering & Operations**

* Own the architecture, deployment, operation, and lifecycle of network automation applications and supporting services.
* Design and operate containerized applications on Kubernetes using Helm, Argo, and Terraform.
* Own the Nautobot platform stack, including Python/Django, Celery, uWSGI/NGINX, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kubernetes, AWS, and GitLab CI/CD.
* Lead platform upgrades, plugin lifecycle management, performance tuning, capacity planning, resiliency, and observability improvements.

**DevOps & Software Delivery**

* Build and manage application images, containers, and deployment workflows.
* Own GitLab standards, branching strategy, runners, CI/CD pipelines, release promotion, and software delivery practices.
* Establish reliable release processes across development, test, and production environments.

**Cloud, Security & Risk**

* Partner with Global Systems and cloud teams to evolve AWS infrastructure, hosting models, scalability, disaster recovery, and operational support.
* Own and manage AWS infrastructure supporting network automation platforms, including IAM roles and policies, EKS, EC2, VPC networking, security groups, S3, load balancing, and platform monitoring.
* Embed DevSecOps practices, including SAST, dependency scanning, container scanning, and infrastructure security validation.
* Ensure platform and deployment practices align with corporate security policies and audit requirements.

**Technical Leadership**

* Serve as the senior technical authority for platform engineering and DevOps within the Automation team.
* Set engineering standards and guardrails, mentor developers, and influence the future of network automation at TNS.

**Qualifications**
**Required Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive IT engineering experience, including 5+ years of hands-on DevOps or platform engineering.
* Proven experience deploying and operating production applications on Kubernetes.
* Strong hands-on experience with AWS, Terraform, Helm, Docker, Git, GitLab administration, runners, and CI/CD pipeline design.
* Strong hands-on AWS experience including IAM, EKS, EC2, VPCs, S3, security controls, monitoring, and cloud networking.
* Hands-on Experience operating distributed application platforms using Kubernetes, Celery, Redis, and containers.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices and security scanning across the software lifecycle.
* Experience supporting highly available production applications with demanding operational requirements.
* Ability to lead architecture decisions, solve complex platform problems, and guide engineers through implementation.

**Preferred Experience**

* Nautobot, NetBox, or comparable network source-of-truth platforms.
* Network automation and orchestration, including Ansible.
* Python and Django applications; PostgreSQL or MongoDB.
* GitLab Runner architecture and management; Argo-based deployment workflows.
* Enterprise platforms operating in regulated environments.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within the first 12 months, you will:
* Lead the transition of the Nautobot AWS/Kubernetes platform from vendor-managed operations to a TNS-owned and operated service, including architecture, deployment, upgrades, security, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
* Standardize GitLab workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and release management.
* Provide clear technical leadership for platform engineering and automation infrastructure.
* Lead the AWS architecture and migration approach for applications, services, and infrastructure moving from on-premises and legacy environments.

For this role in the
**United States**
, we anticipate paying $125,000k - $155,000K. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. TNS offers a competitive benefit package.
  
  
If you are passionate about technology, love personal growth and opportunity, come see what TNS is all about!
  
  
TNS is an equal opportunity employer. TNS evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

title: Lead Data Platform Engineer
description:
**About This Role**
We're seeking an exceptional Data Platform Engineer to shape the strategic direction and architecture of our data infrastructure. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where you'll co-own the overall platform architecture, set technical standards across the entire Data Engineering organization, and drive initiatives that directly impact our data strategy. You'll be a force multiplier—inspiring teams, mentoring senior engineers, and making architectural decisions that affect how the entire organization builds and operates data systems. We are in the midst of transforming our legacy infrastructure into a modern cloud-first platform, and you'll be instrumental in leading this technical evolution.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Strategic Platform Leadership
  
  

* Co-own and evolve the overall data platform architecture across all domains
* Guide the technical vision for the entire Data Engineering organization
* Drive platform initiatives that directly support the company's data strategy
* Lead the modernization of legacy systems while ensuring business continuity
* Identify and solve problems that span the entire Data Engineering org before they impact delivery
* Set the bar for excellence and serve as an inspiration across all engineering teams

Architecture & Technical Excellence
  
  

* Design and drive implementation of highly scalable platform architectures for multi-TB+ daily workloads
* Author and sign off on all RFCs and technical specifications that touch your domain(s)
* Define best practices and patterns that become standard across the organization
* Build self-service infrastructure that empowers hundreds of data consumers while maintaining reliability
* Design event-driven, real-time data architectures using Kafka and stream processing at scale
* Contribute to any codebase across the organization, setting quality standards through exemplary code

Platform Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Architect comprehensive Infrastructure as Code strategies and GitOps frameworks
* Design enterprise-grade security frameworks including encryption, zero-trust access controls, and compliance
* Establish SLAs/SLOs for critical platform services and drive observability strategy
* Lead complex incident response, conduct thorough post-mortems, and implement systemic improvements
* Drive platform reliability and performance optimization initiatives

Influence & Enablement
  
  

* Mentor IC9 and IC10 engineers, accelerating their technical growth and impact
* Collaborate across the entire Engineering organization as a thought partner
* Interact with executives and external stakeholders as a domain expert
* Democratize data access by empowering more teams to contribute to the data stack safely
* Identify hiring gaps and help define interview panels for critical technical roles
* Actively participate in and contribute to Data Engineering communities (conferences, Stack Overflow, vendor forums)

What You Bring
  
  
Deep Technical Expertise
  
  

* Expert-level proficiency in SQL, Python, and at least one additional programming language
* Demonstrated mastery of object-oriented design and software engineering principles
* Deep expertise with databases across paradigms: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, Oracle, DynamoDB, MongoDB
* Extensive Kafka ecosystem expertise: cluster management, Debezium, schema registry, Connect frameworks, stream processing
* Advanced container orchestration with Kubernetes and Docker at scale
* Expert knowledge of Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and cloud-native architectures

Platform Engineering Mastery
  
  

* Proven track record architecting platforms processing multi-TB daily workloads
* Experience designing and operating systems supporting hundreds of concurrent users
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, cloud architectures, and scalability patterns
* Expert-level experience with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Jaeger)
* Mastery of data orchestration platforms like Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster
* Demonstrated success modernizing legacy data systems while ensuring zero business disruption

Experience & Background
  
  

* 10-15+ years of professional experience in data platform engineering or related field
* Track record of leading complex, org-wide technical initiatives
* History of driving architectural decisions that scale across large organizations
* Experience in high-growth or large enterprise environments
* Deep expertise with both modern and legacy technologies (Oracle, SQL Server, Informatica, SSIS, Business Objects)

Leadership & Influence
  
  

* Proven ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and domains
* Excellence in mentoring senior engineers and accelerating their growth
* Strong executive presence and ability to communicate complex technical concepts to all levels
* Comfortable operating in high ambiguity and defining problems before solving them
* Track record of building collaborative relationships across engineering and business organizations
* Recognition as a thought leader in the Data Engineering community

Bonus Points
  
  

* Deep experience with modern data stack tools (dbt, Looker, etc.)
* Machine learning infrastructure and MLOps architecture expertise
* Contributions to open-source data infrastructure projects
* Published technical articles, conference talks, or thought leadership in data platforms
* Expert knowledge of data privacy frameworks (GDPR, CCPA) and implementation at scale

What Success Looks Like
  
  
**First 90 Days:**
Understand our architecture deeply, identify systemic opportunities and risks, and begin influencing key technical decisions. Establish yourself as a go-to expert in your domain(s).
  
  
**First Year:**
Drive at least one major architectural initiative that impacts the entire Data Engineering organization. Establish yourself as a trusted advisor to leadership and a mentor to senior engineers. Author multiple RFCs that set new standards.
  
  
**Ongoing:**
Continuously shape the technical direction of the organization, mentor the next generation of technical leaders, and maintain your position as one of the most knowledgeable experts in your domain(s) both internally and in the broader Data Engineering community.

AWS (EC2, EKS, RDS, extensive cloud-native services)

Apache Kafka, Apache Airflow, SQLMESH, Snowflake, dbt

Python, SQL, Java, Scala, Docker, Kubernetes
  
  
**Monitoring & Observability:**
Prometheus, Grafana, DataDog, ELK Stack, Jaeger

Apache Spark, Oracle, Postgres, SqlServer, Informatica, SSIS, Business Objects

title: Sr. Solutions Architect - Workday
description:
**Company Overview**
At Zuora, we do Modern Business. We’re helping people subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies and ultimately the planet. It’s an approach resulting from the shift to the Subscription Economy that puts customers first by building recurring relationships instead of one-time product sales and focuses on sustainable growth. Through our leading expertise and multi-product suite, we are transforming all industries and working with the world’s most innovative companies to monetize new business models, nurture subscriber relationships and optimize their digital experiences.
  
  
**THE TEAM & ROLE**
Zuora’s Corporate Operations organization serves as the backbone of our internal technology ecosystem, building digital experiences that connect teams, align business priorities, and strengthen collaboration company-wide. Taking a cloud-first, AI-enabled approach, we empower our global ZEOs with modern tools and self-service solutions that drive productivity, scalability, and agility - all while upholding the highest standards of security and compliance.
  
  
Within Corporate Operations, the G&A Business Applications team designs, implements, and optimizes the systems that power all of Zuora's core General & Administrative functions, including Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success (HR), and Legal. Reporting to the Senior Business Systems Manager of Digital Workplace Experience, this team works closely with system analysts, administrators, project managers, data architects, and developers to deliver robust, scalable business solutions.
  
  
The Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems is a senior technical expert and data architect responsible for designing, building, and securing enterprise-grade data structures and integrations across our corporate systems ecosystem. This role functions as a critical cross-functional data and system integration specialist, ensuring seamless data flow, robust security governance, and scalable automation across diverse business platforms (e.g., Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more).
  
  
You’ll join a collaborative, high-performing team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, quality, and scalability of Zuora’s enterprise systems and digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION**
As a senior technical anchor supporting all G&A functions, the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems collaborates closely with leaders across Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal to establish a cohesive enterprise data architecture. You will build robust system integrations and leverage cutting-edge AI frameworks to drive efficiency, maximize data reliability, and enforce strict compliance across all internal platforms in alignment with strategic goals.
  
  
**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**
As the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems, you will play a vital role in the development, data architecture, and integration of Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal systems. Combining your expertise as a data architect and multi-platform integration specialist, you’ll ensure seamless data flow, scalable automation, and cross-system reliability without being tied to a single core vendor. You’ll work closely with functional BSAs to prioritize initiatives, refine user stories, and deliver enhancements through agile sprints, while supporting testing and deployment activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Lead integration support and comprehensive data architecture across core Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal business systems, ensuring cross-platform data consistency and process efficiency.
* Define and maintain end-to-end data models, data lineage, and integration patterns across all G&A applications, establishing a unified "single source of truth" bridging corporate finance, workforce analytics, and legal operations.
* Design, build, and optimize secure, high-performing API-based integrations, microservices, and file-based data flows (REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL) across Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more tools.
* Architect and implement AI-driven automation workflows; evaluate and integrate AI productivity tools and emerging standard frameworks—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers—to safely expose internal tools and secure data layers to AI agents.
* Enforce strict data security policies, field-level encryption, masking, and access controls across integrated systems to protect sensitive workforce metrics (ZEO Success/PII), legal records, and financial data.
* Collaborate with cross-functional BSAs, business cross functional teams, and security teams using RACI frameworks to clearly map out data ownership, system accountability, and technical execution roles across different departments.
* Ensure configuration standards, technical architecture diagrams, and SOPs are up to date and fully compliant with internal controls, SOX, and global privacy standards (GDPR/CCPA).

**OUR TECH STACK:**
REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL, JavaScript/Python, Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, AI Automation Tools, and MCP Server frameworks.
  
  
**What You’ll Accomplish**

* Deliver Modern Data Architecture: Transition fragmented cross-system data points from disparate G&A tools into a beautifully mapped out, resilient, and highly secure enterprise data model.
* Excellence in System Integrations: Establish scalable, automated data connections that allow Finance, FP&A, Procurement, HR, and Legal tools to communicate without operational friction, keeping sync latencies low and reliability high.
* Next-Gen Tech Adoption: Successfully implement secure AI extensions or MCP servers to optimize everyday business workflows and scale manual reporting processes down to self-service models.
* Advance Automation & Data Reliability: Develop solutions that strengthen data accuracy, eliminate manual tasks, reduce operational overhead, and increase system reliability across end-to-end business workflows.
* Promote Secure & Compliant Operations: Collaborate with IT, Security, and Audit teams to uphold field-level data protection, access controls, and strict compliance (SOX/GDPR) across all integration data layers.
* Establish Sustainable System Practices: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and configuration standards to ensure long-term scalability and consistent cross-functional operational excellence.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

title: SecOps Lead
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
We are seeking a Systems Engineer to own patch management, configuration automation, and vulnerability remediation across our Linux and Windows server and endpoint fleets. This role combines Puppet/Ansible-based automation for Linux OS patching and configuration enforcement with SCCM/Intune-based endpoint management and PowerShell-driven remediation on Windows, ensuring systems across both platforms stay compliant, secure, and up to date with minimal manual intervention.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Key Responsibilities — Linux (Puppet/Ansible)**

* Manage end-to-end patch lifecycle (assessment, testing, staged rollout, validation) across RHEL servers.
* Develop, maintain, and version-control Puppet/Ansible modules and manifests for OS patching, software installation, and configuration enforcement.
* Design staged/canary patch rollout groups to minimize production risk.
* Automate software installation and configuration across environments to reduce manual provisioning.
* Troubleshoot patch failures, configuration drift, and Puppet/Ansible run errors across the fleet.
* Lead remediation of End-of-Life (EOL) / End-of-Support (EOS) operating systems and software — upgrading, re platforming, or migrating affected servers ahead of support cutoff dates.
* Execute EOL remediation plans in coordination with infrastructure and application owners, escalating and documenting formal risk acceptance only where remediation isn't feasible within the required timeline.

**Key Responsibilities — Windows (SCCM / Intune / PowerShell)**

* Manage and maintain endpoint security configurations using SCCM and Intune.
* Develop and implement PowerShell scripts to automate vulnerability remediation, security tasks, and processes.
* Create and manage imaging and task sequences in SCCM and Intune.
* Package and deploy patches on Windows servers and workstations based on a monthly schedule.
* Deploy collections in SCCM and push relevant missing patches to remediate vulnerabilities.
* Write PowerShell scripts to fix vulnerabilities based on testing on a few devices and implement them through Qualys or SCCM.

**Shared Responsibilities — Vulnerability Management & Compliance**

* Prioritize and remediate critical/high findings within SLA.
* Define and manage maintenance windows, rollback procedures, and exception/risk-acceptance workflows for unpatchable systems.
* Collaborate with security and application teams to align patch cadence with compliance requirements (CIS Benchmarks, STIG, PCI, etc.).
* Document processes, runbooks, and standard operating procedures for patch, configuration, and remediation management.

**Required Qualifications — Linux**

* Minimum 3+ years of Linux systems administration experience (RHEL).
* Hands-on experience with Puppet/Ansible (manifests, modules, Hiera, PuppetDB, r10k or similar control-repo workflow).
* Experience with package management (yum/dnf, apt).
* Hands-on experience remediating EOL/EOS operating systems and software — performing OS upgrades, migrations, or replat forming to bring systems back into supported status.

**Required Qualifications — Windows**

* Proven experience in vulnerability management and security operations.
* Strong knowledge of Qualys, SCCM, and Intune.
* Experience with imaging and task sequencing in SCCM and Intune.

**Required Qualifications — Shared**

* Scripting proficiency in Bash and/or Python, and proficiency in PowerShell scripting.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong communication and teamwork abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with patch orchestration tools (Red Hat Satellite, Spacewalk, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with vulnerability management/scanning tools (Qualys or similar).
* Understanding of CIS Benchmarks, STIG, or other security hardening standards.
* Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar).
* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or higher; Puppet/Ansible Certified Professional.
* Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare) with formal exception/risk-acceptance processes.
* Experience running EOL remediation projects at scale (e.g., fleet-wide OS version upgrades, distro migrations) in coordination with cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with Ansible or other configuration management tools as a secondary skill.
* Experience building compliance dashboards (Grafana, Splunk, or similar).

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field — or equivalent practical experience.

Onsite

title: Sr. Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
**What Do You Need To Know About The Role**
This is an incident command role. You'll direct application and infrastructure teams during incidents making work assignments, prioritizing troubleshooting paths, and authorizing critical actions like rollbacks and regional failovers. You need the technical depth to rapidly read Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes manifests, and CI/CD configurations to make informed decisions under pressure.
  
  
Meet Our Team
  
  
The Site Health Engineering (Command Center) team serves as the operational and technical authority during PayPal's most critical incidents. We are a team of experienced infrastructure and reliability professionals who blend deep technical expertise with sound judgment under pressure, directing cross-functional engineering efforts across PayPal's core platforms and family of brands, including Venmo, Xoom, Zettle, and Braintree.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:**

Rather than building or maintaining infrastructure day-to-day, our team is entrusted with a broader mandate: safeguarding the reliability, resiliency, and availability of some of the world's most heavily trafficked financial platforms. We hold final decision-making authority during high-severity incidents, partner closely with executive leadership on post-incident learnings, and drive the tooling and processes that continuously strengthen our incident response capabilities.
  
  
You'll also regularly interface with executive leadership during critical incidents and post-mortems, and drive implementation of tooling that advances the Command Center's capabilities.

title: R&D Platform Engineer – GPQSS Digital- IDC
description:
Platform Engineer
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Platform Engineer to design, build, automate, and operate secure, scalable, and reliable engineering platforms that enable development teams to deliver cloud-native applications faster and with higher quality. The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in Azure, AKS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Helm, Azure DevOps, GitOps, observability, and platform automation.
  
  
This role requires strong ownership of developer experience, infrastructure automation, cloud operations, security-by-design, and platform reliability. The candidate will collaborate with architects, developers, DevOps engineers, cybersecurity teams, product teams, and business stakeholders to establish reusable platform capabilities, standards, and self-service solutions across the software delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* Design, build, and maintain internal developer platforms that provide reusable services, templates, pipelines, and automation for application teams.
* Create and manage cloud-native platform components on Azure, AKS, Kubernetes, Docker, and container registries.
* Standardize CI/CD pipeline templates using Azure DevOps for build, test, security scanning, deployment, and release automation.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Helm, Ansible, or similar tools to provision and manage consistent environments.
* Enable GitOps and configuration-driven deployment practices for repeatable, auditable, and scalable platform operations.
* Build self-service capabilities for developers, including environment provisioning, deployment templates, monitoring dashboards, and operational runbooks.
* Improve platform reliability through observability, logging, metrics, alerting, SLOs, incident analysis, and continuous operational improvements.
* Integrate platform security controls including secrets management, container security, dependency scanning, image scanning, and policy enforcement.
* Support DevSecOps practices by integrating tools such as SonarCloud, Black Duck, MetaDefender, or equivalent security and quality gates into delivery pipelines.
* Implement authentication, authorization, API gateway, ingress, service mesh, and secure connectivity patterns for platform services.
* Partner with application teams to troubleshoot deployment, performance, networking, availability, and operational issues.
* Define platform standards, reusable architecture patterns, documentation, and best practices to improve developer productivity and governance.
* Evaluate and introduce automation, AI-assisted development, and platform engineering improvements that reduce manual effort and accelerate delivery.

**Your background**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 7+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or cloud-native application delivery.
* Strong hands-on experience with Azure, AKS, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, container registries, and cloud-native deployment patterns.
* Strong experience in Azure DevOps pipeline design, YAML pipelines, release automation, branching strategies, and reusable pipeline templates.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Ansible, Helm, ARM/Bicep, or equivalent tools.
* Good understanding of platform engineering concepts such as developer portals, golden paths, self-service automation, reusable templates, and paved-road standards.
* Experience with GitOps tools and practices such as Argo CD, Flux, or equivalent configuration-driven deployment approaches.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, or similar platforms.
* Good understanding of networking, ingress controllers, DNS, certificates, load balancing, API gateways, and secure service-to-service communication.
* Experience with secrets management, identity, access control, OAuth, JWT, OpenID Connect, Keycloak, Azure Key Vault, or equivalent solutions.
* Knowledge of DevSecOps, secure SDLC, threat modeling, vulnerability management, dependency scanning, image scanning, and compliance readiness.
* Experience supporting event-driven or distributed systems using Kafka, RabbitMQ, background jobs, or similar integration patterns is an advantage.
* Good understanding of application architecture, microservices, REST APIs, .NET Core, Angular, or full stack development concepts is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, automation, and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex platform and production issues.
* Strong communication, collaboration, ownership, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently, guide engineering teams, and drive adoption of platform standards and best practices.
* Proficiency in English, both speaking and writing.
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot is an advantage.

title: Technical Anchor, Software Engineering
description:
As a Technical Anchor, you will oversee the technical design, development, and delivery of business-critical applications and high-throughput data platforms. You will establish engineering excellence across full-stack systems, architect resilient Java-based microservices, deliver responsive front-end data exploration interfaces using React or Angular, and design enterprise-grade cloud data streaming and analytical pipelines on GCP. You will lead distributed engineering squads across local and global locations, driving cloud modernization, data governance, and operational reliability to fuel Ford’s digital transformation.
  
  

* Technical Leadership, Architecture & Modernization
* Anchor Technical Delivery: Act as the primary technical anchor, translating complex business requirements from legacy applications in GDIA into scalable, fault-tolerant system designs, architectural blueprints, and execution roadmaps.
* Architecture Standards: Drive the evolution of Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), cloud-native microservices, and event-driven patterns. Establish coding standards, API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger), and architectural governance across squads.
* Legacy System Modernization: Lead legacy modernization initiatives by re-architecting monolithic services into modular, containerized workloads on GCP, engineering continuous ingestion flows from heterogeneous enterprise platforms.
* Engineering Mentorship & SDLC Excellence: Champion agile engineering best practices, enforce test-driven development (TDD), lead comprehensive code reviews, and mentor engineers across full-stack, data engineering, and cloud domains.
* Full-Stack & Microservices Engineering
* Backend Services: Architect and develop robust, high-performance microservices and RESTful APIs using Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and supporting synchronous transactions and asynchronous event-driven flows.
* Frontend & Data Visualization: Build responsive, user-centric interfaces using Angular, React, and Node.js that integrate seamlessly with backend APIs to deliver intuitive self-service data access, reporting, and interactive data visualization.
* API Gateway & Service Mesh: Design and standardize API gateway topologies using Apigee; enforce service discovery, circuit breakers, rate limiting, and resilient inter-service communication.
* Performance Engineering & Optimization: Profile and optimize distributed systems end-to-end, including JVM tuning, connection pooling, caching strategies, and database query tuning across relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL datastores.
* Cloud Data Engineering & Analytics
* Scalable Data Pipelines: Architect, build, and maintain real-time streaming and high-volume batch data pipelines leveraging GCP Dataflow (Apache Beam), Dataproc (Spark/Hadoop), and Cloud Pub/Sub.
* Modern Data Warehousing: Standardize, model, partition, and optimize enterprise datasets within Google BigQuery to ensure exceptional SQL query performance, cost efficiency, and real-time analytical capabilities.
* Security, Governance & Compliance
* Zero Trust Security: Enforce least-privileged access control across applications, integrating Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), ADFS, OAuth2/OIDC, and method-level access authorization.
* Cloud & Data Governance: Implement robust cloud security frameworks, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), data encryption (in transit and at rest), data masking, and GCP-native row-level and column-level security.
* Regulatory Compliance: Partner with cybersecurity, compliance, and governance teams to maintain adherence to enterprise data privacy mandates and corporate security standards.
* DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Observability
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Automate and manage repeatable cloud infrastructure and platform provisioning using Terraform.
* CI/CD Automation: Design and optimize enterprise CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Tekton, and build automation tools (Maven, Gradle) for automated testing, static code analysis, and zero-downtime deployments.
* Operational Reliability & Telemetry: Establish proactive monitoring, tracing, and alerting frameworks across Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Run, and Cloud Functions to diagnose distributed system bottlenecks and ensure platform health.
* AI/ML Innovation: Apply foundational AI and Machine Learning (ML) concepts, including Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), to accelerate engineering workflows and enhance software capabilities.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* Professional Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions across full-stack development, distributed computing, and data platforms. Core Technical Competencies:
* Backend Engineering: Deep expertise in Java (Java 17+), Spring Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security), and scripting proficiency.
* Frontend Engineering: Hands-on experience developing data visualization and exploration interfaces using React, Angular, or Node.js.
* GCP Cloud Platforms: Proven track record architecting and deploying systems on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), specifically BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE and Cloud Pub/Sub.
* Database Systems: Strong practical expertise with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL datastores, and columnar analytical warehouses.
* DevOps & IaC: Hands-on mastery of Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and automated CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Tekton, Maven/Gradle).
* API & Testing Standards: Deep knowledge of RESTful API design (OpenAPI/Swagger) paired with a test-driven mindset using JUnit and Mockito

description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Core Technology Infrastructure (CTI), part of the Global Technology & Operations organization, consists of more than 6,600 employees worldwide. With presence in more than 35 countries, TI designs, builds, and operates end-to-end technology infrastructure solutions and manages critical systems and platforms across the bank. TI delivers industry-leading infrastructure products and services to the company’s employees, customers, and clients around the world.
  
  
**Job Description**
An Infrastructure Engineer for Db2 z/OS is required to support software installation, upgrades, maintenance, 24x7 on-call coverage, disaster recovery testing, automation, monitoring, alerting, and security administration for resilient mainframe database and replication services.
  
  
The role contributes to the installation, upgrade, maintenance, certification, and operational support of IBM Db2 for z/OS and replication products, including Q Replication, SQL Replication, and CDC.
  
  
The engineer will help maintain service stability through monitoring, automation, security administration, documented operational procedures, disaster recovery readiness, and effective coordination with internal support teams, software vendors, and management.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  
  

* Install, upgrade, maintain, test, and support IBM Db2 for z/OS and replication products, including Q Replication, SQL Replication, CDC etc.
* Perform software certification testing and maintain clear operational, maintenance, and recovery procedures.
* Support disaster recovery planning and testing to validate service recoverability and operational resilience.
* Develop and enhance automation, monitoring, alerting, health checks, and operational controls.
* Administer security-related activities, including access controls, RACF coordination, TCP/IP connectivity, and network certificates.
* Analyze and resolve complex Db2, replication, infrastructure, performance, and production support issues.
* Work with support teams, software vendors, and management; communicate technical risks, status, and resolution plans clearly.
* Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation and provide off-hours support as required.

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech/Computer Science degree preferred or substantially equivalent experience.
  
  
Certifications If Any: NA
  
  
**Experience Range\***
8-10+ years
  
  
**Foundational Skills**

* Hands-on experience supporting IBM Db2 for z/OS and replication products, including Q Replication, SQL Replication, and CDC.
* Experience with software installation, version upgrades, maintenance, certification testing, operational documentation, and disaster recovery testing.
* Ability to participate in 24x7 on-call rotation and provide off-hours production support when required.
* Strong analytical, debugging, problem-solving, and production incident resolution skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with support teams, software vendors, and management.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience supporting BMC for Db2 tools, IBM z/OS Connect, and Software AG ADABAS and Natural products.
* Programming or automation experience with REXX.
* Working knowledge of SQL, JIRA, SMP/E, RACF, TCP/IP, network certificates, and Splunk.
* Working knowledge of other mainframe subsystems, including CICS, IMS, and MQ.

**Work Timings\***
11:30 to 20:30 IST (Monday-Friday)
  
  

* The schedule would likely start later in the India day initially to perform cross training

**Job Location\***
Hyderabad, Chennai, Mumbai & Gurugram

description:
**Job Title: Senior Product Manager – Enterprise DevOps Platforms**

**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to build and scale a comprehensive DevOps infrastructure that 20,000–30,000 users depend on to move life-changing science to patients faster! This is your opportunity to set the strategy for tools and services that power developer productivity, accelerate delivery, and raise the quality of decision-making across the company. You will feel the sponsorship behind the mission and see the impact of your choices recognized at the highest levels.
  
  
You will lead with both vision and execution—bridging business priorities, user experience, engineering capability, oversight, and organizational standards to build a cohesive platform backbone. Working with guides in software development, cybersecurity, system build, and data, you will align Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitHub Copilot and adjacent services into a secure, scalable, AI-enabled ecosystem. Do you thrive on connecting strategic direction with pragmatic delivery to unlock productivity at scale?
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Portfolio Product Strategy and Vision: Define and drive the product strategy, vision, and roadmap across the enterprise DevOps platform portfolio, aligning business priorities, engineering needs, platform evolution, and enterprise architecture standards to deliver measurable outcomes.
* Team Leadership and Development: Lead and develop Product Owners across multiple products; set direction, clarify accountabilities, set objectives, coach, handle performance, and build a high-performing, outcome-focused culture.
* Connected Platform Ecosystem: Manage Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitHub Copilot and related DevOps services as an integrated ecosystem, not isolated tools; align roadmaps, priorities, and service improvements to support a coherent enterprise strategy.
* Portfolio Prioritization and Direction: Run portfolio-level prioritization that balances business value, user needs, adoption, operational sustainability, security, compliance, and long-term platform health; translate strategy into clear direction and support Product Owners in delivering agreed outcomes.
* Enterprise-Scale Adoption: Drive large-scale adoption and effective usage across 20,000–30,000 users; remove barriers, improve usability and accessibility, and partner with engineering coaches, platform teams, and business collaborators to increase engagement and realized value.
* Ensure platforms are delivered as scalable, supportable, and maintainable enterprise-grade services. Align these services with policies, governance, and the overall organizational system build. Promote standardization, consolidation, and simplification to reduce fragmentation.
* Security by Build and Governance: Embed security-by-design, DevSecOps practices, least privilege principles, and regulatory expectations across the portfolio; ensure secure defaults and appropriate governance in partnership with engineering, security, architecture, and compliance.
* Senior Collaborator Engagement and Influence: Engage senior leaders across business and technology to understand priorities, reconcile differing needs, and influence decisions; act as a senior extension business, product, engineering, and governance.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* The successful candidate will demonstrate significant experience in a product management leadership role such as Senior Product Manager, Lead Product Manager, Product Lead, or a similar position within a technical, platform, or enterprise tooling environment.
* They will bring strong expertise in DevOps, DevSecOps, CI/CD, developer workflows, and enterprise platform product management, together with experience operating across a sophisticated collaborator environment.
* They will also have confirmed experience in formal people management, including leading, coaching, and developing Product Owners or product professionals within a sophisticated enterprise environment.
* The role requires proven experience in leading teams across various products or services, with the ability to build clarity, alignment, and consistency in delivery and product practices.
* Candidates should have a consistent track record of leading central initiatives, influencing across departments, and delivering outcomes in environments where challenges span multiple teams or functional areas. They should be comfortable operating independently, crafting direction, and combining critical thinking with pragmatic execution.
* Experience in portfolio-level product management is critical, including balancing short-term delivery priorities with long-term strategic value across multiple offerings or solutions.
* This position demands demonstrated capability to drive adoption across large user populations, ideally in environments with 10,000+ users. It also requires improving effective usage through product thinking, change enablement, and engaging collaborators.
* Strong communication, leadership, and influencing skills are critical. If you are able to independently persuade internal and external collaborators, often where priorities conflict, and build alignment around roadmap direction, investment decisions, and product outcomes.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience with enterprise platforms and tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitHub Actions, GitHub Copilot, Jenkins, SonarQube, and Artifactory would be valuable.
* Experience with cloud platforms, particularly AWS, is desirable.
* Experience working in a regulated environment, including GxP, would be helpful.
* Experience leading AI-enabled product initiatives or defining AI strategy within enterprise platforms would be advantageous.

As our Site Reliability Engineer, you’ll work closely with our feature team and other colleagues to meet defined service level objectives and continually improve systems and environments. You’ll define error budgets that support finding the right balance between risk and reliability.
  
  
You’ll also provide structure and help to our release process, suggesting and making improvements where possible. You’ll scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, evolving them by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity. * Continually balance and manage any potential risks
* Be accountable for the day-to-day health of both production and non-production environments and respond to any incidents as required
* Provide technical expertise and input to establish the risk tolerance of products and services
* Communicate incident status updates clearly and frequently to other teams, customers and stakeholders

The skills you'll need
  
  
We’re looking for someone with strong knowledge of reliability systems thinking and experience of software engineering. You’ll need experience of using a data driven and scientific approach to fact finding. We’ll also look for financial services knowledge, and the ability to identify wider business impact, risk and opportunity, and make connections across key outputs and processes
  
  
**We’re Also Looking For**

* Strong SRE and production support expertise, including SLI/SLOs, incident/problem management, ITIL, resilience and operational reliability with 12+ years of experience
* Strong technical experience across AWS, Java/Spring Boot, Microservices, React, DevOps, CI/CD, observability, automation and AIOps.

This role supports application engineering and infrastructure teams by establishing automated software delivery, continuous integration, release management, infrastructure-as-code, and operational reliability. Rather than active software development, this role requires a strong architectural and operational understanding of modern microservices, enterprise middleware, database platforms, and batch scheduling systems—specifically

—to effectively automate, deploy, and troubleshoot complex multi-tier application ecosystems.

**CI/CD & Multi-Tier Deployment Automation**

* Design, implement, and maintain scalable Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
* Automate build, packaging, release, and deployment workflows for heterogeneous enterprise workloads, including containerized microservices, traditional middleware, and legacy systems.
* Establish zero-downtime deployment patterns (e.g., Blue-Green, Canary releases) and automated rollback mechanisms across distributed application stacks.

**Enterprise Middleware & Batch Lifecycle Support**

* Support deployment automation and environment configuration for enterprise middleware, including IBM WebSphere application servers and TIBCO BusinessWorks (BW) integration platforms.
* Automate workload scheduling and batch job management using AutoSys (e.g., JIL definition management, job dependency orchestration, and release integration).
* Troubleshoot deployment failures, runtime connectivity, environment variables, configuration drift, and integration points across middleware and batch environments.

**Microservices & Container Orchestration**

* Manage, standardize, and support containerized Java Microservices running on orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes / Red Hat OpenShift.
