description:
**Job Title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance**
**GCL: D3**
**Introduction To Role**
Do you want to build the clear routes that ensure secure delivery becomes the standard across a global enterprise? Can you turn sophisticated security and compliance controls into simple, reusable developer experiences that teams love to adopt?
  
  
In this role, you will develop the outspoken pipelines, infrastructure modules, and automation that power efficient, secure software delivery at scale. Your work will reduce friction for engineering teams, embed security-by-design from the start, and accelerate the delivery of technology that underpins life-changing science for patients worldwide.
  
  
You will partner closely with engineering, security, architecture, and operations to shape enterprise-grade platform capabilities—hands-on and end-to-end. Expect to start by shipping high-impact, reusable assets and evolve into guiding standards and adoption across hundreds of engineers, always balancing deep technical difficulty with practical, outcome-focused delivery.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Golden Paths & Shared GitHub Actions: Design, build, and version enterprise-grade shared GitHub Actions (Composite Actions and Reusable Workflows) and standardized delivery templates to create secure, automated "Golden Paths" across product teams.
* Reusable Infrastructure-as-Code: Build and maintain secure, modular Terraform modules and IaC assets, versioned and documented for broad reuse and easy consumption.
* Embedded DevSecOps Controls: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM generation, and supply chain protections into default delivery workflows, shifting security left through automation and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Secure CI/CD Patterns: Create scalable, resilient CI/CD patterns aligned to enterprise standards, applying least privilege and reducing configuration risk to strengthen operational reliability.
* Automation and Internal Tooling: Develop automation services and developer tooling in Python or Golang that enable self-service onboarding, secure defaults, and consistent quality checks.
* Multi-Environment Architecture: Chip in to solutions spanning cloud, serverless, containerized, compute, and hybrid environments, producing reference architectures, diagrams, and implementation guidance that accelerate adoption.
* Testing and Quality Engineering: Define and execute testing strategies for infrastructure code and automation (unit, integration, and environment validation) to ensure repeatable, high-quality delivery.
* Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Partner with product and platform consumers to drive adoption, capture feedback, and iterate on patterns and assets to enhance developer experience and business value.
* AI-Enabled Engineering: Apply AI tools and techniques where appropriate to improve development speed, quality, secure design, and innovation, sharing learning and elevating team practices.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Significant 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or a related technical engineering discipline.
* GitHub Actions Platform Development: Hands-on experience authoring, testing, and maintaining centralized, reusable GitHub Actions (Composite Actions, Reusable Workflows) across an enterprise organization.
* Pipeline Versioning & Security: Understanding of Semantic Versioning for GitHub Actions (@v1, @v2), supply chain pinning, and securing pipeline-to-AWS authentication using OpenID Connect (OIDC)
* Strong experience with AWS, including services related to compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures.
* Advanced expertise in Terraform and reusable infrastructure-as-code design.
* Strong scripting or software engineering capability in Python or Golang.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and controls, including SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and software supply chain security.
* Experience designing and implementing secure CI/CD pipelines within enterprise environments.
* Solid grasp of security-by-design, the least privilege, and secure architecture principles.
* Experience building scalable, reusable, modular platform solutions rather than one-off implementations.
* Ability to create clear and effective user documentation and architecture artefacts.
* Collaboration skills and ability to work optimally across engineering, security, and architecture teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant certifications in cloud, security, infrastructure, or DevOps/DevSecOps would be advantageous.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration technologies.
* Exposure to hybrid or on-premises environments.
* Familiarity with Azure cloud services.
* Knowledge of modern application stacks such as Java, .NET, or React.
* Experience applying AI tools to development, testing, secure design, or engineering productivity improvement.
* Experience with infrastructure testing frameworks such as Terratest.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior Data Platform Engineer**
**The opportunity**
Your role will be a Technology Lead, or Senior Technology Lead in the Cloud Engineering team. You will be responsible to be a part of the delivery of IT projects for our customers across the globe.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and manage Databricks/Snowflake infrastructure on Azure and AWS, ensuring scalable, secure, and cost-effective deployments.

* Integrate Databricks/Snowflake with enterprise CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.) for code, data, and model lifecycle management.
* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for Databricks workloads using native and third-party tools (e.g., Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Datadog).
* Optimize Databricks cluster performance and cost, including autoscaling, spot instance usage, and job scheduling.
* Ensure security best practices: manage secrets, network isolation, encryption, and compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.
* Collaborate with data engineering, analytics, and ML teams to enable seamless integration and workflow automation.
* Drive adoption of DevSecOps practices: integrate security scanning and compliance checks into DataOps/MLOps pipelines.
* Lead incident response and root cause analysis for Databricks platform issues, ensuring high availability and reliability.
* Document architecture, processes, and best practices for knowledge sharing and operational excellence.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Expertise in Databricks/Snowflake administration, including workspace, cluster, and job management.
* Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS), including networking, IAM, and cost management.
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM, Bicep) and automation scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell).
* Experience with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and source control (Git).
* Deep understanding of DataOps and MLOps concepts, including orchestration, versioning, and monitoring.
* Familiarity with data governance tools and frameworks (Unity Catalog, Purview, AWS Lake Formation, etc.).
* Ability to design secure, compliant, and scalable data architectures in multi-cloud environments.
* Strong troubleshooting and performance optimization skills for distributed data and ML workloads.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive platform adoption.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor).
* Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and integrating security tools into data pipelines.
* Ability to mentor and upskill teams on Databricks, DataOps, and MLOps best practices.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to assess risks and propose mitigation strategies.
* Experience with regulatory compliance (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.) in cloud data environments is a plus.
* Capability to identify software packages and solutions that could meet client solution requirements and develop requests for proposal (RFP’s) from these vendors. Assist clients in the evaluation of the resulting proposals, including the package capabilities and fit to the requirements (business and technology), vendor proposals for pricing and support.
* Capability to design and developed AI infused DevOps and Platform Engineering framework.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* BE/B.Tech/MCA with a sound industry experience of 4 to 8 years
* Cloud Computing knowledge in multi cloud environments (Azure, AWS)
* Hands-on experience with Databricks administration on Azure and/or AWS, including workspace, cluster, and job management
* DevOps – Setting up CI/CD pipeline using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI
* Strong understanding of DataOps and MLOps practices, including orchestration, monitoring, and governance
* Hands-on experience with containerization, including Docker & Kubernetes (AKS/EKS/GKE)
* Scripting Knowledge on PowerShell, python, Groovy, Shell Scripting and cloud native CLIs
* Must be good in IAC tools such as Terraform or ARM or Bicep
* Must be good in Config Management Tools such as Ansible or Chef or Puppet
* Expertise in Golden Paths creation for end-to-end developer workflows.

**Preferred Skills**

* Microsoft Certified: Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions (AZ-305)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
* Hashicorp Certified: Terraform Associates
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
* GitHub Actions
* Github Copilot
* Good to have knowledge in Terraform Cloud, Ansible Tower

**Your People Responsibilities**

* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives
* Ability to travel in accordance with client and other job requirements
* Excellent written and oral communication skills; writing, publishing, and conference-level presentation skills a plus

**Technologies and Tools**

* Cloud platform – Azure, AWS
* SDLC Methodologies: Agile /Scrum
* Version Control Tools – GitHub/ Bitbucket/GitLab
* CI/CD Automation Tools – Azure DevOps/ Bamboo/ Team City/ Harness/ Octopus
* Container Management Tools – Docker/Kubernetes/Docker Swarm
* Application Performance Management Tools – Prometheus/ Dynatrace/ AppDynamics
* Monitoring Tools – Splunk/ Datadog/ Grafana
* IAC Tools – Terraform/ARM Templates/ Bicep
* Config Management Tools – Chef/ puppet/ Ansible

**What We Look For**

* Strong experience in the use of DevOps Tools and technologies, including container technologies.
* Proven experience in Infrastructure Automation (IAC Tools + Config Mgmt. Tool) and experience in Application Automation using Azure DevOps
* Working experience in Azure and strong knowledge in cloud Architecture strategy.

title: Advanced Associate, Observability Engineering
description:
**Function: Observability Engineering / SRE / Cloud Engineering**

  
  

**About the Role**

  
  

We are looking for an
**Observability Engineer**
to join our Observability Engineering team and help build, standardize, and operate a modern enterprise observability platform across cloud and application environments.

  
  

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on engineering experience with
**New Relic, Grafana, and modern observability technologies**
, combined with solid foundations in
**cloud engineering, automation, DevOps, and SRE practices**
.

  
  

This role goes beyond dashboard creation and monitoring operations. You will be responsible for
**engineering scalable observability solutions**
, defining telemetry standards, building reusable monitoring capabilities, improving application and infrastructure visibility, and enabling engineering teams to adopt observability as part of their software delivery lifecycle.

  
  

You will work closely with SRE, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, Application Engineering, and Operations teams to build a consistent and scalable observability experience across the organization.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**1. Observability Engineering**

  

  
* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-grade observability solutions across applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and services.
  
  
* Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, dashboards, service health views, and operational telemetry.
  
  
* Develop standardized observability patterns for
  **metrics, logs, traces, events, and application performance monitoring**
  .
  
  
* Implement observability solutions using
  **New Relic, Grafana, and other industry-standard tools**
  .
  
  
* Develop reusable dashboards, alerts, instrumentation patterns, and observability components.
  
  
* Establish observability standards and best practices across engineering teams.
  
  
* Continuously improve signal quality by reducing alert noise, false positives, and non-actionable alerts.
  

  

**2. New Relic Engineering**

  

  
* Hands-on engineering experience with
  **New Relic APM, Infrastructure Monitoring, Browser Monitoring, Synthetic Monitoring, Logs, Distributed Tracing, NRQL, Alerts, Workloads and Dashboards**
  .
  
  
* Design and implement New Relic monitoring and alerting strategies for enterprise applications.
  
  
* Develop complex
  **NRQL queries**
  , alert conditions, dashboards, and operational views.
  
  
* Configure and optimize New Relic agents and integrations.
  
  
* Implement application and infrastructure instrumentation.
  
  
* Develop reusable New Relic configurations and automation using APIs/IaC where appropriate.
  
  
* Participate in New Relic platform governance, licensing optimization, and standardization.
  
  
* Evaluate and implement emerging New Relic capabilities to improve engineering productivity and reliability.
  

  

**3. Grafana & Visualization**

  

  
* Build and maintain operational dashboards using
  **Grafana**
  .
  
  
* Integrate Grafana with multiple telemetry and data sources.
  
  
* Design effective dashboards for application health, infrastructure, SRE, NOC, and executive operational visibility.
  
  
* Develop visualization standards and reusable dashboard templates.
  
  
* Understand the difference between
  **visualization, monitoring, alerting, and observability**
  , and apply each appropriately.
  

  

**4. OpenTelemetry & Modern Observability**

  

  
* Experience with
  **OpenTelemetry**
  and modern telemetry architectures.
  
  
* Implement and manage telemetry collection for metrics, logs, and traces.
  
  
* Understand distributed tracing and service dependency mapping.
  
  
* Work with telemetry pipelines, collectors, agents, exporters, and integrations.
  
  
* Experience with technologies such as
  **Prometheus, Loki, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or similar observability platforms**
  is desirable.
  
  
* Evaluate new observability technologies and recommend solutions based on scalability, cost, reliability, and engineering value.
  

  

**5. Cloud Engineering**

  
  

Strong cloud engineering fundamentals are expected, including experience with one or more major cloud platforms:

  

  
* **AWS**
  
  
* **Microsoft Azure**
  
  
* **Google Cloud Platform**
  

  

Experience should include:

  

  
* Compute, networking, storage, databases, containers, and cloud-native services.
  
  
* Cloud monitoring and logging.
  
  
* IAM and security fundamentals.
  
  
* Infrastructure automation.
  
  
* Cloud-native architecture and operational best practices.
  
  
* Troubleshooting distributed cloud environments.
  

  

**6. Automation & Infrastructure as Code**

  

  
* Automate repetitive observability and operational activities.
  
  
* Develop scripts and tools using
  **Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages**
  .
  
  
* Use
  **Terraform / OpenTofu**
  or equivalent Infrastructure as Code technologies.
  
  
* Build reusable automation for dashboards, alerts, instrumentation, integrations, and configuration management.
  
  
* Integrate observability capabilities into CI/CD pipelines.
  

  

**7. DevOps & CI/CD**

  

  
* Experience with modern CI/CD practices and tools.
  
  
* Hands-on experience with
  **GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms**
  .
  
  
* Integrate observability and quality gates into deployment pipelines.
  
  
* Implement deployment markers and release health monitoring.
  
  
* Enable automated validation of application and infrastructure health following deployments.
  

  

**8. SRE & Reliability Engineering**

  

  
* Apply SRE principles to improve system reliability and operational maturity.
  
  
* Define and monitor
  **SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets**
  .
  
  
* Participate in incident investigation and root-cause analysis.
  
  
* Develop proactive monitoring and reliability solutions.
  
  
* Identify reliability gaps and engineer solutions to eliminate recurring incidents.
  
  
* Support capacity, performance, availability, and resilience engineering.
  

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

  
  

**Must Have**

  

  
* **3+ years of experience**
  in Observability, SRE, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **New Relic**
  .
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Grafana**
  .
  
  
* Experience building production-grade dashboards, monitoring and alerting solutions.
  
  
* Strong understanding of
  **APM, infrastructure monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and distributed systems**
  .
  
  
* Experience with
  **NRQL**
  and New Relic alerting.
  
  
* Experience with
  **OpenTelemetry**
  is highly desirable.
  
  
* Strong cloud engineering experience in
  **AWS, Azure, or GCP**
  .
  
  
* Strong scripting/programming experience in
  **Python, Bash, Go, or similar**
  .
  
  
* Experience with
  **Terraform/OpenTofu**
  or another Infrastructure-as-Code technology.
  
  
* Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices.
  
  
* Understanding of SRE principles, SLIs, SLOs, incident management, and reliability engineering.
  
  
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  

  

**Good to Have**

  

  
* New Relic certifications or equivalent hands-on expertise.
  
  
* Grafana/Prometheus experience.
  
  
* OpenTelemetry implementation experience.
  
  
* Kubernetes and container observability.
  
  
* Experience with
  **Prometheus, Loki, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics**
  or similar platforms.
  
  
* Experience designing enterprise observability architectures.
  
  
* Experience with observability platform migrations or consolidation.
  
  
* Experience with observability cost optimization and licensing governance.
  
  
* Experience developing observability-as-code.
  
  
* Experience integrating observability with
  **ServiceNow, Jira, PagerDuty, Opsgenie**
  , or similar ITSM/incident platforms.
  
  
* Experience with AI-assisted observability, AIOps, anomaly detection, or automated incident investigation.
  

  

**What Success Looks Like**

  
  

In this role, you will be successful when you can:

  

  
* **Engineer rather than simply operate monitoring.**
  
  
* Build scalable observability solutions that can be reused across hundreds of applications.
  
  
* Turn raw telemetry into meaningful engineering and operational insights.
  
  
* Reduce alert noise and improve signal quality.
  
  
* Standardize New Relic and Grafana adoption across engineering teams.
  
  
* Automate observability configuration and reduce manual operational work.
  
  
* Improve application reliability through better telemetry and proactive detection.
  
  
* Enable engineering teams to own more of their operational health.
  
  
* Help establish
  **Observability as a Platform/Capability**
  , rather than simply another monitoring tool.
  

  

**Behavioral & Leadership Skills**

  

  
* Strong ownership and accountability.
  
  
* Ability to work across engineering, application, infrastructure, and operations teams.
  
  
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
* Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
  
  
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, enterprise engineering environment.
  
  
* Passion for automation, engineering excellence, reliability, and continuous improvement.
  
  
* Ability to challenge existing approaches and introduce better engineering practices.

In this role, you will lead the engineering foundations that power how teams build, test, secure, and ship software that enables our mission to transform patient outcomes. You will guide a high-performing team to elevate our use of GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, SonarQube, Artifactory, and related ecosystems, balancing operational excellence with bold engineering improvements. As we accelerate our shift to a more digital and data-led business, you will shape the capabilities, standards, and automations that unlock impact at scale. Could you see yourself leading the service strategy while also rolling up your sleeves to solve complex CI/CD challenges and lead change?

* Strong experience in operational service leadership, including support models, prioritization, SLA delivery, incident management, and continuous improvement.

* Experience in an international corporate setting with geographically dispersed collaborators and teams .
* Experience within DevOps or platform engineering functions.
* Knowledge of AWS or other cloud environments.
* Experience with automation and scripting, including Python, Shell, or PowerShell.
* Exposure to Kubernetes, containers, or related modern engineering platforms.
* Experience with REST APIs, platform integrations, and interoperability.
* Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and service reporting tools.
* Experience in applying AI to improve engineering workflows, support services, or productivity.

Associate Architect

Full-Time

**Experience Level:**
Mid-to-Senior Level (7 to 12 years)

**About the Role**

We are seeking a high-performing
**Software Engineer transitioning into Architecture (Aspirant Architect)**
. In this pivotal role, you will bridge the gap between hands-on code execution and high-level architectural design.

You will work directly alongside Principal Architects, Technical Leads, and Engineering Managers to architect, evaluate, and scale distributed systems on modern cloud platforms. This role is built for a senior-level developer with strong software engineering fundamentals, deep cloud and distributed systems experience, and a passion for system design, data modeling, and technical leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Architectural Design & Technical Leadership**

* Assist in drafting architectural blueprints, tech stack evaluation documents, and Architecture Decision
* Perform trade-off analyses balancing performance, maintainability, security, scalability, and operational costs across cloud services and codebases.
* Help define and enforce coding standards, API specifications (REST/gRPC/GraphQL), and design patterns across delivery teams.

**2. Hands-on Engineering & Prototyping**

* Write production-ready, highly maintainable code (primarily using
  **Python**
  or equivalent modern languages).
* Build Proofs-of-Concept (PoCs) to test emerging technologies, validate architectural hypotheses, and bench-test performance bottlenecks.
* Troubleshoot complex, non-deterministic bugs and failure modes in distributed production environments.

**3. Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Integration**

* Architect resilient, highly available cloud applications on
  **AWS**
  or
  **Azure**
  using microservices, serverless, and containerized topologies.
* Collaborate with DevOps engineers to establish Infrastructure as Code (IaC), continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and deployment strategies (Canary, Blue/Green).
* Integrate full-stack observability (logging, metrics, distributed tracing) into software architecture from inception.

**4. Data Modeling & System Design**

* Design efficient relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL) schemas optimized for read/write access patterns, storage efficiency, and data integrity.
* Implement event-driven and streaming architectures using message brokers (e.g., Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Azure Event Grid).

**5. SDLC Execution & Engineering Mentorship**

* Champion the end-to-end Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)—from threat modeling and capacity planning to post-launch monitoring.
* Conduct high-impact code and design reviews, mentoring mid-level and junior engineers on clean architecture, principles, and system resilience.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

**Technical Competencies**

* **Software Development:**
  7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience using
  **Python**
  or similar languages (Go, Java, C#).

description:

**Pay And Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
The Enterprise Test Engineering ("ETE") family is responsible for ensuring that all applications and systems meet defined quality standards. The ETE family encompasses three major areas including (a) functional testing, (b) non-functional testing, and (c) test architecture and enablement. Other key focuses include: regression testing, browser testing, performance testing, capacity and stress testing, resiliency testing, environment management services, and infrastructure testing. Develops, conducts, and evaluates testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. The Performance Test Engineering role is responsible for the validation of non-functional requirements for performance testing.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**

* Develop proven grasp of the DTCC Software Delivery process, Performance Test Engineering framework, CoE (Center of Excellence) Engagement process as well as understanding of tech-stack (tools and technologies) to perform day-to-day job
* Prepare, maintain, and implement performance/resiliency test scenarios based on non-functional requirements and follow standard DTCC testing guidelines
* Automate performance test scenarios by using current automated functional and performance test scripts in compliance with the non-functional framework
* Maintain traceability across Non-Functional Requirements, Performance Test Scenarios and Defects
* Review of performance and resiliency test scenarios from both a technical and business perspective with collaborators, such as development teams and business
* Track defects to closure, report test results, continuously supervise execution achievements and call out as required
* Contribute to the technical aspects of Delivery Pipeline adoption for performance testing and improve adoption
* Identify environmental and data requirements; collaborate with Development and Testing teams to manage and maintain environment and data
* Develop a basic understanding of the product being delivered including architecture considerations and technical design of the supported applications in relations to the performance, resiliency and scalability.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 4 years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

* Collaborates well within and across teams.
* Communicates openly with team members and others.
* Experience in performance engineering (analysis, testing, and tuning)
* Experience in Resiliency and Chaos engineering
* Expertise in load testing tools, such as JMeter, LoadRunner etc.
* Experience with Snowflake tasks, warehouse, components and optimization
* Experience with AWS services (Kinesis, Elastic Beanstalk, CloudWatch, Lambda, etc)
* Experience with CI/CD pipeline implementations, including testing, using Jenkins or similar tool
* Expertise in performance analysis of distributed platforms including Linux, Windows, AWS, Containers and VMware (tools: Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Splunk, CloudWatch, TeamQuest)
* Knowledge of the functionality and performance aspects of the above computing platforms
* Understanding of queuing networks modeling and simulation modeling concepts and experience with one of the industry standard analytic modeling tools – TeamQuest, Metron-Athenee, HyPerformix, and BMC
* Experience in scripting (Perl, Unix shell, Python, Terraform, Chef, Jenkins)
* Experience using JMS/IBM-MQ messaging system
* Understanding of RESTful web service, JSON, and XML
* Experience in Relational Databases, preferably Oracle
* Expert MS Office skills. Effective use of Excel statistical functions and sophisticated Power Point presentation skills
* Experience working with Agile teams (preferably scrum)
* Experience in the financial services industry is good to have
* Experience working in Unix or Linux environments

title: Senior Cloud and AI operation leader
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
KLA's IT group supports business growth and productivity by connecting people, process and technology around the world. We work to improve the technology that drives our business to thrive and focus on empowering employee use of technology. This integrated approach to customer service, creativity and technological excellence enhances employee productivity, business analytics and process excellence.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Operations Leadership**

* Lead and manage global cloud operations across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Develop and execute cloud operational strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Ensure high availability, reliability, and performance of cloud platforms.
* Provide executive reporting on cloud health, service availability, operational metrics, and risks.
* Manage a globally distributed cloud operations team and follow-the-sun support model.

**Service Delivery & Support**

* Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 operational support for cloud infrastructure and platform services.
* Establish and manage 24x7 on-call support processes.
* Drive major incident management and root cause analysis.
* Develop SLAs, OLAs, KPIs, and operational dashboards.
* Ensure timely resolution of service requests, incidents, and problems.

**Cloud Governance & Security**- Partner with Information Security teams to enforce security standards, policies, and compliance requirements.
- Ensure cloud environments meet regulatory and audit requirements.
- Implement security best practices including:

* Identity & Access Management (IAM)
* Privileged Access Management (PAM)
* Network Security
* Data Protection
* Encryption
* Vulnerability Management
* Standardize cloud operational processes across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Maintain cloud operating models.

**Monitoring & Observability**

* Implement enterprise monitoring and observability frameworks.
* Develop proactive alerting and performance optimization strategies.

**Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity**

* Define cloud DR strategies, RTO/RPO objectives, and recovery procedures.
* Conduct DR testing and business continuity exercises.
* Oversee backup and recovery operations for cloud workloads.

**Cost & Capacity Management**

* Manage cloud financial operations (FinOps).
* Optimize cloud spending across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Monitor utilization, capacity, rightsizing, and reservation strategies.
* Drive cost governance and budget planning.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 10+ years of IT Infrastructure, Cloud Operations, or Platform Engineering experience.
* 5+ years in management or leadership role.
* Experience managing global cloud operations teams supporting enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience operating AWS, Azure, and GCP production environments.

**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Senior Administrator, Systems
description:
**Title**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Senior Administrator, Systems
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Senior Systems Administrator is responsible for overseeing and providing the installation, maintenance, support and enhancement to the Company computing infrastructure. Areas of responsibility include Windows and Linux Operating Systems , Active Directory , Azure/Entra, Office365, VMWare, Backup and Cloud technologies. The Senior Systems Administrator recommends technology decisions to Management and directs operational processes to Systems Administrators for the ICU Medical Global Computing environment.
  
  
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Create the Architecture; implement, configure, and support all enterprise computing systems globally.
* Create standards and documentation for the Global computing environments.
* Participate in creating and following the directives in the Infrastructure Strategic plan.
* Adhere to all Service Level Agreements established with the user community.
* Create reports and establish operational guidelines for the Global Computing Environments.
* Create automated monitoring to alert Systems Administrators and Service Desk staff of disruptions of service.
* Participate in vendor management under the direction of the department manager.
* Architect, implement, and support virtual and standalone server and storage solutions.
* Benchmark, evaluate and make recommendations for the selection of server and storage management software and hardware products.
* Develop and implement business continuity practices for server and storage management.
* Monitor server and storage performance, diagnose server issues, and perform emergency and scheduled maintenance.
* Provide support to operations relating to server and storage administration problems.
* Maintain server and storage configurations to provide performance monitoring/tuning of enterprise environments.
* Keep the Information Systems staff and customers informed of the status and resolution of issues; update the Service Desk software with resolutions and status.
* Participate in strategic initiatives by performing technical project activities.
* Evaluate server system and storage upgrades and management software patches.
* Prepare monthly status reports (or implement web-based reports) quantitatively reporting server and storage capacity, performance and uptime.
* Responsible for securing server and storage resources including password maintenance, new user logon and setup, and data protection procedures.
* Create and maintain automated systems and procedures for storage and server operations.
* Assist Service Desk staff in streamlining daily operations.
* Coordinate with user community scheduling times and user procedures necessary for server and storage system upgrades and/or maintenance.
* Work to minimize downtime impact on users through accurate planning of scheduled downtimes and quick problem resolution for unscheduled downtimes.
* Follow the established standards for writing and documenting projects and server and storage configurations.
* Contribute to the development of new standards and/or the modification of existing standards.
* Participate in the 24/7 department on-call program.
* Work on special assignments as they arise.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Operating Systems
* Strong knowledge of Office 365 environments
* Experience with PowerShell and using scripting to automate configuration management
* Experience with automation platforms such as SCORCH, MoveIT Automate, VMWare Orchestrator
* Experience with Azure cloud services
* Experience with DFS, CIFS, and print services
* Experience with VDI technologies. Preferably RDS and Horizon
* Experience with MSSQL and basic MSSQL management functions
* Strong knowledge in supporting enterprise backup solutions and troubleshooting backup issues
* Strong knowledge of data center technologies; Virtualization, Storage, Servers
* Understanding or experience supporting .Net application servers
* Knowledge of budget reductions, standardized processes, and operational automation.
* Strong customer service skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent collaboration skills and able to work in a team environment
* Able to work quickly and effectively under pressure and to efficiently handle multiple priorities simultaneously

**Minimum Qualifications, Education & Experience**

* Must be at least 18 years of age
* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related IT field
* Minimum 7 years of experience in server/user administration, virtualization and storage in a global enterprise environment
* Microsoft certification preferred
* Strong experience in virtual/physical server and storage technologies
* Experience in developing and implementing business continuity and disaster recovery practices
* Experience in data backup technologies
* Experience planning and leading global small to medium scale server related projects

**Work Environment**

* This is largely a sedentary role.
* This job operates in a professional office environment and routinely uses standard office equipment.
* Typically requires travel less than 15% of the time.

title: Director - Tech Operations
description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
Joining Amex Tech means helping build and operate technology that supports critical business capabilities at enterprise scale. We are seeking an experienced
**Director of Engineering**
to lead a portfolio within the Operations Data and Analytics organization spanning
**ServiceNow and IT Service Management (ITSM), Strategy platform engineering, and observability and operational analytics for the Customer Journey availability program**
.
  
  
A significant area of focus will be the continued development and modernization of
**Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and the Configuration Management Database (CMDB)**
capabilities that support these processes. This leader will help ensure these capabilities operate as integrated enterprise technology products, with strong engineering practices, reliable data, appropriate governance, and roadmaps aligned to the needs of the broader technology organization.
  
  
This leader will be responsible for bringing together platforms, engineering practices, operational processes, and data to improve availability, resiliency, efficiency, and measurable business outcomes across mission-critical technology services.
  
  
The role requires an experienced engineering leader who can operate at both the strategic and execution levels—setting direction and developing technical talent while maintaining sufficient depth to challenge architecture, engineering, reliability, platform, and service-management decisions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**How You Will Make an Impact**
**Engineering & Platform Leadership**

* Lead engineering and platform capabilities supporting ServiceNow/ITSM, Strategy, and Customer Journeys.
* Establish and execute multi-year platform and engineering strategies aligned with organizational priorities.
* Drive modernization of platform architecture, engineering practices, automation, integrations, and data capabilities.
* Establish standards for software quality, testing, deployment, security, scalability, resilience, and maintainability.
* Ensure critical platforms meet expectations for availability, performance, scalability, security, and regulatory compliance.
* Develop strong technical talent and create organizational depth while establishing clear accountability and ownership.

**ServiceNow, ITSM & Operational Excellence**

* Provide strategic and engineering leadership for ServiceNow and associated enterprise ITSM capabilities, with particular emphasis on Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and CMDB development as it relates to those areas.
* Establish and evolve a technology roadmap for these capabilities that aligns ServiceNow development with enterprise operational, reliability, risk, product owners, and business priorities.
* Maintain a strong understanding of industry standards, established practices, and emerging trends across ITIL-based Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management and use that knowledge to inform platform strategy and engineering priorities.
* Ensure CMDB capabilities supporting Incident, Problem, and Change processes provide accurate, useful, and sustainable configuration and relationship data.
* Drive integration across Incident, Problem, Change, and CMDB capabilities so that configuration data strengthens impact analysis, root-cause analysis, risk assessment, operational decision-making, and automation.
* Partner with ITSM process owners and technology stakeholders to translate process strategy into scalable ServiceNow capabilities.
* Participate in and influence the ServiceNow roadmap through established governance, prioritization, and planning forums, representing the needs and priorities of SRE, Application Support, Operations Engineering, and other technology stakeholders.
* Build alignment across process owners, platform teams, engineering organizations, and senior leaders on ServiceNow priorities, investments, sequencing, and technical direction.
* Challenge unnecessary process or platform complexity while ensuring appropriate controls, governance, and auditability.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows, eliminate process gaps, improve data quality, and reduce operational toil.
* Ensure ServiceNow capabilities evolve as engineered products rather than simply administrative workflows.
* Establish metrics demonstrating the effectiveness of ITSM capabilities and their impact on availability, reliability, engineering productivity, and operational outcomes.

**Observability, SRE & Availability**

* Define and evolve observability capabilities using technologies such as Dynatrace, Splunk, OpenTelemetry, and related enterprise tooling.
* Improve telemetry, monitoring, alerting, event correlation, and root-cause-analysis capabilities.
* Drive adoption of engineering practices that move teams from reactive monitoring toward proactive observability and reliability management.
* Partner with SRE and application teams to establish meaningful SLIs, SLOs, availability measures, and service-health standards.
* Use operational data to identify recurring failure patterns and prioritize engineering investments.
* Connect observability, CMDB, Incident, and Problem data to improve identification and resolution of reliability issues.
* Expand the footprint of our Customer Journeys and align them to critical business services.

**Strategy & Data Platforms**

* Lead application development and production support for Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy), including delivery execution and the long-term platform roadmap.
* Ensure availability, scalability, and performance of BI and analytics capabilities supporting critical business and operational decisions.
* Drive modernization of data architecture, tooling, and engineering practices.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to develop advanced analytics and data-driven operational insights.
* Create integrations with other operational solutions including agentic solutions.

**Customer Journey Availability**

* Provide leadership across modern data ecosystems and workflow/orchestration technologies such as Apache Airflow.
* Lead and expand capabilities for measuring end-to-end availability across critical customer journeys.
* Establish visibility and accountability across application, infrastructure, platform, and business teams.
* Support 99.99% availability objectives for designated critical journeys through standardized measurement, governance, and engineering practices.
* Establish controls and processes supporting reliability, risk management, auditability, and consistent delivery of business outcomes.
* Use observability and operational data to proactively identify risks affecting customer experiences.

**Financial & Organizational Leadership**

* Build, attract, retain, and develop high-performing engineering talent.
* Lead effectively across globally distributed teams and stakeholders.

**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Significant experience leading enterprise engineering, platform engineering, SRE, production management, data, or technology operations organizations.
* Demonstrated experience providing leadership to senior engineers and technical leaders.
* Strong experience with ServiceNow and enterprise ITSM/ITIL processes, particularly Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management.
* Strong understanding of industry standards and established ITIL practices associated with Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and Configuration Management.
* Experience developing or overseeing CMDB capabilities that directly support Incident, Problem, and Change processes.
* Demonstrated experience participating in and influencing ServiceNow platform roadmaps through established governance, planning, and prioritization forums in a complex enterprise environment.
* Ability to influence platform direction across organizations where roadmap ownership, process ownership, engineering execution, and business priorities may reside with different teams.
* Experience with enterprise observability platforms such as Dynatrace and Splunk, including modern telemetry and monitoring practices.
* Strong background in application development, data platforms, analytics ecosystems, and production engineering.
* Experience defining and executing large-scale technology and platform strategies.
* Experience operating business-critical systems in highly available and regulated environments.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering, APIs, DevOps, CI/CD, cloud, automation, and reliability engineering.
* Demonstrated ability to influence peers and leaders and align teams across complex global organizations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) or comparable enterprise BI platforms.
* Experience with Apache Airflow or comparable data orchestration technologies.
* Experience with Site Reliability and Operations Engineering in a large-scale application support organization.
* Experience establishing enterprise observability strategies.

**Leadership Qualities**
Successful Directors in this role will demonstrate the ability to:
  
  

* Set a clear technology vision and convert strategy into executable roadmaps.
* Develop senior engineers and technical leaders.
* Create clear ownership and accountability while empowering individuals to make decisions.
* Balance delivery speed with reliability, security, technical debt, regulatory requirements, and long-term maintainability.
* Communicate complex technical issues and tradeoffs effectively with both engineers and executives.
* Influence enterprise platform and process direction when decision-making is distributed across multiple organizations.
* Build consensus through established governance while being willing to constructively challenge priorities and approaches.
* Make sound decisions in ambiguous situations.
* Create an engineering culture centered on technical excellence, automation, continuous improvement, and learning.
* Maintain sufficient technical depth to challenge teams without becoming the team's de facto principal engineer.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: AI DevOps Engineer II
description:
****Your Title: AI DevOps Engineer II****
****Job Location: Chennai, India****
****Our Department: Trimble Cloud xOps****
As a member of Trimble’s global engineering team focused on accelerating Cloud Support, your first assignment will be to work on the Trimble Cloud xOps. You will be a key member of the Cloud Engineering Team committed to developing, automating, and supporting Trimble's cloud and AI projects while ensuring an intuitive product experience for our current and future customers. We are seeking a highly skilled, motivated, and collaborative individual who maintains a low-key demeanor. The ideal candidate should have experience in building responsive, customer-facing applications and scaling AI/ML infrastructure using the latest cloud and MLOps technologies.
  
  
**Technical/Operational/Functional Expertise**
**What You Will Do:**

* Create, maintain, and enhance automated product and AI/ML model deployments.
* Develop, modify, support, and maintain AWS-based components through Infrastructure as Code and automation (IaC).
* Enhance availability and incident management by implementing AI-driven observability and self-healing solutions based on predictive alerts.
* Continuously improve monitoring, logging, and AIOps capabilities, enabling us to be proactive instead of reactive.
* Conduct risk assessments and business impact analyses to identify potential threats and their impact on business operations and AI workflows.
* Design and configure DR solutions on AWS, including backup, replication, and failover strategies for infrastructure and vector/data stores utilizing services such as AWS Backup, AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery, and Lambda.
* Maintain and improve the current CI/CD and MLOps pipelines (GitHub Workflows & Jenkins).
* Utilize strong Python knowledge for operational automation, API integration, and AI workflow support.
* Apply proficiency in Terraform for Infrastructure as Code to manage AWS resources (including compute, storage, and GPU/EKS clusters).
* Write Shell and PowerShell scripts for system automation.
* Execute application and AI model deployment automation using Ansible, Terraform, Kubernetes, and model-serving frameworks.
* Review and maintain IaC repositories in Bitbucket and GitHub.
* Manage end-to-end deployments and AI/ML infrastructure pipelines.
* Meet and achieve goals for Key Performance Indicators, Service Level Agreements, and Operating Level Agreements.
* Maintain high levels of system uptime and model availability.
* Create, define, manage, track, and improve processes to ensure effective, automated services are being provided.

**What Skills & Experience You Should Bring**

* AWS certifications such as Certified Solutions Architect or Certified DevOps Engineer preferred.
* Experience in a similar role within a large-scale enterprise environment working with DevOps or MLOps practices.
* 3 to 5 years of experience with monitoring and AIOps solutions (DataDog, Grafana, Nagios, New Relic).
* Proficiency with container technologies like Docker, Kubernetes, ECS, EKS, and model-serving runtimes.
* Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure components, AWS SageMaker, vector databases, or LLM deployment frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of AWS services related to DR, including AWS Backup, AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery, Lambda, etc.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as AWS CloudFormation or Terraform.
* Familiarity with networking, security, and storage solutions on AWS tailored for high-performance AI workloads.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Monitoring tools setup experience using Datadog, Grafana, etc. preferred.
* Working experience or strong foundational understanding of core AI competencies, including Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), custom Skills creation, and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Practical hands-on experience utilizing AI-assisted developer tools and environments, such as VS Code, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Cursor, to enhance productivity and automate infrastructure workflows.

**Key Result Areas**

* Accountability for assignments, timely delivery, and meeting or exceeding quality requirements.
* Continuous reduction of operational overhead through automated workflows and AIOps implementation.

**How to Apply:**
Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on one of the Apply buttons located in this posting.

title: DevOps Architect
description:
**We’re Hiring | DevOps Architect – Purple Fabric (Intellect)**

**Job Title:**
DevOps Architect

**Business Unit:**
Purple Fabric (PF)

**Experience:**
12–18 Years

**Job Location:**
Chennai, India

**Work Model:**
On-site

**About Purple Fabric**

Purple Fabric (PF) is Intellect's enterprise AI and decisioning platform, designed to help organizations build, orchestrate, govern, and scale AI-powered solutions. It enables enterprise adoption of Agentic AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven decisioning, with a focus on security, governance, scalability, and operational reliability.

We are looking for an experienced
**DevOps Architect**
to design, build, and optimize the infrastructure and platform engineering capabilities that support Purple Fabric's enterprise AI workloads. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Kubernetes, AWS, cloud-native architecture, CI/CD automation, infrastructure as code, observability, and enterprise platform operations.

**Role Overview**

As a DevOps Architect, you will own the architecture and implementation of scalable, secure, resilient, and automated infrastructure for Purple Fabric. You will work closely with Platform Engineering, AI/ML Engineering, Software Engineering, Security, and Product teams to establish reliable deployment and operational practices across development, testing, and production environments.

The role requires a strong hands-on technical leader who can define platform architecture, establish DevOps standards, troubleshoot complex distributed systems, and drive automation and operational excellence across cloud and on-premises environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Cloud-Native Architecture and Platform Engineering**

* Design and implement scalable, highly available, secure, and resilient cloud-native infrastructure for enterprise applications and AI platforms.
* Architect Kubernetes-based platforms, including cluster design, node management, workload scheduling, networking, storage, ingress, autoscaling, and high availability.
* Define architecture standards for containerized applications, microservices, service discovery, configuration management, and secrets handling.
* Design infrastructure patterns that support multi-environment deployments, workload isolation, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* Evaluate and implement platform engineering practices that improve developer productivity, deployment consistency, and operational reliability.

**2. AWS Cloud Infrastructure**

* Design, implement, and optimize cloud infrastructure on AWS for enterprise-scale applications and platform workloads.
* Work with AWS services such as EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch, Route 53, and load-balancing services, as appropriate to the solution architecture.
* Define cloud networking, security, access control, resource provisioning, and cost-optimization strategies.
* Architect reliable and scalable environments across development, staging, and production.
* Support hybrid and on-premises deployments where required by customer or platform needs.

**3. Kubernetes and Container Orchestration**

* Lead Kubernetes architecture and administration, including cluster provisioning, upgrades, capacity planning, node pools, networking, storage, and resource optimization.
* Establish standards for Docker/container images, Helm charts, Kubernetes manifests, and deployment configurations.
* Implement autoscaling, resource quotas, health checks, service discovery, and workload resilience.
* Troubleshoot complex issues involving pods, nodes, cluster networking, persistent volumes, scheduling, and application performance.
* Define Kubernetes security practices, including RBAC, network policies, secrets management, and container image scanning.

**4. CI/CD and DevOps Automation**

* Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or equivalent platforms.
* Automate build, test, security scanning, packaging, deployment, rollback, and release-management processes.
* Implement GitOps and declarative deployment practices where appropriate.
* Establish standardized deployment strategies, including rolling, blue-green, and canary releases.
* Integrate automated quality checks, vulnerability scanning, and policy enforcement into delivery pipelines.

**5. Infrastructure as Code and Configuration Management**

* Design and implement infrastructure provisioning using Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, or equivalent tools.
* Establish reusable infrastructure modules, version-controlled configurations, and environment-promotion practices.
* Automate infrastructure lifecycle management, configuration drift detection, and repeatable environment provisioning.
* Implement policy-as-code and infrastructure compliance checks where appropriate.
* Improve provisioning speed, consistency, and operational efficiency through automation.

**6. Observability, Reliability, and Performance Engineering**

* Design end-to-end monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and observability frameworks.
* Implement and optimize monitoring solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, CloudWatch, or equivalent technologies.
* Define and monitor service-level indicators, service-level objectives, availability, latency, and error rates.
* Lead root-cause analysis, incident response, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
* Establish disaster recovery, backup, resilience testing, and operational readiness practices.

**7. Security and Enterprise Governance**

* Embed DevSecOps principles throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
* Implement identity and access management, least-privilege access, secrets management, encryption, and secure network architecture.
* Integrate container, dependency, and infrastructure vulnerability scanning into CI/CD pipelines.
* Support auditability, compliance requirements, security reviews, and enterprise deployment standards.
* Collaborate with security teams to establish guardrails for cloud infrastructure and platform operations.

**8. AI Platform and Workload Enablement**

* Build and operate reliable infrastructure to support AI/ML services, LLM-powered applications, agentic workflows, and associated enterprise integrations.
* Collaborate with AI/ML and platform teams to support model-serving services, API gateways, asynchronous workloads, and scalable application deployments.
* Design deployment and operational patterns for AI services, considering resource utilization, scalability, latency, availability, and cost.
* Support secure deployment models for enterprise customers, including isolated environments and private or on-premises deployments where applicable.
* Establish observability and operational practices for AI application services and their supporting infrastructure.

**9. Technical Leadership and Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Define DevOps architecture standards, reference designs, best practices, and technical roadmaps.
* Mentor DevOps and platform engineering teams and provide technical direction for complex infrastructure initiatives.
* Work closely with Engineering, Architecture, Security, QA, Product, and Delivery teams to align platform capabilities with product requirements.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**About Team**
Transactional System provides core transactional systems to enable
  
  
segment and technology partners in creating wonderful omni experiences with speed and leverage. We are a highly motivated group of engineers, working in an agile group to solve sophisticated and high impact problems. This role is part of Cloud Powered Checkout team and will build the next generation multi-tenant, client agnostic, highly scalable, omnichannel checkout solution to seamlessly enable a frictionless customer checkout experience across all sales channels globally. We process millions of orders daily through our high-performance checkout services running in Edge and Cloud.
  
  
As a Site Reliability Engineer in the CPC Team, you will work with L2, Other dependent Applications, Platform team, DevOps and Engineering practitioners to proactively maintain mission-critical infrastructure, cloud platforms, microservices, tools, and processes that will ensure the highest levels of availability and reliability of CPC applications.
  
  
Our team works closely with our US stores and eCommerce business to better serve customers by empowering team members, stores, and merchants with technological innovation. From groceries and entertainment to sporting goods and crafts, Walmart U.S. offers an extensive selection that our customers value, whether they shop online at Walmart.com, through one of our mobile apps, or in-store. Focus areas include customers, stores and employees, in-store service, merchant tools, merchant data science, and search and personalization.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Incident triage, Escalation and Resolution: Triage site-impacting production issues by quantifying impact, severity and urgency, analyzing systems for quick remediation, engaging the right teams for recovery [Reduce MTTE Mean Time to Engage], and focusing on immediate restoration [ Reduce MTTR Mean Time to Restore] of large-scale enterprise systems.
  
  
Alert, Monitoring, Log analysis: Detect and analyze monitoring graphs and alerts to identify systems causing production impacts with various tools like Grafana, Prometheus, MMS, Service Now, JIRA, Dynatrace, Splunk etc [Reduce MTTD Mean Time to Detect].
  
  
Enhance Alerting solutions: Design and implement JavaScript for the integration of alerting tool with service API endpoints with various tools like ServiceNow, Spotlight, Splunk, and xMatters. Requires knowledge of: Monitoring and alerting tools; Monitoring metrics and key performance indicators (for example, availability, MTBF, MTTR); SLIs and SLOs (for example, request latency, availability, error rates, saturation); Distributed tracing; Alerting logic. To demonstrate awareness of the metrics used to monitor software or system performance. Monitors current performance data to ensure adherence to defined SLOs and SLIs for simple applications/systems. Demonstrates awareness of the different types of alerts generated by the monitoring tools. Demonstrates awareness of infrastructure and application metrics.
  
  
Disaster Recovery Planning: Requires knowledge of: Disaster recovery procedures and processes; Enterprise disaster recovery systems. To work with business partners to identify and document critical applications.
  
  
Performance and Optimization : Requires knowledge of: Unix/Linux performance optimization tuning; Java/NodeJS/Tomcat/Apache tuning and optimization; Chaos tools to utilize established criteria (for example, probability of failure, frequency of failure) to measure site reliability. Monitors site reliability conditions and new reliability requirements.
  
  
Work on Product Enrichment ; Content Services projects at Walmart: Develop enterprise monitoring and utilize tooling software solutions such as Grafana, Splunk etc, to improve visibility, pro-actively detect issues and restore system availability.
  
  
Develop Tools and support: Design and develop solutions for widespread internal communications for cloud applications support or workflows for infrastructure availability issues with various internal applications with multiple programming languages like Java, JavaScript (React, Node JS), Python and Shell programming technologies like Prometheus, Database Query languages. Design and develop a UI tool to display Item Content Quality data on a dashboard using AngularJS, ReactJs, HTML5 ; CSS3 etc
  
  
To create and maintain Playbooks.
  
  
Steps to perform correct analysis on the issues and engage correct teams for CPC, Dependent downstream services and Platform teams.
  
  
To handle Deployments. Streamline the deployments process and handle the responsibility as a single team. Understand and explore Post validations and back out steps to make app more resilient.
  
  
Coordinate with platform teams for non-app releases like VM upgrades, DB Maintenance, and other component environment related tasks.
  
  
Participate in rotating on-call duties and work across different time zone with a multi-national team
  
  
Responsible for timely root cause analysis [RCA] of production issues.
  
  
Develop reusable tooling and processes to drive and improve customer experience and lower operational costs.
  
  
Understand DevOps Industry best practices
  
  
Help teams to build highly Observable and Resilient systems
  
  
Collaborate with developers to capture requirements and understanding pain points
  
  
Build reusable tools, library, dashboards which can be used across DevOps/SRE teams
  
  
**What You'll Bring**
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline
  
  
5+ years of hands-on related to Site Reliability Engineer, Operations ; Development experience with Java Script, Java, Restful services, Git, Maven, Jenkins, DevOps, Containerization, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure, Google cloud, Kafka, Azure Cosmos, Azure SQL, Mega cache CI/CD ,Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk etc.
  
  
Automation and Self-healing: Demonstrate knowledge of scripting and software development for automation and self-healing of multi-cloud environments. Help enhance existing solutions by developing automation with Docker, Kubernetes and working with DevOps and Engineering partners.
  
  
Excellent end to end technical understanding of core infrastructure, cloud services, platforms, and micro-services.
  
  
Ability to effectively triage be able to detect and determine symptom vs cause.
  
  
Identify and drive continuous improvement efforts to reduce waste (eliminate, automate or streamline).
  
  
Influence the design of system architecture and tactical solutions.
  
  
Familiar with log centric tooling. Produce time series data and reusable dashboards for use both during and post event.
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, pto, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging

By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
  
  
Equal opportunity employer

That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.
