title: Director / Vice President – SaaS Production Operations, SRE & Security
description:
Director / Vice President – SaaS Production Operations, SRE & Security

**Location:**
Chennai, India (relocation support available)

**Experience:**
15+ years

**Leadership Scope:**
Production Operations, Cloud Infrastructure, SRE, DevSecOps, Security Engineering and ISMS

Role Overview

We are seeking a senior technology leader to own end-to-end production operations, reliability engineering, cloud infrastructure and security engineering for a business-critical, customer-facing SaaS platform.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring proven experience running live SaaS production environments, managing 24×7 operations, meeting customer SLAs, leading major incidents and building proactive security engineering capabilities.

The successful candidate will lead an established Cloud Operations and Information Security Management System (ISMS) organization, strengthen its technical capabilities and drive measurable improvements in reliability, security, automation and operational efficiency.

We are looking for a proven production operations leader—not someone whose experience is limited to enterprise IT infrastructure, architecture, product development or compliance management.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. SaaS Production Operations & Reliability

* Own end-to-end operational reliability, availability, performance and support for customer-facing SaaS platforms.
* Lead 24×7 application monitoring, production support, on-call operations, escalation management and customer SLA adherence.
* Establish and manage SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, observability and reliability improvement programs.
* Personally lead critical production incidents, coordinate technical response, conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and drive preventive actions.
* Improve incident frequency, Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR), change success rates and production stability.
* Establish effective capacity planning, performance optimization, release safety and operational readiness practices.

2. Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering

* Own cloud architecture, provisioning, infrastructure operations and platform resilience.
* Manage cloud environments across OCI, AWS, Azure or GCP, with OCI experience preferred.
* Oversee Kubernetes, virtual machines, microservices infrastructure, cloud networking and databases.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC), policy as code, configuration automation and standardized provisioning.
* Own disaster recovery, backup and restoration testing, business continuity and infrastructure cost optimization through FinOps.

3. Security Engineering & Proactive Risk Prevention

* Lead hands-on security engineering across IAM, privileged access, secrets management, API authorization and multi-tenant isolation.
* Establish continuous vulnerability identification, risk prioritization, remediation SLAs and security verification.
* Drive cloud security posture management, security monitoring, threat detection and security incident response.
* Own penetration-testing programs and ensure identified vulnerabilities are remediated within defined timelines.
* Embed security controls into production operations and software delivery rather than relying solely on periodic audits.

4. DevSecOps & Secure Delivery

* Partner with software Engineering to integrate automated security controls into CI/CD pipelines.
* Implement SAST, DAST, SCA, secret scanning, container security and Infrastructure as Code scanning.
* Establish security gates, remediation SLAs, exception management and measurable security engineering outcomes.
* Enable secure and efficient releases without introducing unnecessary manual bottlenecks.

5. ISMS, Compliance & Customer Assurance

* Lead operational implementation of ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018 and SOC 2 controls.
* Ensure controls are continuously enforced and validated across production systems.
* Manage customer security assessments, audit readiness, risk registers and corrective actions.
* Build an integrated operating model where security engineering and compliance work together, with technical risk reduction as the priority.

6. Automation & AI-Driven Operations

* Drive AIOps adoption for anomaly detection, event correlation, predictive monitoring and incident response automation.
* Reduce manual operational effort through scripting, workflow automation and intelligent monitoring.
* Establish production security controls for AI agents, including identity, tool authorization, execution isolation, audit trails and human approval for high-risk actions.

7. Organization Leadership & Transformation

* Lead and develop the existing Cloud Operations, SRE and ISMS organization, including managers and senior technical leaders.
* Establish clear ownership, operational KPIs, escalation structures and accountability across teams.
* Identify capability gaps, recruit critical talent and develop a technically strong leadership pipeline.
* Drive operational transformation through automation, engineering discipline, measurable service improvements and continuous learning.
* Report production reliability, security exposure, major incidents, remediation progress and infrastructure efficiency to executive leadership.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* 15+ years of overall technology experience, with substantial experience in production operations, SRE, cloud infrastructure or security engineering leadership.
* Proven leadership of a customer-facing SaaS product or platform in a live production environment.
* Direct accountability for 24×7 application monitoring, customer SLAs, production reliability and major incident management.
* Demonstrated experience personally leading critical production incidents and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
* Strong technical leadership experience managing managers, senior engineers and multi-disciplinary teams.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major cloud platform: OCI, AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes, microservices, networking, databases, infrastructure automation and disaster recovery.
* Practical security engineering experience covering IAM, secrets management, API authorization, vulnerability management and security incident response.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps controls and automated security testing within CI/CD pipelines.
* Demonstrated success in improving an existing organization's processes, reliability, security posture and operational performance.

Preferred Experience

* Multi-tenant SaaS products in insurance, fintech, financial services or other regulated industries.
* OCI architecture and operations.
* ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018 and SOC 2 control implementation in production environments.
* AIOps implementation and AI-agent security in production.
* Experience scaling engineering organizations and driving operational transformation.

First-Year Success Measures

**First 90 days**

* Establish baseline reliability, incident, security and cloud cost metrics.
* Identify operational and security risks, with clear owners and remediation timelines.
* Deliver a prioritized 12-month transformation roadmap.

**Within 12 months**

* Demonstrate measurable improvements in production incident frequency, MTTR, vulnerability exposure time and cloud cost efficiency.
* Establish automated security gates and tenant-isolation testing.
* Complete a successful disaster recovery test.
* Strengthen operational ownership, incident prevention, security automation and team effectiveness.

**Candidate Application Requirements**

Please provide specific examples demonstrating:

1. A major production incident you personally led on a customer-facing SaaS platform, including business impact, your role and corrective actions.
2. A security engineering initiative or security incident you led, including tools used, vulnerabilities addressed and remediation timelines.
3. Your current leadership structure, including direct reports, managers reporting to you, total team size and budget responsibility.
4. Whether your production platform was a product sold to customers or a service delivered to a client.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss measurable outcomes and their personal accountability for production reliability and security.

**Ideal candidate:**
A senior production operator who combines strong technical depth, executive leadership, customer-facing SaaS operations ownership, SRE, proactive security engineering and organizational transformation experience.

description:

* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
The Enterprise Test Engineering ("ETE") family is responsible for ensuring that all applications and systems meet defined quality standards. The ETE family encompasses three major areas including (a) functional testing, (b) non-functional testing, and (c) test architecture and enablement. Other key focuses include: regression testing, browser testing, performance testing, capacity and stress testing, resiliency testing, environment management services, and infrastructure testing. Develops, conducts, and evaluates testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. The Resiliency Test Engineering role is responsible for the validation of non-functional requirements for resiliency testing.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**

* Deepen understanding of the DTCC Software Delivery Process and proactively identify opportunities for improvement within assigned responsibilities.
* Execute performance test scenarios based on user stories, requirements, and application architecture.
* Develop, maintain, and enhance performance test scripts using Apache JMeter and other automation frameworks.
* Design and implement test automation solutions to support performance, scalability, and resiliency validation.
* Create and maintain Jenkins CI/CD pipelines to automate performance test execution, reporting, and continuous validation.
* Develop and maintain Groovy-based Jenkins pipeline scripts for test orchestration and automation workflows.
* Execute and manage performance tests using BlazeMeter, including test scheduling, execution, analysis, and reporting.
* Analyze test results, identify performance bottlenecks, and provide actionable recommendations to development and engineering teams.
* Track execution of performance test scenarios and communicate findings, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Build knowledge of Delivery Pipeline components and recommend enhancements to improve automation, efficiency, and reliability.
* Develop a strong understanding of the products, applications, and business processes being delivered.
* Follow DTCC performance engineering standards, policies, and procedures in day-to-day activities.
* Demonstrate strong technical ability to develop scripts, write code, and automate testing processes.
* Align risk and control processes with daily responsibilities to monitor, mitigate, and appropriately escalate risk.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in Performance Engineering, Test Automation, Software Development, or a related field.
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience developing and executing performance tests using Apache JMeter.
* Experience using BlazeMeter for performance test management, execution, reporting, and analysis.
* Experience building and maintaining Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience developing automation solutions using Groovy scripting.
* Strong programming experience in Java and object-oriented design principles.
* Experience with Python for automation, test engineering, scripting, and data processing.
* Familiarity with source control tools such as Git/Bitbucket.
* Understanding of Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, and Continuous Testing practices.

Talents Needed for Success
  
  

* Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively within and across teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to review deliverables and ensure quality, accuracy, and adherence to standards.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with Java development, including APIs, multithreading, Spring Boot, and enterprise application frameworks.
* Experience developing and maintaining Groovy scripts for Jenkins pipeline automation.
* Experience integrating JMeter and BlazeMeter within CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with Python development for automation and tooling.
* Experience with React development, including building and maintaining modern web-based applications and dashboards.
* Ability to troubleshoot application and performance issues using logs, metrics, and monitoring tools.
* Understanding of performance engineering concepts including: - Load Testing
* Stress Testing
* Endurance/Soak Testing
* Scalability Testing
* Capacity Planning
* Performance Tuning
* Bottleneck Analysis

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience working with enterprise-scale distributed systems and cloud-based applications.
* Knowledge of observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or similar platforms.
* Experience supporting high-volume transactional applications in financial services environments.
* Familiarity with resiliency testing, failure mode analysis, and non-functional requirements (NFR) validation

title: Development Engineer 3
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.
  
  
**Job Summary**
About Comcast Next Generation Access Networks (NGAN) NGAN (Next Gen Access Networks) is a group within Headquarters at Comcast that partners with all three divisional Engineering & Technical Operations teams to drive expansion, new technologies and continuous improvement into the ‘last mile’ of the network.
  
  
**Job Description**
Job Description
  
  
Are you passionate about digital media, entertainment, and access technologies? Do you like big challenges and working within a highly motivated team environment?
  
  
The Next Gen Access Technologies team is a small and fast-moving team of world-class experts who are innovating in end-to-end IP services delivery. As a senior integration engineer on the next gen access team, you will design and develop software orchestration solutions used in our new product testing lab to verify the technology that will enable next generation services to our customers. We are a team that thrives on big challenges, results, quality, and agility.
  
  
**Who does the Next Gen Access Technologies team work with?**
The team manages new technology development and deployment programs that require coordination across multiple teams. There is a strong, collaborative relationship between Next Gen Access, developers, vendors, QA engineers, deployment and operations teams as partners in the delivery of quality systems and services. We work at all levels of the organization to plan and deliver new services and service capabilities.
  
  
**What are some interesting problems you’ll be working on?**
In this role, you will be part of a team that is responsible for the development of automated software suites that validate Comcast’s next generation access network capabilities in an R&D test lab environment. You will automate time-consuming manual test processes by orchestrating data flows from a variety of systems to build a “big picture” of the system state as it progresses though operational modes. In addition, you will work with the system engineers on developing applications for debugging and monitoring live systems in the field.
  
  
**Where can you make an impact?**
You’ll be working with the best and brightest minds in Comcast to verify the access networks infrastructure and products that will power the next generation of services. Success in this role is characterized by a higher speed to market as well as fewer customer-facing defects and outages of equipment and services that delight and entertain our customers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop solutions to convert manual data-gathering processes across multiple systems and devices to fully automated, reliable software tools
* Develop tools to integrate parallel data streams from a variety of APIs, tools, logs, and systems into a cohesive unit using a variety of technologies.
* Develop tools to orchestrate device interactions on multiple systems.
* Develop tools to assist the system engineers in debugging and monitoring systems in the field.
* Work collaboratively on a small development team.
* Be available for live meetings with USA-based team members, usually in the evening, local time.
* Participate with fellow team members and the test leads during the automation design phase.
* Support the lab test team in the execution of automated tools you develop.

**Skills & Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering or equivalent work experience.
* 6-8 years of software development.
* Strong preference for experience with business process automation, EIA, and other software orchestration technologies and Python based automation frameworks.
* Strong preference for experience with asynchronous programming
* Experience with front-end system development like React
* Experience with regular expressions and predictive text data processing
* Experience with cable network architecture, specification, engineering, validation a plus.
* Experience with AI Agent, Skill, MCP is a plus
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Keen attention to detail and high level of commitment.

Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.
  
  
Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best-in-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality - to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details.
  
  
**Education**
Bachelor's Degree
  
  
While possessing the stated degree is preferred, Comcast also may consider applicants who hold some combination of coursework and experience, or who have extensive related professional experience.
  
  
**Relevant Work Experience**
5-7 Years

title: Hybrid Infrastructure Architect & Governance Lead
description:
**Opportunities Without Borders**
*At Fuller Technologies, we believe great ideas know no boundaries. For over 140 years, we’ve led the way in innovation, creating solutions that make the cement industry cleaner, smarter, and more efficient. Here, you’ll work on projects that span continents, collaborate across cultures, and gain experiences that expand your horizons. Join us, and take your career to new heights—on a global scale.*
**About The Role**
The Hybrid Infrastructure Architect & Governance Lead provides strategic leadership, governance, architecture, and Level 3 / Level 4 technical support across the organization's hybrid infrastructure landscape, including Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), VMware, and on-premises datacenter environments.
  
  
The role ensures that cloud and on-premises infrastructure are secure, resilient, scalable, and cost-effective while driving governance, architecture, cloud financial management (FinOps), security, and infrastructure modernization initiatives. The position works closely with Infrastructure & Operations, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Application teams, and managed service providers to define technology standards, oversee solution architecture, optimize operational performance, and ensure alignment with business objectives.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities :**

* Define and maintain enterprise infrastructure governance, architecture standards, policies, and best practices across Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), VMware, and on-premises environments.
* Design and approve secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-effective infrastructure solutions for new and existing workloads.
* Establish and govern Azure Landing Zones, management groups, subscriptions, Azure Policy, RBAC, and enterprise cloud operating standards.
* Develop OCI governance frameworks and review architecture designs across networking, compute, storage, IAM, security, high availability, and disaster recovery.
* Own the architecture and technical governance of VMware, VxRail, Hyper-V, and core datacenter platforms.
* Define standards for virtualization, compute, storage, networking, backup, monitoring, and disaster recovery.
* Lead datacenter modernization, hardware refresh, capacity planning, performance management, and infrastructure lifecycle roadmaps.
* Provide Level 3/Level 4 technical escalation support for complex cloud, OCI, and datacenter infrastructure incidents.
* Coordinate with Microsoft, Oracle, VMware, managed service providers, and other vendors during critical technical incidents and service issues.
* Lead cloud FinOps initiatives across Azure and OCI, including cost visibility, forecasting, budgeting, rightsizing, tagging, reserved capacity, and showback/chargeback models.
* Build and maintain reporting dashboards to monitor cloud consumption, financial performance, capacity, and optimization opportunities.
* Define and govern enterprise cloud security architecture aligned with Zero Trust principles.
* Oversee security services including Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Entra ID, Defender for Cloud, and OCI security capabilities.
* Govern identity and access management, privileged access, MFA, conditional access, endpoint security, vulnerability remediation, and cloud security posture.
* Partner with Security Operations, Finance, application teams, and business stakeholders to improve security, operational resilience, and cost efficiency.
* Lead Architecture Review Board discussions and maintain enterprise reference architectures and technical documentation.
* Review managed service provider deliverables to ensure compliance with architecture, security, operational, and documentation standards.
* Drive automation, infrastructure-as-code, operational standardization, and continuous improvement across cloud and on-premises platforms.
* Ensure all infrastructure services meet enterprise security, compliance, business continuity, disaster recovery, and audit requirements.

**You bring**
**Technical Skills**

* Cloud Platforms: Microsoft Azure
* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
* Virtualization & Datacenter: VMware vSphere
* VMware vCenter
* VMware ESXi
* Dell VxRail
* Hyper-V
* SAN / NAS Storage
* Backup & Recovery Platforms
* Disaster Recovery Solutions
* Infrastructure: Windows Server
* Linux
* Active Directory
* Microsoft Entra ID
* DNS / DHCP
* Enterprise Networking
* Load Balancers
* Firewalls
* Security: Microsoft Defender Suite
* Microsoft Sentinel
* Azure Policy
* Defender for Cloud
* Endpoint Security
* Vulnerability Management
* Zero Trust Architecture
* Identity & Access Management
* FinOps: Azure Cost Management
* OCI Cost Analysis
* Cost Optimization
* Budget Forecasting
* Chargeback / Showback
* Resource Tagging
* Automation: PowerShell
* Terraform
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* Azure Automation
* Scripting
* 18+ years of Infrastructure and Cloud experience.
* 10+ years designing enterprise Azure environments.
* 10+ years working with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
* Strong VMware and enterprise datacenter architecture experience.
* Experience designing hybrid cloud solutions.
* Strong background in cloud governance, infrastructure governance, and security.
* Experience leading managed service providers and global infrastructure operations.

*As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.*
**Application and contact**
Please apply by clicking “apply” on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews - also on a virtual setting as required - on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible.
  
  
No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please.
  
  
**Build a better world**
Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to driving growth while minimising environmental impact. To achieve this, your skills, your curiosity, and your drive for change are important. Together in our diverse team, we collaborate in an inclusive and supportive environment to discover further ways to economic and environmental success.
  
  
For further information on Fuller Technologies' business and services, visit https://www.fuller-technologies.com/

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-TS-Hybrid Infra
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Job Description – AI and Hybrid Infrastructure Strategy (Sr. Consultant)**
**At Deloitte Strategy & Transactions (S&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth**
**Within S&T, the AI and Hybrid Infrastructure strategy capability plays a critical role in shaping how organizations modernize their core technology foundations to enable digital, cloud, and AI-led transformation. As a Strategy professional in this space, you will help clients define their enterprise-wide AI and hybrid infrastructure strategy, help them make sense of their AI consumption economics, identify value creation and cost optimization opportunities, and design future-ready operating models that bridge business ambition with technical reality.**
**But we don’t stop at client impact, we are equally passionate about investing in our people. You’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.**
**If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact, and where your growth matters as much as your clients’, AI and Hybrid Infrastructure Strategy is your next move.**
**The Team**
The AI and Hybrid Infrastructure team sits at the core of Deloitte’s technology-enabled transformation agenda. We advise clients on where and how to modernize their infrastructure landscape — spanning data centers, hybrid and multi-cloud platforms, networks, and AI-enabled infrastructure — to support business growth, resilience, and innovation.
  
  
Our work is strategy-led and outcome-oriented, focused on helping executives make clear, data-driven decisions on topics such as:
  
  

* AI Infrastructure strategy
* AI Economics / Tokenomics strategy
* Hybrid Cloud strategy
* Enterprise Infrastructure and platform enablement
* Legacy modernization and technical debt reduction
* Cost optimization, resilience, and scalability
* Technology operating model and governance design
* AI / Hybrid Cloud sourcing strategies

Strategy professionals in this team act as trusted advisors to CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and business leaders, translating complex business problems into actionable technology choices. We are looking for Consultants and Senior Consultants who combine strong analytical thinking with a solid understanding of modern infrastructure and AI ecosystems.
  
  
**Work You Will Do**
As part of the AI and Hybrid Infrastructure Strategy team, you will work with clients to shape and execute their AI infrastructure and platform strategies across hybrid environments (Cloud. On-premise, Edge) ensuring alignment with broader business and digital transformation goals.
  
  
Your responsibilities will include supporting enterprise infrastructure and AI platform strategies (including hybrid and multi-cloud adoption roadmaps, investment prioritization, and value realization cases), advising clients on high-level AI-ready infrastructure architectures, designing target-state technology operating models, compute and token consumption strategies, including trade-offs between cost, performance, scalability and conducting strategic assessment and diagnostics across infrastructure, AI platforms and MLOps. This role provides exposure to complex, high-visibility transformation programs and enables you to build deep expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and enterprise infrastructure in a client-facing consulting environment.
  
  
**Required Experience And Skills**

* Ability to translate complex infrastructure and AI architecture concepts into clear business value narratives for executive and non-technical stakeholders
* Strong understanding of how infrastructure, cloud, data and AI investments drive growth, cost efficiency, risk reduction, and operational resilience
* Ability to articulate emerging trends, best practices, and strategic implications of AI infrastructure and hybrid cloud adoption across industries
* Infrastructure, Cloud and AI domain knowledge:
* Foundational understanding of enterprise infrastructure concepts, including compute, storage, networking, and hybrid / multi-cloud architectures
* Understanding of AI/ML lifecycle (training, fine-tuning, inference) and concepts such as tokens, RAG, LLMs, Vector Databases etc.
* Understanding of cost drivers in AI and infrastructure (e.g., compute, storage, token usage, cloud consumption models) and ability to support cost-benefit analysis and TCO evaluations
* Familiarity with AI/ML workloads, platforms, frameworks, ecosystems (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, NVIDIA AI platforms) and their infrastructure implications
* Understanding of key compliance, security, and regulatory standards relevant to Infrastructure and AI environments (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST CSF)
* Architecture & Transformation Experience: Candidates are required to have at least one full project experience in either one or more of the following areas:
* AI or cloud infrastructure strategy, architecture, or large-scale transformation initiatives
* Design or assessment of AI/ML platforms, MLOps workflows, or AI-ready infrastructure environments
* Infrastructure modernization, cost optimization, or operating model transformation programs
* AI Economics and optimization
* Exposure to integrating compute, networking, and storage capabilities to support scalable AI or cloud workloads, with an emphasis on architectural decision-making rather than hands-on operations
* Experience supporting ecosystem-driven solutions and working with technology partners to shape solution options and recommendations
* Ability to support benchmarking, performance assessments, and business case development to inform infrastructure and AI investment decisions
* Experience defining target operating models (TOMs), roadmaps, governance frameworks, and process designs
* Exposure to security, governance, and compliance considerations across infrastructure and AI stacks
* Interest in contributing to internal knowledge development, POVs, or client thought leadership as part of broader practice growth
* Exposure to working with non-India Geographies (preferably the US) and / or interacting with Global stakeholders

**Core Consulting Skills**

* Clear and concise communication - conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members
* Analytical thinking - ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data
* Logical structuring - structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems
* Deadline-oriented and quality focused - develop and own development of deliverables. Own and manage specific work-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources
* Collaboration - Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate
* Network - ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant STEM Field (ex. Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics) from a premier school in India or abroad
* MBA, MS, M. Tech. from a premier school in India or abroad, with a background in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, etc.
* 4+ years (for Senior Consultants) of relevant experience in in roles involving technology strategy, enterprise architecture, digital transformation, or large-scale infrastructure and cloud initiatives
* Relevant certifications in hybrid cloud/AI infrastructure space would be nice to have (e.g., TOGAF, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, CISM, CISSP, CEH)

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Engr IV-Security Engrg
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
You’ll be finding the right technology to help ensure our enterprise identity systems remain secure and spot risks before they become real threats. You’ll manage, maintain, and enhance our enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) infrastructure, protecting systems, defending access points, and safeguarding our business, brand, and bottom line.

* Executing SRE operations including automated server patching (OS, JDK, Java), continuous alert monitoring, incident remediation, and maintaining high-availability standards.
* Driving security posture and vulnerability management through Tenable vulnerability scans, SAST (Fortify), DAST, OSS library scanning, and AI-driven penetration testing.
* Designing and deploying authentication modules using Python, Java, Angular, and Spring Boot to support Zero Trust requirements, advanced MFA, and risk-based authentication workflows.

* Supporting key IAM initiatives including Zero Trust application migrations, Passkey adoption, and authentication resiliency.
* Integrating SSO applications and troubleshooting complex authentication and identity issues to maintain seamless access and high availability.

**What We’re Looking For...**
You’re driven to pinpoint a problem and tenacious about finding a solution. You’re organized and pay attention to details. You are the person that others rely on. You are accountable and follow through with a sense of urgency.
  
  
**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
* Four or more years of relevant work experience in Security Engineering, IAM Infrastructure, or Single Sign-On (SSO) technologies.
* Experience with enterprise identity Access platforms, vulnerability remediation, and SRE operations.

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* A degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or Engineering.
* Strong experience with security risk procedures, security patterns, authentication technologies (PingAccess, Ping Identity Gateway, SiteMinder), and Zero Trust frameworks.
* Hands-on development experience with Python, Java, Angular, and Spring Boot for custom authentication workflows.
* Experience with automated vulnerability scanning tools (Tenable, Fortify, DAST, OSS scanning) and pen testing.
* Knowledge of or experience with AI-assisted development and automation tools (Claude, Gemini etc.).
* Certifications in security, network, or architecture (e.g., CISSP, CEH, Security+).

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every "even better" qualification listed above.
  
  
Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Senior Engineer II - SRE (AI-First)
description:
**What is Contentstack?**
Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.
  
  
While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.
  
  
Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.
  
  
Learn more at www.contentstack.com.
  
  
**Who Are We?**
At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let's go!
  
  
**What you will be working on**

* **Reliability of a multi-tenant platform under growth:**
  Defining SLIs and SLOs for the services in your area, instrumenting them honestly, and having the error-budget conversation when one is at risk.
* **Making releases boring:**
  Progressive delivery through Argo CD — canary and blue/green, automated verification, fast rollback — so a bad change is contained in minutes rather than escalated.
* **Release management at pace:**
  Coordinating what ships and when across [N] services, with change gates that catch problems without becoming a queue.
* **Helm as a product, not a pile of charts:**
  Reusable, tested, versioned charts that other teams can depend on.
* **Incident response and what happens after:**
  Leading incidents on the platform, then writing the postmortem and landing the follow-up work — the part most teams skip.
* **Removing toil rather than absorbing it:**
  Every recurring manual task is a candidate for automation in Python, Bash, or Ansible, and you'll have the time budget to actually do it.
* **Deciding what AI should and shouldn't touch in our delivery path:**
  Reviewing AI-authored Helm and pipeline code before it reaches production, keeping secrets and customer data out of agent context, scoping the credentials our CI agents hold.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* **Service level management:**
  Define and operate SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for platform services; make reliability legible to engineering and product; drive the follow-through when budgets are burned.
* **Production on-call and incident response:**
  Hold primary on-call, act as incident commander, and run blameless postmortems with tracked actions. Escalate cleanly to Infra SecOps where infrastructure or credential changes are required. Use AI-assisted analysis to improve triage, root-cause identification, anomaly detection, and MTTR.
* **Observability:**
  Build and maintain the instrumentation, SLO monitors, and dashboards in Datadog that make failure visible before customers see it; reduce alert noise as deliberately as you add alerts.
* **CI/CD engineering:**
  Design, operate, and optimise build and deployment pipelines — caching, parallel execution, automated testing, security scanning, deployment verification. Manage artifacts and dependencies in the Artifactory.
* **Release management and progressive delivery:**
  Own the release process end-to-end; implement GitOps with Argo CD including canary and blue/green rollouts, automated validation, and rollback; run change management so that shipping is routine rather than an event.
* **Helm and deployment configuration:**
  Build and maintain production-grade Helm charts and libraries with testing, versioning, policy validation, and reusable standards across services.
* **Kubernetes day-2 operations:**
  Operate and troubleshoot production Kubernetes — scheduling, autoscaling, resource management, add-on lifecycle, workload networking — at a depth that holds up at 3am. Cluster provisioning sits with Infra SecOps; you'll partner with them on upgrades and capacity changes.
* **Toil reduction and automation:**
  Identify and eliminate recurring operational work with automation in Python, Bash, and Ansible.
* **Capacity and resilience:**
  Workload-level capacity planning and resource tuning, resilience and failover testing, and feeding infrastructure capacity requirements into Infra SecOps ahead of need.
* **AI guardrails and review:**
  Define how AI-generated deployment and pipeline code is reviewed before it reaches production, keep secrets and customer data out of prompts and agent context, scope CI agent credentials to least privilege, and maintain provenance for generated code.
* **Cross-team partnership:**
  Review and raise pull requests against Infra SecOps' Terraform where platform changes are needed, and keep the interface between the two teams working.
* **Technical leadership:**
  Contribute to design and architecture reviews, mentor engineers, and raise the bar on availability, deployment speed, and developer experience.

**Mandatory Skills**

* **Production on-call ownership:**
  You've held the pager for a SaaS platform, led incidents end-to-end, and written the postmortems.
* **SLO practice, not SLO vocabulary:**
  You've defined SLIs and SLOs for real services and can describe a decision and an error budget changed.
* **Kubernetes in production:**
  Deep, hands-on day-2 operation and troubleshooting of EKS — scheduling, autoscaling, resource management, add-ons — not just deploying onto it.
* **Helm depth:**
  You've written charts and libraries that other teams depend on, with tests and CI behind them.
* **CI/CD engineering:**
  You've built and owned pipelines at scale, not just consumed them — and you can talk about what you did to make them fast and trustworthy.
* **Release engineering judgement:**
  Practical experience with progressive delivery and rollback — Argo CD, Flux, or equivalent.
* **Observability:**
  Hands-on with Datadog or equivalent — you've built the monitors and dashboards, not just read them.
* **Systems fundamentals:**
  Strong Linux, load balancing, and application clustering; you can debug from logs, stack traces, and core dumps.
* **Demonstrated AI-assisted workflow:**
  Show us something you built — an agent or MCP integration, a prompt/context library your team uses, an AI-assisted review or incident workflow — and tell us where you decided not to use it.
* **Works well across a boundary:**
  You've operated in a model where some remediation needs another team, and you know how to make that fast rather than resentful.

**What Do We Offer?**
**Interesting Work |**
We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the "challenge yourself" role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you're doing it.
  
  
**Tribe Vibe**
| We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict "no a\*\*hole policy" and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.
  
  
**Bragging Rights**
| We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!
  
  
**One Team One Dream**
| This is one of our values, and it shows. We don't believe in artificial hierarchies. If you're part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it's a great time to be joining…

As a leader in Senior/Lead Devops Engineer, you will lead a team focused on delivering automation and DevOps solutions and implementations in customer NW for 4G and 5G product portfolio for different Business Cases.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Rollout automation in customer environment

**You will bring**
Work with the development teams to design scalable, robust systems using cloud native architectural principles.
  
  

* Git, GitLab Azure DevOps GitHub Ansible,Puppet/Chef, Cloudflare , SonarQube (SAST) Docker Artifactory, OSs and Enterprise Environments, Ubuntu 20.04/22.04-RHEL 7/8 Kubernetes, Python /Shell Scripting json/yaml.!
* Project management and methodologies
* Scrum, Agile and DevOps ways of working (Preferred)
* Experience with public cloud platforms i.e. Azure, AWS, GCP
* Expertise in DevOps pipeline orchestration and automation
* Experience with common software development tools, such as- Source Code Management, Configuration Management, Security and Compliance, Registries and Artifact Repos, OSs and Enterprise Environments, Desired Programming languages, Monitoring Tools.
* Build automation using industry standard tools to deploy hundreds of different services.
* Outstanding collaboration, communication, and innovation skills!
* Develop, manage and maintain automation assets of the Service Delivery Global DevOps Platform
* Develop automation to manage platform infrastructure, applications, and services.
* Continuous improvement of Platform reliability, quality, uptime, and Customer Satisfaction
* Provide primary operational support, lifecycle management, and engineering Platform systems and services.

title: Associate Technical Lead, DevSecOps
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Required Skills & Experience**
▪ 4–5 years of experience in DevSecOps, Application Security, Security Engineering, or related roles, with at least 2+ years in a lead or senior technical role.
  
  
▪ Proven experience leading and mentoring security or DevOps engineering teams.
  
  
▪ Expert-level hands-on experience with Checkmarx One (SAST) or equivalent enterprise SAST platforms.
  
  
▪ Deep experience with DAST tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, or commercial alternatives.
  
  
▪ Extensive experience architecting and integrating security tools into Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions at enterprise scale.
  
  
▪ Strong expertise in container security, Kubernetes security, and API security.
  
  
▪ Hands-on experience designing and implementing secrets management solutions (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault).
  
  
▪ Expert understanding of Secure SDLC, OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25, and enterprise vulnerability management practices.
  
  
▪ Deep experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native security controls.
  
  
▪ Advanced Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, or Ansible.
  
  
▪ Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and service mesh technologies.
  
  
▪ Proficiency with observability and monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk).
  
  
▪ Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, Go, or PowerShell.
  
  
▪ Experience driving security initiatives in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments.
  
  
▪ Experience with threat modeling and secure architecture reviews.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
▪ Master’s degree with 4–5 years of relevant experience, or Bachelor’s degree with 6–8 years of experience.
  
  
▪ Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, GWAPT, GWEB, or cloud security specialty certifications (AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer).
  
  
▪ Cloud or DevOps certifications (CKS, CKA, AWS DevOps Professional, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert).
  
  
▪ Experience with container and API security platforms (Aqua, Prisma Cloud, Sysdig, Snyk).
  
  
▪ Experience with SIEM platforms (Splunk, Sentinel, Chronicle) and security orchestration (SOAR).
  
  
▪ Experience with zero trust architecture and identity-based security models.
  
  
▪ Background in penetration testing or red team activities.
  
  
▪ Experience presenting to and influencing executive leadership on security strategy and risk.
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
▪ Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence and drive change across teams and organizational boundaries.
  
  
▪ Excellent strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  
  
▪ Outstanding communication skills with the ability to articulate complex security concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
▪ Proven ability to mentor and develop talent.
  
  
▪ Collaborative mindset with experience working in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
  
  
▪ Ownership mentality with a focus on quality, security, and continuous improvement.
  
  
▪ Ability to balance security requirements with business objectives and delivery timelines.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

title: DevOps Engineer - Fresher
description:
**Job Description**
Job Description
  
  
DevOps Engineer – Fresher
  
  
**Company:**
Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited
  
  
**Department:**
Infrastructure & DevOps
  
  
**Experience:**
Fresher
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  

* Role Overview

We are looking for a
**responsible, technically curious, and self-motivated DevOps Engineer**
who is interested in building practical expertise in Linux, Docker, CI/CD, server management, deployment automation, infrastructure security, monitoring, and backup management.
  
  
GwayERP is growing rapidly, and we are strengthening our infrastructure and deployment processes to support an increasing number of ERP implementations and frequent application releases.
  
  
The selected candidate will work closely with the development, QA, and technical teams to maintain existing environments, improve infrastructure reliability, automate repetitive activities, strengthen security, maintain documentation, and contribute to building a scalable deployment ecosystem.
  
  
This role provides an opportunity to work with real development environments, local servers, Docker-based applications, Jenkins pipelines, MongoDB, and customer deployment infrastructure.
  
  
You are not expected to know every technology from day one. However, you should have a strong foundation in IT, an interest in DevOps, and the willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies and apply them to real-world problems.
  
  
****The Mindset We Expect:****
"If I don't know the solution, I will research it, learn the fundamentals, test it safely, implement it correctly, and document what I have learned."
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Environment Management

Assist in maintaining the different application environments used by GwayERP, including:
  
  

* Development
* Testing / QA
* Staging
* Trial / Demo
* Production / Client environments

**Responsibilities Include:**

* Checking server and application availability.
* Monitoring server health.
* Managing application services and Docker containers.
* Maintaining environment configurations.
* Supporting developers with environment-related issues.
* Identifying configuration inconsistencies.
* Following established environment management procedures.
* Maintaining environment documentation.

The candidate will learn how to maintain consistent and reliable environments for application development, testing, and deployment.
  
  

* Linux & Local Server Administration

Work hands-on with Linux and Ubuntu servers used for application development and infrastructure.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Basic Ubuntu/Linux server administration.
* User and permission management.
* SSH configuration and access management.
* Monitoring CPU, RAM, and disk usage.
* Checking storage health and available space.
* Basic network configuration.
* Understanding firewall rules.
* Managing system services.
* Analysing system logs.
* Supporting system updates and security patches.
* Troubleshooting common server issues.

The candidate should progressively develop the ability to investigate and resolve Linux administration problems independently.
  
  

* Docker & Container Management

Learn to manage Docker-based application environments.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Creating and managing Docker containers.
* Working with Docker Compose.
* Understanding Dockerfiles.
* Managing container networks and volumes.
* Maintaining application configurations.
* Checking container health.
* Troubleshooting container failures.
* Reviewing container logs.
* Managing Docker images.
* Identifying unused Docker resources and cleaning them safely.
* Following established containerization practices.

The objective is to understand how Docker can make application environments consistent, portable, and easier to maintain.
  
  

* CI/CD & Jenkins

Assist in maintaining and improving CI/CD workflows using Jenkins, Git, and GitHub.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding existing Jenkins pipelines.
* Supporting Jenkins job configuration.
* Monitoring automated builds.
* Troubleshooting build failures.
* Supporting application deployment pipelines.
* Managing build artifacts.
* Investigating deployment failures.
* Following secure credential management practices.
* Maintaining basic pipeline documentation.
* Learning how to automate repetitive build and deployment activities.

The candidate should understand the relationship between source code, application builds, testing, releases, and deployment.
  
  
****Our Objective:****
Repeatable → Reliable → Automated → Traceable
  
  

* Deployment Automation

Work with developers and the technical team to improve application deployment procedures.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding application deployment requirements.
* Preparing and maintaining deployment scripts.
* Learning Bash and Shell scripting.
* Automating repetitive deployment tasks.
* Supporting application updates.
* Maintaining deployment configurations.
* Performing post-deployment verification.
* Assisting with rollback procedures.
* Maintaining deployment checklists and documentation.
* Identifying opportunities to reduce manual work.

The candidate should gradually learn how to deploy applications consistently without relying on undocumented manual steps.
  
  

* Preparing for High-Volume Deployments

GwayERP is preparing to support an increasing number of customer installations.
  
  
Our infrastructure and deployment processes are being developed to support a future target of approximately
**20–30 or more deployments per day**
.
  
  
**The Candidate Will Contribute To This Preparation By:**

* Understanding the existing deployment workflow.
* Identifying repetitive manual activities.
* Supporting deployment automation.
* Helping standardize client deployment procedures.
* Recording deployment results.
* Identifying deployment bottlenecks.
* Supporting parallel deployments where appropriate.
* Learning how to improve deployment speed and reliability.

The candidate will work with the technical team to understand the requirements and progressively implement suitable solutions as the number of customers increases.
  
  

* Secure Client Deployment

GwayERP applications may be deployed on customer-owned on-premises servers or customer-preferred cloud infrastructure.
  
  
The candidate will assist in preparing secure and repeatable deployment methods.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include Learning And Working With:**

* Docker images.
* Private container registries.
* Pre-built application artifacts.
* Runtime configuration.
* Secrets management.
* Access control.
* Secure deployment packages.
* Application versioning.
* Container security.

The objective is to allow customers to run the ERP application without unnecessarily exposing the organization's development source code.
  
  
The candidate should understand that protecting source code, securing application access, and protecting customer data are important parts of deployment engineering.
  
  

* Application Updates & Release Management

GwayERP applications will receive regular bug fixes, security updates, new features, and performance improvements.
  
  
The candidate will assist in maintaining a safe and repeatable release process.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Preparing application release packages or images.
* Supporting application updates.
* Checking deployment prerequisites.
* Assisting with database migrations.
* Verifying application health after deployment.
* Maintaining application version information.
* Recording deployment history.
* Supporting rollback procedures when required.

The candidate must understand that ERP applications handle important business transactions and that updates must be performed carefully.
  
  

* MongoDB Backup & Recovery

Assist in maintaining reliable MongoDB backup and recovery procedures.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Learning MongoDB backup methods.
* Supporting automated backup configuration.
* Monitoring backup jobs.
* Maintaining backup records.
* Following backup retention procedures.
* Checking backup integrity.
* Performing supervised restore tests.
* Assisting with database recovery.
* Maintaining backup and recovery documentation.

**The Candidate Should Understand An Important Principle:**
**A successful backup is useful only when the data can be restored successfully.**
The objective is to help maintain reliable backup procedures and develop practical recovery skills.
  
  

* Data Safety During Deployment

Follow established procedures to protect customer data during application updates.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include Checking That Appropriate Procedures Are Followed For:**

* Database backups.
* Application and database compatibility.
* Database migrations.
* Configuration backups.
* Deployment verification.
* Rollback readiness.

The objective is to minimize the risk of data loss, database corruption, configuration loss, and failed updates.
  
  
The candidate must be particularly careful when working with production systems and customer databases.
  
  

* Infrastructure Security

Learn and apply basic infrastructure security practices.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Linux server hardening.
* SSH security.
* Firewall configuration.
* Port management.
* User access control.
* File permissions.
* Docker security.
* Database access restrictions.
* Jenkins security.
* Git/GitHub access management.
* Secure handling of credentials and secrets.
* SSL/TLS certificate management.
* Applying security updates.

The candidate should actively learn about infrastructure security and follow established security procedures.
  
  

* Monitoring & Logging

**Assist In Implementing And Maintaining Monitoring For:**

* Server CPU and RAM.
* Disk space and storage health.
* Network connectivity.
* Docker containers.
* Application services.
* MongoDB.
* Redis.
* Jenkins.
* Backup jobs.

**Help Identify And Report Important Issues, Including:**

* Server unavailability.
* Low disk space.
* Repeated container failures.
* Database connectivity problems.
* Backup failures.
* Application health failures.
* Deployment failures.

The objective is to identify problems early and help prevent them from affecting customers.
  
  

* Infrastructure Documentation

Maintain clear and useful documentation for infrastructure and deployment activities.
  
  
**Documentation May Include:**
**Environment Documentation**

* Server details.
* Application environments.
* Docker services.
* Ports and network configuration.
* Application dependencies.

**Deployment Documentation**

* Deployment procedures.
* Application update procedures.
* Rollback procedures.
* Client deployment checklists.

**Backup Documentation**

* Backup procedures.
* Backup locations.
* Retention policies.
* Restore procedures.

**Infrastructure Documentation**

* Server configurations.
* Docker architecture.
* Jenkins pipelines.
* Application deployment architecture.

**Troubleshooting Documentation**

* Common problems.
* Investigation steps.
* Solutions.
* Recovery procedures.

The objective is to ensure that infrastructure knowledge is documented, repeatable, and easy for the technical team to reference.
  
  

* Git & Release Management

Work with Git and GitHub-based development workflows.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding Git branches.
* Learning pull requests and code changes.
* Following established branching practices.
* Understanding release tags.
* Tracking application versions.
* Supporting release management.
* Maintaining deployment history.
* Understanding how changes move from development to production.

**The Candidate Should Understand The Complete Workflow:**
**Git → Build → Release → Deployment → Production**

* Infrastructure Automation

Learn to automate repetitive infrastructure and deployment activities.
  
  
**This May Include:**

* Bash and Shell scripts.
* Docker automation.
* Jenkins pipelines.
* Deployment scripts.
* Backup scripts.
* Monitoring scripts.
* Server setup scripts.
* Configuration automation.

Knowledge of Ansible or Terraform is an advantage, but prior expertise is not mandatory.
  
  
The candidate should demonstrate an interest in learning automation tools and applying them to practical infrastructure problems.
  
  

* Working With Developers & QA

Work closely with developers and QA engineers to support application environments and deployments.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding application requirements.
* Supporting development and testing environments.
* Helping prepare staging environments.
* Understanding application configurations.
* Supporting deployment preparation.
* Assisting with database migrations.
* Identifying environment-related issues.
* Helping troubleshoot application deployment problems.
* Communicating technical issues clearly to the relevant team members.
* Learning & Continuous Improvement

This role requires a strong self-learning mindset.
  
  
**The Candidate Is Expected To:**

* Research unfamiliar technologies.
* Read official technical documentation.
* Test solutions safely.
* Build small proof-of-concepts when required.
* Learn from technical issues.
* Improve existing processes.
* Develop security awareness.
* Learn infrastructure automation.
* Explore better deployment methods.
* Understand container orchestration as future requirements evolve.
* Document useful findings and solutions.

We value the ability to learn and implement solutions rather than simply list technologies on a resume.
  
  

* Problem Solving & Troubleshooting

Develop practical troubleshooting skills across infrastructure and application environments.
  
  
**Problems May Include:**

* Application startup failures.
* Docker container failures.
* Database connection failures.
* Network issues.
* Jenkins build failures.
* Deployment failures.
* Disk space problems.
* Permission errors.
* SSL certificate issues.
* Backup failures.
* Server performance issues.

**The Expected Approach Is:**
**Understand → Investigate → Identify Root Cause → Fix → Verify → Document → Prevent Recurrence**
The candidate should develop the habit of investigating problems systematically and learning from each incident.
  
  

* Technical Skills

Expected Fundamentals
  
  
Candidates should have a basic understanding of, or a strong willingness to learn:
  
  

* Linux / Ubuntu.
* Docker and Docker Compose.
* Git and GitHub.
* Jenkins and CI/CD fundamentals.
* Basic computer networking.
* SSH.
* Firewall fundamentals.
* MongoDB basics.
* Database backup and restoration.
* Shell / Bash scripting.
* Basic server monitoring.
* Basic infrastructure security.

Good to Have
  
  
Familiarity with any of the following will be an advantage:
  
  

* Ansible.
* Terraform.
* Nginx.
* Private Docker registries.
* Prometheus.
* Grafana.
* Redis.
* SSL/TLS.
* VPN.
* AWS.
* Azure.
* OVH.
* Proxmox.
* Cloud infrastructure.
* Infrastructure as Code.
* Container security.

Candidates are not expected to have experience with every technology listed above.
  
  

* Eligibility & Experience

**Required**

* Fresh graduates with knowledge in DevOps, infrastructure, Linux administration, system administration.
* Basic understanding of operating systems and computer networking.
* Familiarity with Linux or Ubuntu is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of Docker or containerization is desirable.
* Basic knowledge of Git and version control.
* Interest in learning CI/CD and deployment automation.
* Ability to investigate technical problems logically.
* Strong willingness to learn and improve.

Academic projects, internships, certifications, and personal projects demonstrating practical skills will be considered.
  
  
**Preferred Educational Background**

* Computer Science.
* Information Technology.
* Computer Engineering.
* Electronics and Communication Engineering.
* Other relevant technical disciplines.

Candidates from other educational backgrounds may also apply if they demonstrate the necessary technical fundamentals and learning ability.
  
  

* What We Expect From You

You are not expected to know everything when you join.
  
  
**However, We Expect You To:**

* Take responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Learn new technologies quickly.
* Research unfamiliar problems.
* Follow instructions carefully when working with production systems.
* Communicate issues early.
* Document what you learn.
* Understand the importance of data security.
* Understand the importance of backup and recovery.
* Think about automation.
* Consider scalability when implementing solutions.
* Follow established security practices.
* Work collaboratively with developers and QA.
* Ask questions when requirements are unclear.
* Continuously improve your technical skills.

**We value curiosity, discipline, responsibility, and the ability to learn more than a long list of tools on a resume.**

* Growth Opportunity

This position is designed for a fresher who wants to build a long-term career in DevOps and infrastructure engineering.
  
  
**You Will Gain Practical Exposure To:**

* Linux server administration.
* Production infrastructure.
* ERP application deployments.
* Docker and containerization.
* Jenkins and CI/CD architecture.
* Deployment automation.
* Infrastructure security.
* MongoDB backup and recovery.
* Disaster recovery.
* Cloud infrastructure.
* On-premises infrastructure.
* Container architecture.
* Infrastructure automation.
* High-volume application deployments.

As your knowledge and practical capability improve, you will have opportunities to handle increasingly complex infrastructure and deployment responsibilities.
  
  
**The Potential Career Progression Is:**
**DevOps Engineer → DevOps Engineer (Experienced) → Senior DevOps Engineer → DevOps / Infrastructure Lead**
Career progression will depend on demonstrated technical ability, performance, ownership, and readiness for greater responsibility.
  
  

* Performance Expectations

Performance will be evaluated based on practical improvements and the quality of work delivered.
  
  
**Key Expectations Include:**

* Stable development and testing environments.
* Reliable application deployments.
* Reduced manual deployment activities.
* Accurate and updated infrastructure documentation.
* Reliable backup and recovery procedures.
* Improved infrastructure security.
* Reduced avoidable deployment failures.
* Better monitoring and alerting.
* Consistent deployment procedures.
* Effective collaboration with developers.
* Progress toward supporting higher deployment volumes.
* Continuous improvement of DevOps practices.
* Increasing independence in troubleshooting and implementation.

The long-term infrastructure objective is to support
**20–30 or more application deployments per day**
, with appropriate automation, validation, monitoring, and safeguards.
  
  
The candidate will contribute to this objective as their skills and responsibilities develop.
  
  

* The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is an enthusiastic and self-motivated individual who wants to understand how applications are built, deployed, secured, monitored, and maintained in real-world environments.
  
  
You may be a fresher, but you should be willing to learn Linux, work with servers, understand networking, troubleshoot containers, automate repetitive tasks, and develop the technical skills required to solve infrastructure problems.
  
  
You should enjoy improving systems rather than simply maintaining them.
  
  
**We Are Looking For Someone Who Believes:**
**"I may not know the solution today, but I can learn, research, test, and implement the right solution."**
The objective is to build a DevOps environment that is:
  
  
**Secure → Automated → Documented → Reliable → Scalable**
and capable of supporting the continued growth of GwayERP.
  
  

* How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit their applications through the official recruitment website.
  
  
For quicker communication regarding your application, you may send a WhatsApp message to our official HR number after submitting your application through the website.
  
  
Kindly do not make phone calls, as our recruitment team may not be able to answer individual application enquiries due to the high volume of applicants.
  
  
We appreciate your patience and look forward to connecting with candidates who are passionate about learning, growing, and building a successful career with Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited.

+91 7200082250

title: Staff Engineer (Python, CI/CD)
description:
**About Us**
One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
