title: Lead Advanced Solutions Engineer
description:
**About Chargebee**

Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.

Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2.

With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.

**About the Team**

You’ll join the Advanced Solutions Engineering team, an L2 support group connecting customer-facing operations directly with our Engineering and Product teams. We focus on triaging and solving mission-critical customer issues to keep our systems running smoothly. We value sharp diagnostic skills, asynchronous collaboration, and driving solutions from issue detection to final resolution.

**About the role (Job Summary)**

As a Lead Advanced Solutions Engineer, you will act as a senior technical leader, team guide, and pivotal bridge connecting Customer facing teams, Core Engineering, and Product Management. Stepping up from execution, you independently define and drive issue resolution strategies, ensuring efficient troubleshooting and escalations across multi-component systems. You will take complete technical and troubleshooting ownership as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) across all sub-modules within the ASE module.

In this role, you will lead and mentor Advanced Solutions Engineers (ASEs) and Senior ASEs, lead complex multi-phase investigations, write targeted code patches, and champion AI-powered diagnostic workflows. You own the reliability of supported modules/services, architect internal troubleshooting tools, and partner directly with Engineering leaders to eradicate systemic friction, implement scalable fixes, and elevate overall platform supportability.

**What you’ll do (role and responsibilities)**

* **Lead, mentor, and elevate**
  Advanced Solutions Engineers by fostering a culture of debugging excellence, establishing diagnostic playbooks, and driving team-wide adoption of AI-powered troubleshooting tools.
* **Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME)**
  across all ASE sub-modules, taking full ownership of platform reliability, observability, and service maintenance.
* **Perform deep-code debugging**
  across complex microservices and integration layers to uncover non-obvious logic flaws, concurrency bugs, and performance bottlenecks.
* **Write targeted code patches**
  and develop scalable workarounds to quickly resolve high-impact customer issues, ensuring all fixes meet platform security and maintainability standards.
* **Drive incident response strategies**
  during critical platform outages, leading rapid cross-component triage to protect customer trust and maintain operational readiness across 24/7 rotational shifts.
* **Champion AI innovation**
  by integrating LLM-driven log analysis, automated stack trace summarization, and AI coding assistants to continuously reduce MTTR.
* **Collaborate directly with Engineering and Product leaders**
  to translate recurring incident patterns into long-term product fixes, eliminating platform friction and improving supportability.

**What you’ll bring (required skills and experience)**

* **6+ years supporting complex enterprise applications or SaaS products**
  in an L2/L3 technical support capacity.
* **Strong fluency in Java/J2EE**
  with proven experience reading, navigating, patching, and profiling large, production-grade enterprise codebases.
* **Hands-on experience with AI-powered diagnostic tools**
  (e.g., GitHub Copilot, LLM prompt engineering, AI log analyzers, and automated code inspection tools).
* **Deep technical expertise in web technologies**
  , including RESTful APIs, webhooks, JSON/XML payloads, and modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue).
* **Extensive experience with enterprise observability tools**
  (such as Datadog, Splunk, ELK Stack, or New Relic) for log analysis and performance profiling.
* **Excellent oral and written communication skills**
  to effectively explain complex technical concepts to both cross-functional engineering teams and leadership.

**Nice to have (preferred)**

* 3+ years of direct experience as a Software Development Engineer (SDE) or Sustaining Engineer building or maintaining multi-tenant cloud software.
* Track record of designing internal tools, AI diagnostics, or engineering automation that significantly improved troubleshooting efficiency, reduced support overhead, or eliminated recurring ticket categories.

**Benefits we offer**

At Chargebee, we believe that feeling supported is the foundation for doing great work. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your personal, financial, and professional growth and ensure you thrive in every aspect of your life. Our commitment to supporting our employees is universal, while our benefits are thoughtfully designed to meet the unique needs of each region. We offer comprehensive packages that generally include:

* Health & Wellness: Robust coverage and access to programs to support your physical and mental well-being.
* Financial Security: Initiatives to help you build long-term financial stability.
* Work-Life Balance: Flexible options and resources to help you thrive both professionally and personally.

*Chargebee is an equal opportunity employer. At Chargebee, we believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences is not a “good-to-have” but a “must-have” as it strengthens us as a company and as individuals. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive.*

*We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, age, national origin, ancestry, caste, citizenship, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

LS systems enable precise, cost-effective inspection for cutting-edge process nodes, while SWIFT systems offer comprehensive macro inspection of all wafer surfaces—capabilities that are especially critical for advanced packaging, as well as logic, memory, and automotive applications.

* Expertise in scalability, performance optimization, reliability, and future-proof software design, ensuring robust architectures, code quality, and maintainability.

* Strong technical leadership and mentoring skills, influencing architects, senior engineers, and technical leads across organizations, geographies, and disciplines.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, effectively engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders in global teams.
* Ownership-driven mindset with a focus on execution, innovation, and engineering excellence, leveraging modern development practices and AI-assisted engineering tools.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building and architecting complex distributed systems.
* Familiarity with UI/UX design considerations in engineering applications.

**Technical Skills:**

* Programming: C#, C++, Java, Python, .NET
* Architectural Paradigms: Microservices, service-oriented architecture, modular monolith, layered architecture, event-driven architecture
* Legacy Modernization: Monolith decomposition, migration from thick-client/desktop stacks to modern service-based platforms, backend/frontend separationWorking knowledge of container technologies, orchestration frameworks (e.g., Kubernetes), and workflow automation.Strong grasp of software development best practices, CI/CD, and DevOps principles.
* Leadership & Communication: Demonstrated ability to lead and drive functional teams. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Passion for mentoring and developing engineering talent.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 6 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 8 years

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. title: Network Architect
description:
We are seeking a Network Architect, responsible for designing and governing secure, scalable, highly available enterprise network solutions across LAN, WAN, WLAN, data center, cloud, and SD-WAN environments. The role will define network architecture and standards, provide technical leadership for implementations and migrations, perform capacity and performance planning, ensure security and resiliency, and act as the senior escalation point for complex network issues. Strong expertise in routing, switching, firewalls, VPN, SD-WAN, cloud networking, network security, and high-availability architecture is required.

**6 Months On Contract Role**

Design enterprise LAN, WAN, WLAN, data center, and cloud connectivity solutions.

Develop high-level and low-level network architecture and maintain network diagrams and technical documentation.

Translate business and application requirements into scalable network designs.

Define network architecture standards, design principles, technology roadmaps, and best practices.

Architect and support SD-WAN, VPN, routing, switching, firewalls, load balancing, DNS/DHCP, and secure remote connectivity solutions.

Design network solutions for high availability, redundancy, disaster recovery, performance, and scalability.

Perform network capacity planning, performance analysis, and optimization.

Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to incorporate appropriate security controls, including firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, and network access controls.

Evaluate new network technologies and recommend improvements or modernization opportunities.

Provide architectural guidance to Network Engineers and implementation teams.

Lead technical reviews and support major network migrations, upgrades, and transformation initiatives.

Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex network issues and perform root-cause analysis.

Work with technology vendors and service providers on solution design, technical evaluation, and implementation.

Ensure network solutions comply with organizational architecture, security, and operational standards.

**Required Technical Skills:**

* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, VLAN, STP, MPLS, VPN, QoS, DNS and DHCP
* Enterprise routing and switching
* LAN/WAN/WLAN architecture
* Firewall and network security architecture
* SD-WAN and modern enterprise networking
* Cloud networking across Azure/AWS or equivalent cloud platforms
* Hybrid-cloud and data-center connectivity
* Network monitoring and performance management
* High availability and disaster recovery design
* Network troubleshooting and root-cause analysis
* Network documentation and architecture diagrams
* Exposure to network automation and Infrastructure-as-Code is desirable

**Key Competencies**

* Enterprise architecture and solution-design capability
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
* Technical leadership and decision-making
* Stakeholder and vendor management
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Ability to explain complex network designs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Strong documentation and presentation skills
* Ability to manage multiple technical priorities in enterprise environments

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong hands-on experience in enterprise networking, progressing into network solution design and architecture.
* Experience designing networks across data centers, enterprise sites, cloud environments, and remote connectivity.
* CCNP/CCIE, Juniper, cloud networking, or equivalent certifications are desirable. Industry role descriptions commonly identify advanced Cisco, Juniper, and cloud networking certifications as relevant to Network Architect positions.

title: Tech Resilience - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Join Deloitte Cyber to help clients strengthen technology resilience and recovery capabilities across complex enterprise environments. As a Senior Consultant, you will support clients in identifying resilience risks, designing recovery strategies, and implementing solutions that improve preparedness for cyber incidents, operational disruptions, and technology failures. You will work across infrastructure, cloud, backup, and recovery domains to help organizations improve operational continuity and recovery readiness.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Defense & Resilience team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Conduct technology resilience risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities, technical risks, and single points of failure across enterprise environments
* Design and implement cyber resilience, disaster recovery, incident response, and business continuity solutions aligned to client requirements
* Design, build, and maintain isolated recovery environments and support recovery of critical workloads, including applications, databases, and directory services
* Assess infrastructure, application, network, storage, and cloud environments to improve resilience architecture, backup integrity, and recovery readiness
* Lead recovery testing, simulation exercises, runbook development, and client preparedness activities across resilience programs

**The team**
Cyber Defense & Resilience teams help clients defend against sophisticated threats by transforming security operations, leveraging technology, data analytics, and threat intelligence for continuous monitoring and rapid incident response. They manage dynamic attack surfaces and support business continuity through services such as operational resilience, crisis and incident response, and security operations center transformation.
  
  
Resilience as a Practice focuses on preparing organizations to anticipate, withstand, and recover from disruptions—including cyberattacks, natural disasters, and operational failures—by embedding resilience into processes, technology, and culture. Deloitte’s Resilience Team combines technical, operational, and strategic expertise to deliver integrated solutions for business continuity, disaster recovery, and risk management, ensuring organizations meet regulatory demands and maintain stakeholder trust during crises.

title: Princ Engr-AI Science
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing…**
As a Principal Engineer (Agentic & Applied AI), you will serve as a technical leader and individual performer, architecting and driving end-to-end solutions for complex AI and Agentic use cases across multiple concurrent projects. You will be hands-on in design and coding, while leading project pods with one or two junior engineers or data scientists.
  
  

* Leading the architecture, design, and end-to-end development of complex Agentic AI and traditional AI/ML solutions across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Working in a collaborative environment with global teams and managing cross-functional stakeholders across business and technical domains to deliver scalable solutions to high-impact business problems.
* Architecting, developing, and deploying LLM-driven applications, multi-agent workflows, autonomous agent systems, and traditional data science models into production environments.
* Translating complex business requirements into robust technical and system architectures, creating high-level and low-level design documents, and articulating architectural decisions and findings to leadership and stakeholders.
* Hands-on coding and system implementation using Python, LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), REST/gRPC APIs, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures with Apache Kafka.
* Guiding, mentoring, and technical coaching of junior engineers and data scientists on project pods—conducting peer code and architecture reviews, sharing constructive feedback, and driving the team toward best-in-class technical execution
* Designing and implementing robust testing, validation, evaluation, and observability frameworks (e.g., LLM evals, hallucination mitigation, latency/token optimization, model governance) across the end-to-end AI lifecycle.
* Developing next-generation AI systems with built-in data privacy, ethical AI, bias mitigation, guardrails, and compliance with enterprise security and governance policies.
* Assisting in growing the AI practice by leading POCs, identifying new high-value opportunities, defining architectural blueprints, evaluating emerging tools/frameworks, and contributing to technical white papers and documentation.
* Staying informed on the latest advancements in Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic frameworks, and related tech stacks, finding ways to deliver business value by customizing and applying them to our specific enterprise domain.
* Partnering with ecosystem partners, startups, and open-source communities to explore and integrate cutting-edge AI capabilities.

**What We’re Looking For...**
You have deep technical expertise in modern AI engineering and traditional data science, and you thrive as a hands-on technical lead who bridges architecture, coding, and stakeholder collaboration. You are energized by working in a dynamic environment, handling multiple complex projects simultaneously, and translating ambiguous business problems into reliable, production-ready AI systems. You take pride in technical excellence, enjoy mentoring junior team members, and are passionate about advancing state-of-the-art Agentic and LLM architectures within an enterprise scale.
  
  
**What we're looking for… ("You'll need to have…")**

* Bachelor's degree with six or more years of relevant experience.
* Five or more years of hands-on experience in software engineering, applied machine learning, or advanced data science in production environments.
* One or more years of hands-on experience architecting, building, and deploying Agentic AI and LLM-driven solutions (e.g., autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, tool calling/function calling, agent workflows).
* Strong hands-on proficiency with modern AI orchestration and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent agent frameworks.
* Deep familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture, tool integration standards, REST/gRPC APIs, and microservices design.
* Expert-level coding proficiency in Python and solid software engineering practices (OOP, design patterns, modular architecture, CI/CD, testing, code quality).
* Strong experience working with relational, analytical, and streaming data stores: BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka.
* Solid foundation and working understanding of traditional data science methodologies, predictive modeling, machine learning concepts (supervised/unsupervised learning, neural networks, ensembling), and evaluation metrics.
* Experience with all phases of an end-to-end AI project lifecycle: data ingestion/streaming, preprocessing, prompt engineering/fine-tuning, model validation/evals, containerization, deployment, operationalization, monitoring, and tracing.
* Demonstrated track record of leading technical implementation across multiple simultaneous projects and collaborating effectively with cross-functional business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience providing technical mentorship, conducting architectural and code reviews, and giving feedback to junior engineers and data scientists.

**What we're looking for… ("Even better if you have…")**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* Experience architecting and deploying AI/ML and Agentic solutions in the Telecommunications domain or large-scale enterprise environments.
* Experience with Vector Databases and advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques (hybrid search, reranking, contextual compression).
* Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks and guardrail systems
* Experience with cloud AI platforms (GCP Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI) and distributed compute/data infrastructure.
* Experience in optimization, simulation techniques, or operations research applied to enterprise problems.
* Active contributions to open-source AI projects, agent frameworks, or authoring technical white papers and publications.
* Exceptional presentation, communication, and executive storytelling skills with a proven ability to influence technical and non-technical leadership.

Where you’ll be working

title: Lead/Senior SQA Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
**Our Mission:**
We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high-value content.
  
  
**About Us**
Contiem, Inc. is a global provider of software and services to assist clients in creating, managing, and delivering high-value content - technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives.
  
  
Contiem headquarters is located in Annapolis, MD, with additional locations in the US and internationally in Sutton, UK, Chennai, India, and Sydney, Australia. Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications.
  
  
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**
**Quality Ownership & Technical Leadership**

* Own end-to-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment.
* Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas.
* Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions.
* Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements.
* Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality.
* Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements.

**Test Strategy & Coverage**

* Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly.
* Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content.
* Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e.g., S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance.
* Perform accessibility testing (WCAG & EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases.

**Automation & CI/CD Excellence**

* Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium.
* Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows.
* Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation.
* Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing.
* Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers.
* Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks.
* Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage.

**Functional & Workflow Testing**

* Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions.
* Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows.
* Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes.
* Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services.
* Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle.

**XML and Publishing Validation**

* Perform validation of XML-based content processing pipelines.
* Verify XML structures (e.g., DITA maps, topics, etc.), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms.
* Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows.
* Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules.
* Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats.
* Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines.

**Data Layer Testing**

* Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures.
* Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes.
* Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases .
* Develop and execute XQuery-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules.
* Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories.
* Ensure data consistency across systems and environments.

**API and Integration Testing**

* Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services.
* Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications.
* Test webhook-based integrations and event-driven workflows.
* Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system-to-system communication.
* Perform end-to-end validation across integrated platforms.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points.

**Performance and Reliability Testing**

* Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads.
* Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories.
* Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance.

**Collaboration & Execution**

* Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams.
* Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria.
* Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines.
* Contribute to cross-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance.

**Experience And Skills**
**Mandatory Requirements & Qualifications**
:
  
  

* Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills.
* Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes.
* Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management.
* Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML-based publishing pipelines.
* Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content.
* Hands-on experience testing XML/NoSQL database platforms, with the ability to develop and execute XQuery-based validation scripts.
* Experience testing modern APIs.
* Experience testing asynchronous, event-driven, and webhook-based workflows.
* Strong SQL skills and experience validating relational database systems.
* Expertise in Playwright (JS/TS), JMeter, Azure DevOps, and Jira.
* Minimum of 10 years’ experience in SQA, specifically testing XML based systems. .
* Proven experience defining enterprise QA strategy, establishing testing standards, and driving quality initiatives across multiple teams.
* Demonstrated ability to influence product, engineering, and architectural decisions through quality leadership.
* Experience mentoring QA engineers and leading quality efforts without direct supervision.
* Track record of improving release quality, automation maturity, and testing efficiency at an organizational level.
* Deep understanding of SDLC/STLC with proven Agile/Scrum experience.
* Strong skills in test data creation, maintenance, and management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Education: MCA / Bachelor’s in Engineering (Computer Science or equivalent).
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience with Power Automate for workflow automation.
* Strong API and database testing expertise (REST, SOAP, SQL, MarkLogic, NoSQL).
* Accessibility testing knowledge (WCAG & EAA compliance).
* Proficiency with Git and version control systems.
* Experience working with structured content publishing ecosystems, including localization, translation management, or content delivery platforms.
* Exposure to cloud-based testing environments (AWS/Azure).
* Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes) for test execution.
* Knowledge of security testing fundamentals (OWASP).

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
Kaleris is a global leader in supply chain execution, focused on accelerating the transformation of digital supply chain for industrial and finished goods shippers and carriers by combining best-in-class solutions for industry-specific challenges tied to yard management, shipment visibility, and asset management, across rail, truck, and multi-mode transportation.
  
  
Our cloud-based solutions connect shippers, carriers, and drivers to the Kaleris platform where visibility across multiple modes and nodes are connected and deliver powerful analytics and second to none, enterprise-level execution.
  
  
Many of the world's largest shippers rely on Kaleris solutions for mission-critical workflows to achieve the confidence and clarity necessary to make moves ahead of the curve. Kaleris is backed by Accel-KKR, a leading technology-focused private equity firm with deep domain expertise in supply chain management software and solutions.
  
  
Kaleris is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to join the Master Terminal (MTN) team. Customer MTN environments are on-prem today, run either by the customer themselves or under JADE's own managed service, and our DevOps team is the technical authority customers and JADE lean on for installation guidance, release/patch cycles, environment migrations, and troubleshooting. In parallel, Kaleris is standing up its own hosted environments in Azure to better support the development and QA teams. This is backed by the adoption of JadeGit to manage Jade's combined source-and-data nature through a modern Git-based workflow, Terraform/Spacelift-managed Azure infrastructure, and Dev/QA and Production Kubernetes (AKS) clusters hosting MTN's newer web apps and internal tooling. This role suits someone equally comfortable advising on a Windows Server/IIS certificate problem on a customer's on-prem box and writing Terraform for an Azure Kubernetes cluster, with room to grow as Kaleris' own hosted footprint expands.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own and evolve the Jade Git workflow / GitHub Actions toolchain that validates, merges, and deploys JADE schema/class changes with quality gates.
* Build and maintain IaC for MTN cloud infrastructure using Terraform via Spacelift on Azure, including the Dev/QA and Production Kubernetes (AKS) clusters used for containerized MTN web apps and internal tooling, and the growing set of Kaleris-hosted MTN environments.
* Assist and advise customers (and JADE, where they hold the managed service) on their on-prem JADE Master Terminal environments — installation guidance, IIS/WebPortal/certificate configuration, monthly release and patch cycles, and instance copy/migration (e.g. PROD → UAT).
* Design, test, and execute backup, restore, and disaster-recovery procedures for Kaleris-hosted JADE environments (e.g. Azure Storage-backed backups, restore validation), and advise customers/JADE on DR readiness for on-prem environments.
* Implement and maintain security and compliance tooling across the MTN SDLC — primarily BlackDuck (SCA) & Wiz (SAST/vulnerability management).
* Integrate observability and alerting for MTN systems — Sumo Logic log/app/infra monitoring, PagerDuty.
* Collaborate with the JADE application team on schema/class changes, and with the broader MTN product team, QA, and Professional Services to plan releases, troubleshoot production issues, and document/knowledge-share operational runbooks.
* Carry personal responsibility for high-quality changes delivered in an agile manner.

**Requirements**

* Minimum 4-6 years of DevOps/SRE/platform engineering experience, ideally including support of a legacy or on-prem enterprise application alongside modern cloud infrastructure.
* Hands-on Windows Server administration, including IIS, Windows services, and certificate management.
* Experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps Pipelines), including writing custom automation (TypeScript/JavaScript or PowerShell/Python) that integrates with proprietary or legacy tooling.
* Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform, and familiarity with GitOps-style deployment tooling (Spacelift, Argo CD).
* Container orchestration experience with Kubernetes (AKS) and Docker.
* Experience with Azure, including storage, networking, and identity (Azure Entra / OAuth2).
* Demonstrated backup/restore and disaster-recovery experience for production systems.
* Strong full-stack troubleshooting ability — from network/VPN connectivity, through app-server and IIS logs, to database/schema-level issues.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude) and a willingness to adopt AI-driven workflows to boost efficiency across development, automation, and troubleshooting tasks.
* Fluent in English; comfortable working with a team spread across India, New Zealand, and Australia, and occasional off-hours work.

**Additional Skills And Experience**

* Direct experience with JADE, or demonstrated ability and willingness to learn a proprietary object-database platform with a schema/class-based deployment model.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps tooling (BlackDuck, Wiz, Burp Suite) and monitoring platforms (Sumo Logic, PagerDuty, or OTEL-compatible tooling).
* Experience with OpenVPN CloudConnexa or similar site-to-site/dev VPN access solutions.
* Exposure to engineering metrics frameworks (Jellyfish, DORA) and Jira-driven Agile/epic planning.

*The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned from time to*
*time or the scope of the position may change necessary to business demands.*
Kaleris is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Sr. DevOps Network Engineer- Operations
description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.
  
  
Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.
  
  
**About Five9**
Five9 is a leading provider of cloud software for the enterprise contact center market, bringing the power of the cloud to thousands of customers and facilitating more than three billion customer interactions annually. Since 2001, Five9 has led the cloud revolution in contact centers, helping organizations transition from legacy premise-based solutions to the cloud. Five9 provides businesses with cloud contact center software that is reliable, secure, compliant and scalable, which is designed to create exceptional customer experiences, increase agent productivity and deliver tangible business results.
  
  
**Role Overview**
To complement our rapid growth, we are actively sourcing for a Network Engineer to operate in a 24/7 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment maintaining IP Networking components in a production setting.
  
  
In this role you will:
  
  

* Design, engineer, and oversee highly scalable CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, digital-twin dry-running, and zero-downtime deployment of configurations across massive physical and virtual network fabrics
* Champion the "Network-as-Code" paradigm, establishing enterprise-wide GitOps workflows and enforcing source control (Git) as the absolute single source of truth for all network state, policy, and infrastructure design
* Drive the strategic vision for network automation, designing complex, reusable code frameworks and Playbooks to permanently eliminate manual configuration and operational "toil" at a global scale
* Design and optimize massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and container networking interfaces (CNIs) supporting ultra-high-throughput, multi-region cloud and bare-metal environments
* Serve as the ultimate technical authority (SME / Tier 4) for complex network, routing, and overlay issues, rapidly deciphering and resolving the most difficult challenges across physical underlays and software-defined layers
* Design and implement next-generation telemetry, monitoring, and alerting-as-code platforms, leveraging advanced heuristics for proactive auto-remediation of performance, security, and capacity issues

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner at a strategic level with Enterprise Designers, SRE leaders, and Platform teams to build and implement highly resilient, secure, and multi-tenant-isolated network infrastructure
* Establish coding standards and write/review sophisticated Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Python, and Bash
* Lead the engineering, deployment, and optimization of modern overlay and container networking solutions, particularly VXLAN, OVN (Open Virtual Network), and Project Calico
* Design the automation of complex security and traffic management policies across enterprise-grade firewalls (Palo Alto/Fortinet) and load balancers (F5 BIG-IP/Cloudflare/Octavia)
* Embed "Security-as-Code" directly into CI/CD pipelines, engineering automated validation gates for security groups, ACLs, and firewall rules prior to production pushes
* Engineer robust, automated network validation suites to continuously verify network health, state, and complex routing tables (BGP, OSPF) pre- and post-deployment
* Drive the adoption of code-based infrastructure definitions and dynamic, living technical documentation (e.g., NetBox, Git Markdown), setting the standard for documentation across the engineering organization

**Qualifications & Skills**

* 8+ years of progressive experience in Network Engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with a deeply established focus on large-scale network design, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC)
* Expert-level proficiency in engineering complex network automation tooling utilizing Ansible, Terraform, and Python (including deep experience with network-specific libraries like Netmiko, Nornir, or NAPALM)
* Deep design and operational expertise with massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and overlays, specifically VXLAN, OVN, and Project Calico
* Advanced mastery of Kubernetes networking designs (CNIs, Ingress controllers, Service Mesh, Kube-Proxy behaviors) at an enterprise scale
* Extensive, expert-level experience engineering and automating enterprise edge, routing, and security fabrics, including Cisco Nexus (9k/7k/5k/2k), Arista, Versa SD-WAN, and firewalls (Palo Alto and Fortinet)
* Authoritative knowledge of API-driven application delivery and load balancing across monolithic and cloud-native stacks (e.g., F5 BIG-IP AS3, Cloudflare APIs, Octavia LBaaS)
* Deep Linux internals and networking expertise, including advanced knowledge of Linux network namespaces, virtual interfaces, eBPF/iptables, and kernel-level routing
* CCIE-level (or equivalent) mastery of core routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EVPN) and a comprehensive understanding of how virtual/container overlay networks map to physical underlays
* Extensive experience designing and scaling CI/CD platforms (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and implementing test-driven development (TDD) for infrastructure changes
* Unparalleled troubleshooting capabilities utilizing advanced packet analysis (tcpdump/Wireshark), NetFlow, and log aggregation platforms to trace asymmetric routing and microburst traffic across hybrid fabrics
* Proven track record of technical leadership, including mentoring mid-level engineers, leading design review boards, and driving cross-functional engineering initiatives
* Deep telecommunications background, specifically VoIP, RTP, SIP peering/trunking, and Session Border Controllers (SBC), is highly advantageous
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to executive stakeholders while fostering a collaborative, DevOps-oriented engineering culture

**Diversity & Inclusion**
Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.
  
  
This role is hybrid and requires 3 days a week in office.

Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9.com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law.

title: Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary – AI Technical Lead.**

* Kumaran Systems is looking for an experienced
  **AI**
  **Lead (Technical)**
  to lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable, production-ready AI/ML solutions within its
  **Equity Market Technology -Capital Markets domain.**

* The role will drive innovation in
  **Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI workflows, and intelligent automation using the Microsoft Azure cloud platform**
  .

* The candidate will
  **provide technical leadership to a team of AI engineers**
  , collaborate closely with stakeholders, data scientists, and platform teams, and translate business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable AI solutions.

* The role requires strong hands-on
  **technical expertise, solution architecture capabilities, and the ability to lead AI initiatives from Concept to Production.**

**Details of Employment:**

**Location:**
Chennai, India

**Work Location**
– Guindy Olympia Tech Park OR SIPCOT Siruseri.

**Mode of Employment**
- 3 days Hybrid in the Office.

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time, Permanent.

**Notice Period**
- 0 to 15 days from the date of the offer (
**Critical Requisition; hence the ask**
)

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI Architecture and Solution Design**

* Architect and lead the development of enterprise-grade RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, vector databases, embedding models, and retrieval strategies using Azure AI Search, FAISS, and Pinecone.
* Design and implement Agentic AI systems incorporating autonomous agents, multi-step planning, tool orchestration, reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Develop AI solutions that integrate with internal systems, including trading platforms, operations workbenches, and risk engines, to automate decision support, exception handling, and reporting.
* Establish standards for prompt engineering, AI guardrails, and evaluation frameworks, including offline evaluations, A/B testing, and automated regression testing.

**2. Azure Cloud and AI Platform Engineering**

* Lead the design, implementation, and management of AI/ML infrastructure on Microsoft Azure using Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Design scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient AI inference pipelines using caching, request batching, and token-budget optimization.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML models and AI agents, incorporating model versioning, controlled deployments, A/B testing, rollback mechanisms, and observability.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise cloud governance, data residency, and security requirements using Azure Private Endpoints, Managed Identity, Key Vault, and related security controls.

**3. AI Performance Optimization and Troubleshooting**

* Diagnose and resolve production AI performance issues, including inference latency, embedding drift, retrieval quality degradation, hallucinations, and context-window limitations.
* Monitor and optimize token consumption, API rate limits, throughput, and cost per query across production AI workloads.
* Establish AI observability through structured logging, distributed tracing across prompt processing, retrieval, and generation, and dashboards tracking latency (p50/p95/p99), retrieval recall, and answer relevance.
* Conduct root-cause analysis of AI system failures, including incorrect tool invocations, RAG retrieval failures, safety-filter false positives, and model regressions following version upgrades.

**4. Technical Leadership and Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of 4–6 AI/ML engineers, overseeing code reviews, architecture decisions, sprint planning, engineering standards, and professional development.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, data scientists, quantitative teams, and operations leaders to translate business requirements into scalable, production-ready AI solutions.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, model releases, fine-tuning techniques, agent frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, and CrewAI, and AI evaluation methodologies.
* Represent the AI engineering function in technical design reviews, architecture governance forums, and incident post-mortems.
* Drive engineering best practices and continuous improvement across AI solution design, development, deployment, monitoring, security, and operational support.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on AI/ML solutions in production environments.
* Deep hands-on experience with RAG architectures, including vector databases, embedding pipelines, chunking strategies, hybrid search (keyword + semantic), re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation.
* Proven track record of building Agentic AI systems, including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, planning loops, memory management, and fallback strategies.
* Strong proficiency in Azure Cloud services, including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search (formerly Cognitive Search), Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, AKS, and App Service.
* Experience troubleshooting AI performance issues, including inference latency optimization, token budgeting, embedding drift detection, hallucination mitigation, and cost management at scale.
* Proficiency in Python and at least one of the following: C#/.NET or TypeScript/Node.js.
* Experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI.
* Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, including transformers, attention mechanisms, fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), RLHF, and evaluation metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, faithfulness, and relevance.
* Experience leading engineering teams of 4+ members in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and prepare clear technical documentation.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
About the role

You will be the architect who wins the technical deal. Before a contract is signed, you show enterprise customers that their AI agents will work, at their scale and under their rules. You build the demos and proofs of concept, answer the architecture questions, and hand delivery a plan they can execute. This is a hands-on engineering role in front of customers. You write code most weeks and spend the rest with CIOs, platform teams and risk officers. You report to the Co-Founder and CTO.

What you will do

• Discover: run technical discovery with CIOs, platform-engineering and risk teams at banks, insurers and asset managers. Map their systems, data and controls to the agent use cases that matter.

• Demo: build tailored demos of agent workflows, using the customer's own scenarios where you can.

• Prove: scope and deliver 2 to 6 week proofs of concept. Write the code, wire up integrations and measure results against agreed success criteria.

• Design: produce reference architectures for agent deployment on AWS, Azure or GCP, covering identity, data access, observability and guardrails.

• De-risk: answer security, compliance and model-risk questionnaires (SOC 2, data residency, audit logging, human-in-the-loop controls).

• Hand off: turn every won proof of concept into a delivery plan our forward-deployed engineers can run from day one.

• Feed back: bring field patterns to product and build reusable demo assets, templates and starter agents.

What we are looking for

• 8+ years in software engineering, solutions engineering, solutions architecture or forward-deployed engineering for enterprise customers.

• Hands-on experience building LLM applications or agents: prompt and tool design, RAG, evaluation, and at least one agent framework.

• Strong Python, plus working knowledge of APIs, containers and one major cloud.

• Comfort in regulated environments, where governance, auditability and access control decide the deal.

• Consulting experience: client-facing work, scoping engagements and running workshops with enterprise stakeholders.

• Understanding of tool calling and MCP, guardrails and policy controls, access management, observability and audit trails.

Nice to have

• Experience selling to, or working inside, financial services.

• Kubernetes, observability or AIOps tooling.

• AWS, Azure or GCP certifications.

• A public demo, repo, talk or post about something you built with agents.

Location: Chennai, India (Chennai office), hybrid 3 days on-site, with travel to customer sites as needed.

title: SecOps Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
We are seeking a Secops Engineer with minimum 3 years to maximum 5 years – Vulnerability, Patch, and Application Packaging Management
  
  
**Role Summary**
Responsible for overseeing end-to-end vulnerability management, patch lifecycle, and application packaging for servers and workstations. The role ensures timely remediation of vulnerabilities through effective patching, packaging, and deployment strategies across enterprise assets, integrating automation, compliance, and tool optimization (Qualys, SCCM, Intune, AdminStudio, ORCA).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Application Packaging & Deployment:**

* Develop, customize, and validate MSI/MST/MSIX packages using AdminStudio, InstallShield, and ORCA.
* Convert legacy EXE installers into silent MSI/IntuneWin formats for streamlined deployment.
* Perform application discovery, dependency mapping, and compatibility testing for Windows 10/11 environments.
* Coordinate testing and deployment of packaged apps through SCCM and Intune.
* Manage version control, documentation, and change requests for packaged applications.
* Automate repetitive packaging and deployment tasks using PowerShell scripting.
* Collaborate with the Cybersecurity team to validate that packaged applications meet security compliance and vulnerability-free baselines.

**Vulnerability & Patch Management**

* Lead enterprise Vulnerability Management Program using Qualys VMDR — ensuring timely detection, prioritization, and remediation.
* Manage monthly patch cycles for Windows servers (via SCCM) and workstations (via Intune).
* Validate and test Microsoft and third-party patches before deployment to production environments.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, endpoint, and security teams to ensure critical vulnerabilities are remediated within SLA.
* Perform zero-day vulnerability handling (e.g., WannaCry-type events) with accelerated patch validation and rollout.

**Operational Excellence**

* Drive automation for vulnerability-to-patch correlation workflows using Python and PowerShell.
* Integrate patch and packaging workflows with vulnerability intelligence (Qualys → SCCM/Intune mapping).

**Tools & Technologies**

* Application Packaging: AdminStudio, ORCA, InstallShield, MSIX Packaging Tool
* Scripting: PowerShell
* Patch Management: SCCM, Intune, WSUS
* Vulnerability Management: Qualys VMDR, Rapid7 InsightVM

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
As a Software Engineering Manager within MS TECH Order Fulfillment, you will provide strategic product and technical leadership, along with hands-on expertise, to build industry-leading products. You are a systems thinker capable of driving large-scale transformations that maximize value for Ford, our Dealers, and our customers. The role combines high-level strategy, including product vision, AI/ML use-case portfolio, data strategy, and technical roadmaps, with disciplined execution to deliver scalable, resilient, secure, explainable, and highly available solutions in a global environment.
  
  
**Technical Leadership & Vision**

* Serve as the primary technical authority for the Order Generation product suite, defining the evolution of the technology stack, data architecture, AI/ML capabilities, and architectural patterns.
* Lead cross-functional teams through complex integrations, managing dependencies across the broader Order Fulfillment ecosystem to ensure seamless data flow and system interoperability.
* Translate high-level business requirements into actionable technical strategies that align with Ford enterprise standards.

**AI/ML Product Strategy & Innovation**

* Define and execute an AI/ML and data analytics product strategy that converts priority business requirements into a sequenced portfolio of intelligent capabilities and measurable outcomes.
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI/ML opportunities across forecasting, order generation, decision support, anomaly detection, optimization, and workflow automation using value, feasibility, risk, data readiness, and adoption criteria.
* Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of AI/ML products from discovery, business-case development, experimentation, and MVP validation through industrialization, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, Product, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy, and business teams to ensure solutions are technically sound, usable, compliant, and aligned with responsible AI principles.
* Establish outcome-based product metrics, experimentation methods, model performance targets, and adoption measures; use evidence and customer feedback to guide investment and roadmap decisions.
* Monitor emerging technologies, including generative AI, agentic AI, foundation models, advanced analytics, optimization, and intelligent automation, and determine where they can create differentiated business value.
* Drive build, buy, or partner assessments and develop scalable patterns for reusable AI/ML services, data products, model APIs, and decision intelligence capabilities.

**Product Strategy & Delivery**

* Partner with business stakeholders to define and execute a multi-year product vision and roadmap focused on optimized order forecasting and generation.
* Champion an iterative, Agile delivery model, prioritizing the delivery of Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) and maintaining a high-velocity release cadence.
* Apply Human-Centered Design (HCD) principles to ensure technical solutions solve real-world problems for Dealers and customers.
* Create launch and adoption plans that include operational readiness, user training, change management, benefit tracking, and feedback loops.

**Data, Model & MLOps Excellence**

* Ensure AI/ML solutions are supported by trusted, governed, discoverable, and fit-for-purpose data, with clear ownership, lineage, quality controls, and access patterns.
* Guide the implementation of robust MLOps and LLMOps practices covering reproducible experimentation, model registry, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, rollback, and auditability.
* Define controls for model quality, explainability, bias and fairness evaluation, privacy, security, human oversight, and responsible use throughout the product lifecycle.
* Balance predictive accuracy with interpretability, latency, cost, reliability, and business usability when selecting models and architectures.

**Engineering & Operational Excellence**

* Enforce rigorous engineering standards, including Test-Driven Development (TDD), robust CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps practices.
* Drive a culture of Full Lifecycle Ownership, where the team is responsible for the design, security, deployment, and operational health of its services.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for system health, code quality, delivery velocity, model performance, data quality, adoption, and realized business value.

**Architectural Design**

* Architect and oversee the development of cloud-native, microservices-based systems designed for global scale, multi-tenancy, and high-performance transactional processing.
* Design interoperable data and AI architectures that support batch and real-time inference, event-driven workflows, APIs, observability, and secure integration with enterprise platforms.

**People Leadership & Talent Development**

* Cultivate a high-performing, diverse team of Software Engineers, Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and ML Engineers through active coaching, mentorship, and career pathing.
* Foster a culture of psychological safety and continuous learning, utilizing blameless retrospectives and regular feedback loops to drive team growth.
* Identify and close skill gaps within the team to keep pace with emerging technologies and industry trends.

**Strategic Collaboration**

* Act as a bridge between the product team and domain experts in Cloud Infrastructure, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, Responsible AI, SRE, and DevOps to reduce portfolio complexity.
* Influence stakeholders across the organization to adopt modern engineering practices, responsible AI controls, reusable data products, and standardized service contracts.

**Technical Execution (Hands-on)**

* Maintain deep technical fluency in the team’s primary languages, frameworks, cloud services, data platforms, and AI/ML toolchain, including Java, Spring Boot, GCP/Azure, Vertex AI, and modern MLOps platforms.
* Lead from the front by participating in architecture and code reviews, resolving complex technical blockers, reviewing model and data design decisions, and occasionally prototyping high-risk or emerging technology concepts.
* Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering, digital product, data, or AI/ML solution delivery experience, with a significant portion in engineering and product leadership roles.
* AI/ML Product Leadership: Demonstrated experience strategizing, developing, launching, and scaling AI/ML-based products that address business requirements and deliver measurable operational or customer outcomes.
* Product Strategy: Experience defining product vision, business cases, roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, MVPs, go-to-market or launch plans, adoption strategies, and value-realization metrics for data and AI products.
* Education: Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.
* Certifications: Industry certifications relevant to software engineering, cloud, data, or AI/ML, or a commitment to obtain them within 6 months. GCP Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or equivalent certification is a plus.
* Cloud Expertise: 4+ years of experience delivering production solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including cloud-native application and data/AI services.
* Technical Depth: Expertise in microservices, cloud-native architectures, event-driven architectures, APIs, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), distributed systems, and secure enterprise integration.
* AI/ML & Analytics: Strong working knowledge of supervised and unsupervised learning, time-series forecasting, optimization, anomaly detection, feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation, and production inference patterns.
* Data Engineering: Experience with data architectures, data pipelines, data quality, governance, metadata and lineage, feature stores, batch and streaming data, and analytics platforms.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Hands-on experience establishing or governing CI/CD/CT for models, experiment tracking, model registry, automated validation, deployment, observability, drift monitoring, retraining, and lifecycle controls.

* Developer Experience: Experience increasing developer productivity by integrating AI agents, coding assistants, reusable platform capabilities, or AI skills into the development lifecycle.
* Leadership Qualities: Proven ability to lead large-scale transformations, apply systems thinking, create psychologically safe teams, influence complex decisions, and earn the respect of strong individual technical talent through competence and mentorship.
* Communication & Business Acumen: Ability to communicate complex technical and AI concepts to executives and business partners, align diverse stakeholders, manage trade-offs, and connect product investments to business outcomes.

**Nice to Have**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.

title: Infrastructure DevOps Specialist
description:
Req ID: 140491
  
  
Remote Position: Hybrid
  
  
Region: Asia
  
  
Country: India
  
  
State/Province: Chennai
  
  
City: Guindy, Chennai
  
  
**Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled, Senior Specialist to design, build, and actively engineer our enterprise cloud and hybrid platform infrastructure. You will directly write code, engineer systems, configure virtual networks, and troubleshoot complex production workloads. Operating within a product-based environment, you will serve as the primary technical authority for our infrastructure, heavily leveraging Microsoft Azure as our primary cloud foundation alongside secondary multi- cloud setups (AWS/GCP). You will also directly manage underlying operating systems (Linux & Windows) and virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V) across hybrid deployments.
  
  
Detailed Description
  
  
**Cloud Infrastructure & Virtualization**

* Directly provision, configure, and maintain production workloads on Microsoft Azure (Primary), with working operational experience on AWS and GCP.
* Hands-on administration of enterprise virtualization platforms, specifically VMware vSphere/ESXi and Microsoft Hyper-V, for hybrid cloud integrations and compute management.
* Write, test, and deploy modular Terraform scripts for Azure, multi-cloud, and virtualized resource orchestration.
* Automate configuration management, VM patching, and state compliance using Ansible playbooks.

**Operating Systems & Administration**

* Hands-on systems engineering, performance tuning, and hardening across enterprise Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu, CentOS) and Windows Server environments.
* Diagnose and resolve OS-level bottlenecks, kernel/system performance issues, disk/volume allocations, and active directory / identity integrations.

**Kubernetes & Container Orchestration**

* Directly deploy, manage, and scale enterprise Kubernetes clusters across public cloud and on-premise platforms: AKS (Azure), EKS (AWS), GKE (GCP), bare-metal/virtualized on-prem Kubernetes, and Red Hat OpenShift.
* Implement ingress routing, service meshes, cluster security policies, CNI plugins, and monitoring setups.

**Coding, Scripting & Pipeline Engineering**

* Develop operational tooling, continuous delivery scripts, and cloud automation using Python (Mandatory) and advanced Shell/Bash (plus PowerShell for Windows automation).
* Build, manage, and optimize enterprise build and release pipelines using Azure DevOps (ADO) and GitLab CI/CD.

**Networking & Security Fundamentals**

* Apply solid CCNA-level networking fundamentals to configure VNet/VPC peering, Subnetting (CIDR), DNS, routing, load balancing, and secure site-to-site VPN connectivity between cloud and VMware/Hyper-V on-premise environments.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
  
  
**Core Technology Stack**
**Cloud Platforms:**
Azure (Primary), AWS, GCP
  
  
**Virtualization**
: VMware (vSphere/ESXi), Hyper-V
  
  
**Operating Systems**
: Enterprise Linux, Windows Server
  
  
**Containers**
: Kubernetes (AKS, EKS, GKE, On- prem), OpenShift
  
  
**IaC & Config**
: Terraform, Ansible
  
  
**Coding/Scripting:**
Python (Mandatory), Shell/ Bash, PowerShell
  
  
**CI/CD Pipelines**
: Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD
  
  
**Networking**
: CCNA basics, Cloud VNets/VPCs, VPNs, Firewalls
  
  
Physical Demands
  
  

* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

Typical Experience
  
  

* 10+ years of overall IT experience with a strong background in hands-on Systems, Cloud, and DevOps engineering.
* Proficient hands-on coding in Python (mandatory) and Shell/PowerShell scripting.
* Deep practical experience with Linux/Windows administration, VMware/Hyper-V hypervisors, Terraform IaC, and Kubernetes/OpenShift container management.

Typical Education
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Educational Requirements may vary by Geography

Notes
  
  
This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.
  
  
Celestica is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on any protected status (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran or disability status or other characteristics protected by law).
  
  
At Celestica we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. Special arrangements can be made for candidates who need it throughout the hiring process. Please indicate your needs and we will work with you to meet them.
  
  
**Company Overview**
Celestica, Inc. (NYSE: CLS; TSX: CLS) is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high-growth markets. With a talented team and a strategic global network, Celestica helps its customers achieve competitive advantages.
  
  
Today, Celestica delivers innovative supply chain solutions globally to customers in strategic two operating and reporting segments: Advanced Technology Solutions (ATS) and Connectivity and Cloud Solutions (CC):
  
  
**ATS:**
This segment serves customers in complex, regulated and high-reliability markets such as Industrial & Smart Energy, Aerospace & Defense, Semiconductor Capital Equipment, and HealthTech. It is engineering led, with deep expertise in design, manufacturing and lifecycle solutions.
  
  
**CCS:**
This segment focuses on high-performance technology solutions and services for the data center, serving hyperscalers, digital native customers and enterprises. Celestica's Platform Solutions offering provides innovative and customizable computing, storage and networking solutions enabling AI-driven growth.
  
  
Built on a legacy of trust and performance, Celestica has earned its reputation by delivering results in complex and fast-changing markets. Celestica exceeds customer expectations by identifying trends and staying ahead of the curve. Backed by comprehensive capabilities and a global network across North America, Europe and Asia, Celestica helps customers gain competitive advantage with the quality, flexibility and resiliency they need to respond quickly to shifts in demand. Guided by a bold vision to accelerate market advancements, Celestica delivers innovative solutions and technologies that turn complexity into opportunity. Anchored in teamwork and commitment, Celestica strives to be the most trusted partner to its customers and colleagues worldwide.
  
  
Celestica would like to thank all applicants, however, only qualified applicants will be contacted.
  
  
Celestica does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or fee based recruitment services.

title: Sr Network DevOps Engineer - Operations
description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.
  
  
Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.
  
  
**About Five9**
Five9 is a leading provider of cloud software for the enterprise contact center market, bringing the power of the cloud to thousands of customers and facilitating more than three billion customer interactions annually. Since 2001, Five9 has led the cloud revolution in contact centers, helping organizations transition from legacy premise-based solutions to the cloud. Five9 provides businesses with cloud contact center software that is reliable, secure, compliant and scalable, which is designed to create exceptional customer experiences, increase agent productivity and deliver tangible business results.
  
  
**Role Overview**
To complement our rapid growth, we are actively sourcing for a Network Engineer to operate in a 24/7 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment maintaining IP Networking components in a production setting.
  
  
In this role you will:
  
  

* Design, engineer, and oversee highly scalable CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, digital-twin dry-running, and zero-downtime deployment of configurations across massive physical and virtual network fabrics
* Champion the "Network-as-Code" paradigm, establishing enterprise-wide GitOps workflows and enforcing source control (Git) as the absolute single source of truth for all network state, policy, and infrastructure design
* Drive the strategic vision for network automation, designing complex, reusable code frameworks and Playbooks to permanently eliminate manual configuration and operational "toil" at a global scale
* Design and optimize massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and container networking interfaces (CNIs) supporting ultra-high-throughput, multi-region cloud and bare-metal environments
* Serve as the ultimate technical authority (SME / Tier 4) for complex network, routing, and overlay issues, rapidly deciphering and resolving the most difficult challenges across physical underlays and software-defined layers
* Design and implement next-generation telemetry, monitoring, and alerting-as-code platforms, leveraging advanced heuristics for proactive auto-remediation of performance, security, and capacity issues

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner at a strategic level with Enterprise Designers, SRE leaders, and Platform teams to build and implement highly resilient, secure, and multi-tenant-isolated network infrastructure
* Establish coding standards and write/review sophisticated Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Python, and Bash
* Lead the engineering, deployment, and optimization of modern overlay and container networking solutions, particularly VXLAN, OVN (Open Virtual Network), and Project Calico
* Design the automation of complex security and traffic management policies across enterprise-grade firewalls (Palo Alto/Fortinet) and load balancers (F5 BIG-IP/Cloudflare/Octavia)
* Embed "Security-as-Code" directly into CI/CD pipelines, engineering automated validation gates for security groups, ACLs, and firewall rules prior to production pushes
* Engineer robust, automated network validation suites to continuously verify network health, state, and complex routing tables (BGP, OSPF) pre- and post-deployment
* Drive the adoption of code-based infrastructure definitions and dynamic, living technical documentation (e.g., NetBox, Git Markdown), setting the standard for documentation across the engineering organization

**Qualifications & Skills**

* 5+ years of progressive experience in Network Engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with a deeply established focus on large-scale network design, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC)
* Expert-level proficiency in engineering complex network automation tooling utilizing Ansible, Terraform, and Python (including deep experience with network-specific libraries like Netmiko, Nornir, or NAPALM)
* Deep design and operational expertise with massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and overlays, specifically VXLAN, OVN, and Project Calico
* Advanced mastery of Kubernetes networking designs (CNIs, Ingress controllers, Service Mesh, Kube-Proxy behaviors) at an enterprise scale
* Extensive, expert-level experience engineering and automating enterprise edge, routing, and security fabrics, including Cisco Nexus (9k/7k/5k/2k), Arista, Versa SD-WAN, and firewalls (Palo Alto and Fortinet)
* Authoritative knowledge of API-driven application delivery and load balancing across monolithic and cloud-native stacks (e.g., F5 BIG-IP AS3, Cloudflare APIs, Octavia LBaaS)
* Deep Linux internals and networking expertise, including advanced knowledge of Linux network namespaces, virtual interfaces, eBPF/iptables, and kernel-level routing
* CCIE-level (or equivalent) mastery of core routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EVPN) and a comprehensive understanding of how virtual/container overlay networks map to physical underlays
* Extensive experience designing and scaling CI/CD platforms (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and implementing test-driven development (TDD) for infrastructure changes
* Unparalleled troubleshooting capabilities utilizing advanced packet analysis (tcpdump/Wireshark), NetFlow, and log aggregation platforms to trace asymmetric routing and microburst traffic across hybrid fabrics
* Proven track record of technical leadership, including mentoring mid-level engineers, leading design review boards, and driving cross-functional engineering initiatives
* Deep telecommunications background, specifically VoIP, RTP, SIP peering/trunking, and Session Border Controllers (SBC), is highly advantageous
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to executive stakeholders while fostering a collaborative, DevOps-oriented engineering culture

**Diversity & Inclusion**
Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.
  
  
This role is hybrid and requires 3 days a week in office.
