title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

Applix is seeking an experienced
**Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) – API Operations & Cloud Support**
to ensure the reliability, availability, performance, and operational efficiency of enterprise production systems.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in AWS cloud infrastructure, DevOps automation, production support, incident management, and monitoring and observability. The role requires expertise in troubleshooting complex production issues, conducting root cause analysis (RCA), improving service reliability, and managing Tier 2 escalations.

In addition to core SRE and cloud operations responsibilities, the candidate will support REST API operations and customer integrations, coordinate with engineering and product teams, and contribute to Snowflake data-sharing governance initiatives. The successful candidate will combine technical problem-solving with effective stakeholder communication, operational ownership, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

Site Reliability Engineering & Production Operations

* Monitor and maintain the availability, reliability, scalability, and performance of production applications and services.
* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, application, networking, and API-related incidents.
* Manage Tier 2 support escalations and coordinate resolution of critical production issues.
* Conduct root cause analysis and prepare postmortems for major incidents.
* Define, monitor, and improve Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Service Level Indicators (SLIs).
* Improve observability through effective logging, metrics, dashboards, alerting, and performance monitoring.
* Identify reliability risks, vulnerabilities, and recurring failure patterns; implement preventive and corrective actions.
* Collaborate with development teams to resolve application defects, performance bottlenecks, and production stability issues.

AWS Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps

* Manage and troubleshoot AWS infrastructure across compute, storage, networking, databases, security, and application services.
* Work with AWS services including EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, EBS, RDS, DynamoDB, VPC, Route 53, Elastic Load Balancing, CloudFront, IAM, Certificate Manager, WAF, SQS, SNS, SES, and CloudWatch.
* Develop, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to support automated builds, testing, deployments, and releases.
* Implement infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent automation tools.
* Manage containerized applications using Docker and Amazon ECS or Kubernetes.
* Develop scripts and automation using Python, Java, PowerShell, or other suitable languages.
* Improve infrastructure security, scalability, resilience, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Troubleshoot cloud networking, access permissions, load balancing, storage, and connectivity issues.

Monitoring, Observability & Reliability Improvement

* Configure and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting, and dashboard solutions using tools such as Amazon CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK Stack, AppDynamics, and ThousandEyes.
* Analyze metrics, logs, traces, and system events to identify service degradation and performance anomalies.
* Establish actionable alerts and improve incident detection and response.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and automate repetitive troubleshooting and support activities.
* Recommend and implement improvements to system resilience, recovery, and operational readiness.

API Operations & Customer Integration Support

* Support RESTful API operations, integrations, authentication, and troubleshooting for enterprise customers and dealers.
* Investigate recurring API failures, latency, connectivity issues, and integration errors.
* Collaborate with engineering and product teams to define requirements for new telematics API capabilities and enhancements.
* Provide technical guidance on API usage, integration scenarios, and customer use cases.
* Coordinate API feature releases, customer feedback, adoption initiatives, and field follow-up activities.
* Maintain API troubleshooting guides, operational documentation, and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Work with API gateway technologies such as Apigee or equivalent platforms where applicable.

Incident, Problem & Change Management

* Manage incidents, escalations, ticket assignments, priorities, and resolution tracking through ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms.
* Follow established ITSM/ITIL processes for incident, problem, and change management.
* Coordinate incident response activities and communicate status, impact, and recovery progress to relevant stakeholders.
* Conduct post-incident reviews and track corrective and preventive actions through closure.
* Maintain runbooks, standard operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
* Identify recurring incidents and implement automation and process improvements to reduce repeat occurrences.
* Support release planning, change implementation, and production readiness activities.

Snowflake Data Governance & Project Coordination

* Coordinate business approvals for dealer and customer Snowflake data-sharing initiatives.
* Support the definition and maintenance of business sign-off processes for VisionLink Snowflake data-sharing programs.
* Document business and technical requirements, track project deliverables, and maintain approval records.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders, product teams, and technical teams to ensure alignment and timely execution.

Technical Leadership & Continuous Improvement

* Provide technical guidance and operational support to Tier 2 engineers and other team members.
* Mentor team members on troubleshooting, incident response, monitoring, and reliability best practices.
* Participate in sprint planning and release discussions to identify operational risks and prepare support strategies.
* Improve knowledge-sharing practices and facilitate effective handoffs between development, product, and support teams.
* Prioritize competing tasks based on business impact, urgency, and service risk.
* Drive initiatives that improve service quality, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

**Required Technical Skills**

Professional Experience

* 7–8+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, cloud operations, production support, or application operations.
* Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise-scale production systems.
* Strong troubleshooting, incident management, root cause analysis, and reliability engineering skills.
* Experience handling production escalations and coordinating with cross-functional technical teams.

AWS Cloud Services

Hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure and services, including:

* **Compute:**
  EC2, ECS, Lambda.
* **Storage and Databases:**
  S3, EBS, RDS, DynamoDB.
* **Networking:**
  VPC, Route 53, Elastic Load Balancing, CloudFront.
* **Security:**
  IAM, AWS Certificate Manager, WAF.
* **Messaging:**
  SQS, SNS, SES.
* **Monitoring and Infrastructure Provisioning:**
  CloudWatch, CloudFormation.

Candidates should understand cloud architecture, networking, load balancing, access management, security controls, and production troubleshooting.

DevOps, CI/CD & Infrastructure Automation

* Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
* Working knowledge of Jenkins, Git, Bitbucket, Maven, and SonarQube.
* Experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, or equivalent infrastructure automation tools.
* Understanding of automated builds, testing, deployment strategies, release management, and version control.
* Ability to automate operational workflows and repetitive support tasks.

Programming & Scripting

* Practical experience with Python, Java, PowerShell, or other scripting languages.
* Ability to develop scripts for operational automation, monitoring, troubleshooting, and system maintenance.
* Ability to analyze logs and diagnose infrastructure and application-level issues.

Monitoring & Observability

Experience with one or more of the following tools:

* Amazon CloudWatch
* Prometheus and Grafana
* Splunk
* ELK Stack
* AppDynamics
* ThousandEyes

Candidates should be able to interpret monitoring data, configure actionable alerts, troubleshoot performance issues, and improve production visibility.

Containers & Orchestration

* Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized applications.
* Experience with Amazon ECS or Kubernetes.
* Understanding of container deployment, service health, scaling, and production troubleshooting.

API & Application Support

* Strong understanding of REST APIs, authentication, integrations, HTTP status codes, and API troubleshooting.
* Experience diagnosing API availability, latency, connectivity, and integration failures.
* Familiarity with Apigee or other API gateway technologies is desirable.
* Ability to collaborate with developers to resolve application-level issues.

ITSM & Incident Management

* Experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms.
* Strong understanding of incident, problem, and change management processes.
* Experience handling production escalations, performing RCA, preparing postmortems, and tracking corrective actions.
* Understanding of SLAs, SLOs, SLIs, operational procedures, and service reliability practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL Foundation V3 certification or equivalent practical knowledge of ITIL processes.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure in addition to AWS.
* Exposure to Snowflake data sharing, data governance, or enterprise data platforms.
* Experience supporting telematics platforms, customer-facing APIs, or enterprise integrations.
* Experience coordinating technical releases, customer adoption initiatives, and stakeholder communications.
* Previous experience mentoring engineers or overseeing Tier 2 production support operations.

**Required Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
* Effective decision-making and prioritization during critical incidents.
* Clear verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
* Ability to communicate technical issues, business impact, and resolution plans effectively.
* Proactive ownership of production reliability and continuous improvement.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment.

**Key Success Metrics**

Success in this role will be measured by the candidate's ability to:

* Maintain production availability and meet defined SLAs, SLOs, and SLIs.
* Reduce recurring incidents through effective RCA and preventive measures.
* Improve incident detection, response times, and service recovery.
* Enhance monitoring, observability, and operational readiness.
* Improve API reliability and customer integration support.
* Automate repetitive operational activities and reduce manual effort.
* Maintain effective incident documentation, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Improve coordination between development, product, business, and support teams.
* Support timely completion of Snowflake data-sharing approvals and associated project deliverables.

**Job Function:**
Site Reliability Engineering / DevOps / Production Support

**Primary Skills:**
AWS, SRE, CI/CD, Production Support, Incident Management, Monitoring & Observability

**Preferred Experience:**
Enterprise APIs, ITSM/ITIL, Snowflake data governance, and customer-facing integrations

description:

****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Role Definition
  
  
Develop, maintain, and modernize Java and Angular-based enterprise applications by transforming traditional Agile software development practices into an Agentic SDLC using Caterpillar-approved AI frameworks, development tools, and governance standards to accelerate solution delivery, improve software quality, and enhance engineering productivity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business partners and stakeholders to capture requirements, refine user stories, and optimize business workflows through intelligent automation and AI-assisted solution design.

Skill Descriptors
  
  
Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

* Communicates well downward, upward, and outward.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
* Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
* Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
* Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Customer Support Policies, Standards and Procedures: Knowledge of the organization's customer support policies, standards and procedures; ability to guide customers on all company interactions.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Collaborates with other functions on establishing and documenting joint standards.
* Develops quality assurance and monitoring mechanisms.
* Advises on the development of customer support policies and practices.
* Implements cross-functional standards and procedures.
* Evaluates the impact of standards and policies across functional specialties.
* Analyzes existing and evolving procedures for their efficiency and effectiveness.

Software Product Technical Knowledge: Knowledge of technical aspects of a software products; ability to design, configure and integrate technical aspects of software products.

Software Release Management: Knowledge of strategies, practices and tools for managing versions and distribution of software products and enhancements; ability to evaluate and improve release management practices and tools.

Software Reliability Management: Knowledge of software reliability management; ability to develop and use principles, methodologies and metrics that increase software product performance and reliability.

Performance Measurement and Tuning: Knowledge of system performance, testing and programming; ability to monitor, measure, and optimize system performance and network communication.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Works with the performance measurements of hardware, software or network components.Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation.

**Level Extensive Experience:**

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
DevOps Engineer – GwayERP
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a
**hands-on, responsible and growth-oriented DevOps Engineer**
with approximately
**1–2 years of experience**
who is interested in building strong practical expertise in
**Linux, Docker, CI/CD, server management, deployment automation, security, monitoring and infrastructure management**
.
  
  
GwayERP is growing rapidly, and we are preparing our infrastructure and deployment processes to support an increasing number of ERP implementations and frequent application releases.
  
  
The selected candidate will work closely with the
**development, QA and technical teams**
to maintain the existing environments, improve the current infrastructure, automate repetitive activities, strengthen security, improve documentation and progressively build a reliable deployment ecosystem.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who has a good foundation in DevOps and is willing to
**learn deeply, take responsibility, research solutions independently and grow into larger infrastructure and DevOps responsibilities**
.
  
  
The candidate does not need to know everything from day one.
  
  
**However, The Candidate Must Have The Mindset:**
**“If I don't know it, I will learn it, understand it properly, implement it safely and document it.”**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Environment Management

Support and maintain the different application environments used by GwayERP, including:
  
  

* Development
* Testing / QA
* Staging
* Trial / Demo
* Production / Client environments

**Responsibilities Include:**

* Maintaining environment availability.
* Checking server health.
* Managing application services.
* Managing Docker containers.
* Managing environment configurations.
* Supporting developers with environment-related issues.
* Identifying configuration inconsistencies.
* Keeping environments properly documented.

The candidate will progressively improve the structure and reliability of these environments.
  
  

* Local Server & Linux Administration

Work hands-on with our local/on-premises infrastructure.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Ubuntu/Linux server administration.
* User and permission management.
* SSH configuration.
* Server resource monitoring.
* Disk and storage monitoring.
* Network configuration.
* Firewall configuration.
* Service management.
* Log analysis.
* System updates and patching.
* Troubleshooting server-related issues.

The candidate should gradually develop the ability to independently troubleshoot common Linux infrastructure problems.
  
  

* Docker & Container Management

Work with Docker-based application environments.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Creating and maintaining Docker containers.
* Managing Docker Compose configurations.
* Managing container networks.
* Managing Docker volumes.
* Managing application configuration.
* Monitoring container health.
* Troubleshooting container failures.
* Managing application logs.
* Maintaining Docker images.
* Cleaning unused resources safely.
* Following standard containerization practices.

The candidate should progressively learn how to design
**consistent and reusable Docker environments**
rather than maintaining containers manually.
  
  

* CI/CD & Jenkins

Support and improve the organization's CI/CD processes using
**Jenkins, Git and GitHub**
.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding existing Jenkins pipelines.
* Maintaining Jenkins jobs.
* Supporting automated builds.
* Managing deployment pipelines.
* Troubleshooting failed builds.
* Troubleshooting deployment failures.
* Managing build artifacts.
* Supporting automated application deployments.
* Maintaining Jenkins credentials securely.
* Gradually improving deployment automation.

The long-term objective is to reduce manual deployment activities and make deployments:
  
  
**Repeatable → Reliable → Automated → Traceable**

* Deployment Automation

Work with developers to improve the way GwayERP applications are deployed.
  
  
The candidate will help establish a standardized deployment process such as:
  
  
**Code → Build → Release → Deploy → Verify**
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding application deployment requirements.
* Preparing deployment scripts.
* Automating repetitive deployment tasks.
* Supporting application updates.
* Maintaining deployment configurations.
* Performing deployment verification.
* Supporting rollback procedures.
* Maintaining deployment documentation.

The candidate should continuously identify opportunities to eliminate unnecessary manual steps.
  
  

* Preparing for High-Volume Deployments

GwayERP are expected to be deployed to an increasing number of customers.
  
  
The infrastructure is being prepared for a future requirement of approximately:
  
  
**20–30+ deployments per day**
The candidate will work with senior technical team members and developers to understand this requirement and progressively improve the deployment architecture.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Identifying deployment bottlenecks.
* Automating repetitive deployment tasks.
* Improving deployment speed.
* Improving deployment reliability.
* Standardizing client deployment procedures.
* Supporting parallel deployment where appropriate.
* Maintaining deployment records.
* Learning and implementing suitable DevOps practices for higher deployment volumes.

The candidate is expected to
**grow with the requirement**
and continuously improve the deployment system as the number of clients increases.
  
  

* Secure Client Deployment

**GwayERP Applications May Be Deployed In:**

* Customer on-premises servers
* Customer-preferred cloud servers
* Other approved customer environments

The candidate will assist in developing a deployment architecture where the application can run securely in the customer's environment without unnecessarily exposing the organization's source code.
  
  
The candidate should learn and work with concepts such as:
  
  

* Docker images
* Private container registries
* Build artifacts
* Runtime configuration
* Secrets management
* Access control
* Secure deployment packages
* Application versioning
* Container security

**The Objective Is:**
**Customers should be able to run and use the ERP application without receiving unrestricted access to the development source code.**
The candidate should continuously research and recommend better approaches as the deployment model evolves.
  
  

* Application Updates & Release Management

**ERP Applications Will Continuously Receive:**

* Bug fixes
* Security fixes
* New features
* Performance improvements
* Workflow enhancements

The DevOps process must support updating existing client installations safely.
  
  
**The Candidate Will Assist In Building Processes For:**
**New Release → Backup → Deployment → Database Migration → Verification**
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Preparing release packages/images.
* Supporting application updates.
* Checking deployment prerequisites.
* Supporting database migrations.
* Verifying application health after deployment.
* Maintaining release versions.
* Supporting rollback when required.

The candidate must understand that
**ERP deployments involve customer business data and therefore require much greater care than a simple application redeployment.**

* MongoDB Backup & Recovery

Work with the technical team to maintain reliable MongoDB backup and recovery processes.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding MongoDB backup methods.
* Configuring automated backups.
* Monitoring backup jobs.
* Maintaining backup retention.
* Checking backup integrity.
* Performing test restores.
* Supporting database recovery.
* Maintaining backup documentation.

**The Candidate Should Develop a Strong Understanding Of:**
**Backup ≠ Recovery**
A backup should be periodically tested to ensure that it can actually be restored.
  
  

* Data Safety During Deployment

The candidate must follow deployment practices that protect customer data.
  
  
Before significant application updates, the candidate should ensure appropriate procedures are followed for:
  
  

* Database backup
* Application compatibility
* Database migration
* Configuration backup
* Deployment verification
* Rollback

**The Objective Is To Minimize The Possibility Of:**

* Data loss
* Database corruption
* Incompatible application/database versions
* Configuration loss
* Failed updates
* Infrastructure Security

Security will be an important responsibility of this role.
  
  
**The Candidate Will Work On:**

* Linux server hardening.
* SSH security.
* Firewall configuration.
* Port management.
* User access control.
* File permissions.
* Docker security.
* Database access restrictions.
* Jenkins security.
* Git/GitHub security.
* Secret management.
* SSL/TLS.
* Security updates.

The candidate should continuously learn about current infrastructure and application security practices.
  
  

* Monitoring & Logging

**Help Implement And Maintain Monitoring For:**

* Server CPU
* RAM
* Disk space
* Disk health
* Network
* Docker containers
* Application services
* MongoDB
* Redis
* Jenkins
* Backup jobs

The candidate should help establish alerts for important conditions such as:
  
  

* Server unavailable
* Disk nearly full
* Container repeatedly restarting
* Database unavailable
* Backup failure
* Application health failure
* Deployment failure

The goal is to identify problems
**before they become customer-impacting issues**
.
  
  

* Documentation

One of the important responsibilities of this role is to improve the current level of infrastructure documentation.
  
  
**The Candidate Should Maintain Documentation For:**
Environment
  
  

* Server details
* Application environments
* Docker services
* Ports
* Network configuration
* Application dependencies

Deployment
  
  

* Deployment procedures
* Update procedures
* Rollback procedures
* Client deployment steps

Backup
  
  

* Backup procedures
* Backup locations
* Retention
* Restore procedures

Infrastructure
  
  

* Server configuration
* Docker architecture
* Jenkins pipelines
* Application deployment architecture

Troubleshooting
  
  

* Common problems
* Solutions
* Recovery procedures

The objective is to ensure that important operational knowledge is
**documented and repeatable rather than dependent on individual memory**
.
  
  

* Git & Release Management

Work with Git/GitHub-based development workflows.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding branches.
* Understanding pull requests.
* Managing deployment branches where required.
* Understanding release tags.
* Tracking application versions.
* Supporting release management.
* Maintaining deployment history.

**The Candidate Should Understand The Relationship Between:**
**Git → Build → Release → Deployment → Production**

* Infrastructure Automation

The candidate should actively look for opportunities to automate repetitive work.
  
  
**This May Include:**

* Shell scripts
* Bash
* Docker automation
* Jenkins pipelines
* Deployment scripts
* Backup scripts
* Monitoring scripts
* Server setup scripts
* Configuration automation

Knowledge of tools such as
**Ansible or Terraform**
will be an advantage.
  
  
The expectation is not that the candidate knows every automation tool immediately, but that they have the willingness and ability to learn them when required.
  
  

* Working With Developers

The DevOps Engineer will work closely with developers and QA engineers.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding application requirements.
* Understanding environment requirements.
* Supporting development environments.
* Supporting testing environments.
* Supporting staging.
* Preparing deployment environments.
* Understanding application configuration.
* Supporting database migrations.
* Identifying deployment risks.
* Helping developers troubleshoot environment issues.

The candidate should be comfortable discussing technical issues directly with developers.
  
  

* Learning & Continuous Improvement

This position requires a strong
**self-learning mindset**
.
  
  
The candidate will encounter technologies and infrastructure requirements that may not be known at the time of joining.
  
  
**The Candidate Is Expected To:**

* Research unfamiliar technologies.
* Read official documentation.
* Test solutions safely.
* Build proof-of-concepts where necessary.
* Learn from incidents.
* Improve existing processes.
* Keep up with DevOps practices.
* Learn security best practices.
* Learn infrastructure automation.
* Learn container orchestration and deployment approaches as the organization's needs evolve.

We value the ability to
**learn and implement**
more than simply listing a large number of technologies on a resume.
  
  

* Problem Solving & Troubleshooting

The candidate should develop strong troubleshooting skills.
  
  
**Problems May Include:**

* Application not starting
* Container failure
* Database connection failure
* Network issue
* Jenkins build failure
* Deployment failure
* Disk space issue
* Permission issue
* SSL certificate issue
* Backup failure
* Server performance issue

**The Expected Approach Is:**
**Understand → Investigate → Identify Root Cause → Fix → Verify → Document → Prevent Recurrence**
Technical Skills
  
  
Required / Expected
  
  

* Linux / Ubuntu
* Docker
* Docker Compose
* Git
* GitHub
* Jenkins
* CI/CD fundamentals
* Basic networking
* SSH
* Firewall fundamentals
* MongoDB basics
* MongoDB backup and restore
* Shell / Bash scripting
* Basic server monitoring
* Basic security practices

Good to Have
  
  

* Ansible
* Terraform
* Nginx
* Private Docker Registry
* Prometheus
* Grafana
* Redis
* SSL/TLS
* VPN
* AWS
* Azure
* OVH
* Proxmox
* Cloud infrastructure
* Infrastructure as Code
* Container security

**Experience**
Required
  
  

* 1–2 years of practical DevOps / Infrastructure / System Administration experience
* Hands-on Linux experience.
* Hands-on Docker experience.
* Basic Jenkins/CI/CD experience.
* Git/GitHub knowledge.
* Basic understanding of networking and server security.
* Basic understanding of databases and backup.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical problems independently.
* Strong willingness to learn.

Advantage
  
  
**Experience Working With:**

* SaaS applications
* ERP applications
* Enterprise applications
* MongoDB
* Node.js applications
* React applications
* Dockerized applications
* On-premises deployments
* Cloud deployments
* Customer application deployments

What We Expect From You

title: CloudOps Engineer IV
description:
PDI Technologies is looking for a CloudOps Engineer IV to join the SRE organization supporting Paylo, PDI’s payments, loyalty, and fuel-pricing product suite. This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role focused on keeping high-traffic, customer- and partner-facing platforms reliable, secure, and running efficiently across multi-cloud infrastructure.

  
  

 You will bring strong, hands-on experience across AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, Terraform/OpenTofu, Jenkins, and Datadog, and apply it directly — building and operating infrastructure, improving deployment pipelines, and strengthening observability. You will work under the direction of the Senior Manager, SRE, executing against the team’s reliability and infrastructure roadmap while bringing your own judgment and technical leadership to the problems in front of you.

**Job Responsibilities:**
Cloud Infrastructure & Operations: 
  
 
  

  
* Build, operate, and troubleshoot infrastructure across AWS and Azure in support of production workloads.
  
* Operate and maintain Kubernetes clusters, including deploying and maintaining Helm charts for the services you support.
  
* Participate in on-call rotation, respond to incidents, and drive them to resolution within your area of ownership
  
* Contribute to capacity planning, cost optimization, and resilience improvements for the systems you support
  
  

  
 Automation & Continuous Delivery: 
  
 
  

  
* Build and maintain GitOps-based deployment pipelines using Argo CD/Argo Workflows, including rollout and promotion configuration across environments.
  
* Write and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, OpenTofu) for the infrastructure you own, following team module standards.
  
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins, improving build/deploy automation and reliability.
  
* Support progressive delivery practices (blue-green/canary, automated rollback) for the services you support
  
  

  
 
  
Reliability & Observability:
  
 
  

  
* Build and maintain Datadog dashboards, monitors, and alerts for the services you support, tuning alert thresholds to reduce noise.
  
* Contribute to defining SLIs/SLOs for your services and help track them over time.
  
* Participate in postmortems for incidents you're involved in, and follow through on assigned remediation items
  
  

  
Collaboration & Mentorship:
  
 
  

  
* Partner with engineers across the SRE team and with product engineering teams to troubleshoot issues and improve system design.
  
* Share knowledge with and mentor less-experienced engineers on the team (CloudOps Engineer I III) on cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and CI/CD practices.
  
* Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and onboarding materials for the systems you support.
  
  

**Required Qualifications:**

  
* 10+ years of experience in Cloud Operations, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering roles
  
* Hands-on experience with AWS — you can build, troubleshoot, and operate cloud infrastructure directly.
  
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Helm — deploying, operating, and troubleshooting workloads in production clusters.
  
* Hands-on experience with Argo CD/Argo Workflows for GitOps-based continuous delivery.
  
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, OpenTofu).
  
* Hands-on experience with Jenkins and Rancher for CI/CD pipeline development and maintenance.
  
* Hands-on experience with Datadog (or equivalent observability platform), including building dashboards, monitors, and alerts.
  
* Experience participating in an on-call rotation and responding to production incidents.
  
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across teams.
  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  
* Experience supporting payments, fuel/retail, or loyalty platforms, or other systems with PCI DSS or similar compliance obligations
  
* Relevant certifications such as CKA/CKAD, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate.
  
* Experience with messaging systems (Kafka/SQS/SNS) and multi-region/multi-AZ resilience patterns.
  
* Prior experience mentoring junior engineers or leading small technical initiatives.
  
  

**Behavioral Competencies:**
  

  
* Cultivates Innovation
  
* Decision Quality
  
* Manages Complexity
  
* Drives Results
  
* Business Insight

  

PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career.  This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements.  Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. title: Infrastructure Senior Tech Analyst -Assistant Vice President
description:
**Job Description**
Infrastructure Technology Lead Analyst (Red Hat Linux, GRID Infrastructure L3 Support Engineer)
  
  
The Infrastructure Technology Lead Analyst is an intermediate-level technical role responsible for providing Level 3 support, engineering, remediation, and operational excellence across the Unified Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) estate consisting of more than 100,000+ servers. The role requires deep expertise in Linux administration, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, security hardening, automation, and configuration management. The overall objective is to leverage advanced infrastructure technology knowledge, operational policies, and engineering best practices to maintain platform stability, security, compliance, and service availability.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide Level 3 technical support for complex Red Hat Enterprise Linux, GRID infrastructure server incidents, escalations, and critical production outages across a large-scale enterprise environment.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of high-impact operating system, kernel, performance, storage, networking, and server infrastructure issues to restore services within agreed SLAs.
* Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) following service restoration and implement corrective and preventive actions to eliminate recurring issues.
* Design and implement server security hardening standards in accordance with enterprise security policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Manage vulnerability remediation activities, security patching, operating system lifecycle management, and compliance controls across the Red Hat server estate.
* Administer and troubleshoot infrastructure agents including monitoring, security, backup, automation, compliance, and endpoint management agents deployed across Linux servers.
* Develop, maintain, and optimize Ansible playbooks for server provisioning, configuration management, patching, security remediation, and operational automation.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks and develop engineering solutions to improve platform stability, efficiency, and operational resilience.
* Review infrastructure requirements, define operating system standards, and update operational processes, procedures, and technical documentation as required.
* Conduct proactive system health reviews, capacity planning, performance tuning, and operational risk assessments.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and strategic guidance to team members and operational support teams.
* Collaborate with security, application, middleware, storage, network, and infrastructure teams to resolve cross-functional technical challenges.
* Support operating system upgrades, migrations, disaster recovery exercises, and business continuity initiatives.
* Ensure ongoing compliance with regulatory requirements, corporate governance standards, and security frameworks.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Red Hat Enterprise Linux platforms and associated technologies when engaging with senior stakeholders, engineering teams, and project groups.
* Operate independently with minimal supervision while demonstrating strong ownership, sound judgment, and decision-making capabilities.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations; adhering to policy; applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct, and business practices; and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) administration, GRID infrastructure and troubleshooting.
* Advanced knowledge of Linux kernel, system performance tuning, networking, storage, LVM, multipathing, clustering, and filesystem management.
* Experience in enterprise server security hardening, vulnerability management, and compliance frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with Ansible automation and playbook development.
* Experience with Chef configuration management and infrastructure-as-code practices.
* Knowledge of monitoring, backup, security, and compliance agents deployed in enterprise Linux environments.
* Experience supporting mission-critical production environments at large scale.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, incident management, and root cause analysis skills.
* Familiarity with virtualization, cloud technologies, and DevOps practices is advantageous.

**Education:**

* 6-8 years of experience in relevant technologies.

As an AI Security Consultant specializing in Infrastructure in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice, you will own technical workstreams that secure the cloud, network, container and model-serving foundations used to run generative AI and agentic workloads. You will combine client advisory with hands-on engineering, turning requirements into architectures, integrations and production controls. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations and help estimate delivery work.
  
  
Work you'll do
  
  
As an AI Security Consultant on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for
  
  

* Build secure AI landing-zone components across cloud accounts or subscriptions, networks, identity, compute, Kubernetes, model services and observability.
* Design and deploy secure AI landing zones and model-serving environments across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Kubernetes-based platforms.
* Lead implementation of network isolation, private access, egress controls, cluster security, secrets, artifact controls, IaC and policy enforcement.
* Engineer and review Kubernetes and model-serving patterns for tenant isolation, GPU workloads, autoscaling, resilience and controlled enterprise integration.
* Plan and execute platform security, resilience and operational testing, diagnose complex failures, and drive issues through resolution.
* Own an infrastructure workstream, manage dependencies and milestones, and provide day-to-day guidance to consultants.
* Lead technical demonstrations and prototypes, and contribute architecture, effort and estimation inputs to pursuits.

* Ability to independently lead a technical workstream and manage priorities, dependencies and delivery commitments.
* Clear communication of architecture decisions, technical tradeoffs, risks and implementation status to engineering and business stakeholders.
* Ability to guide consultants, review technical work and create a collaborative delivery environment.
* Strong demonstration and technical storytelling skills for workshops, prototypes and client readouts.

The team
  
  
Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security and operations.
  
  
We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle, so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data or infrastructure risk.
  
  
Within the practice, the Infrastructure capability focuses on secure AI landing zones, cloud and network architecture, container and model-serving platforms, policy automation and observability.

* Previous consulting, client delivery or customer-facing engineering experience.
* Experience across both managed AI services and self-hosted or open-weight AI platforms.
* Experience with AI threat modeling, red teaming, security evaluations, secure AI development practices or AI-specific monitoring.
* Experience developing reusable technical assets, guiding junior engineers or contributing to engineering standards.

title: Senior Staff Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
  
  
Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
****cut carbon****
.
  
  
**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**

* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all.
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.

Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits


+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency

**What We’re Looking For**
We are seeking a
****Senior Staff Engineer (L6)****
to join Core Engineering in India as a senior individual contributor operating across squads rather than inside one. You will be the technical subject matter expert our teams pull in when the problem is hard, the design is ambiguous, or the blast radius is large — moving between our Acquisition, Extraction and Storage, and Presentment squads as priorities shift.
  
  
This role exists because our squads are shipping faster than our design review capacity. We have driven deep adoption of AI-assisted development across India engineering, and the constraint has moved: teams can now produce architecture and implementations quickly, but senior validation of those designs concentrates on too few people. You will be one of a small number of engineers trusted to review and approve significant designs, and to raise the design ceiling of the engineers around you.
  
  
You will not have direct reports. Your influence comes from technical depth, design judgment, and mentorship rather than reporting lines. This is a hybrid, remote-first role anchored in Chennai, working daily with US-based engineering and product partners.
  
  
Our engineering values are deeply ingrained in our culture — you can read more about them here.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Act as the floating technical SME across Core Engineering squads, embedding where the hardest current problem is and moving on once the team is self-sufficient
* Review and approve component and service designs, sharing design authority with squad leads so that architecture approval stops being a single-person bottleneck
* Own the design of complex, cross-service changes spanning multiple owners — provider data model changes, extraction pipeline evolution, migrations, and event contract changes
* Write production code on the critical path. This is a hands-on role; you will be in the repositories, not only in documents
* Set and raise the bar on non-functional requirements: performance, scalability, reliability, observability, and cost across the services you touch
* Validate AI-generated designs and implementations, reviewing agent output for architectural soundness, hidden coupling, and failure modes the model did not consider
* Advance how we do AI-assisted engineering: spec-driven development, reusable skills and subagents, prompt patterns that hold up against our codebase, and automation of recurring work
* Mentor Staff Engineers and below through pairing, design review, and constructive feedback, measurably lifting the technical judgment of the squads you rotate through
* Lead major refactoring and technical debt reduction across legacy platform services, sequencing the work so that delivery continues
* Debug and resolve complex production issues that cross service, data, and infrastructure boundaries
* Write the design documents, architecture decision records, and runbooks that make your decisions durable. Confluence is our single source of truth
* Partner with US engineering leads on cross-region initiatives, representing India engineering in architecture discussions

**What Will Help You Succeed**
The following list reflects our current technology stack. You will need meaningful overlap or analogous experience, but not an exact match.
  
  
****Must-haves****

* 10–12+ years in software engineering, with a track record of owning technically complex, multi-service work end to end
* Deep production expertise in Python, plus working fluency in a second ecosystem such as Java and Spring Boot or TypeScript/Node
* Strong distributed systems and event-driven architecture experience — queues, streams, idempotency, eventual consistency, and backpressure
* Hands-on AWS (ECS/EKS, S3, Lambda, Kinesis or equivalent) and containerized deployment on Kubernetes
* Solid relational data modeling and query tuning (MySQL, Postgres), plus search or analytical stores (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Snowflake)
* Demonstrated ability to review other people’s designs and improve them. You can point to architectures that are better because you were in the room
* Practical, daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor, and of spec-driven development, with a clear view of where they help and where they mislead
* Credibility without authority: able to influence squads you are not part of, and to mentor senior engineers without managing them
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and comfort operating across India and US time zones
* Comfort with ambiguity and rotation — the willingness to be reassigned to the highest-value problem rather than owning one fixed surface

****Nice to have****

* Utility, energy, or fintech data domain experience
* Web data acquisition at scale (Puppeteer, headless Chrome, anti-bot mitigation)
* Document extraction, OCR, or LLM-based extraction pipelines
* dbt and analytics engineering on Snowflake
* Experience modernizing legacy monoliths into services while keeping delivery running

****Eliminating carbon footprints, eliminating carbon copies.****
Here at Arcadia, we cultivate diversity, celebrate individuality, and believe unique perspectives are key to our collective success in creating a clean energy future. Arcadia is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. While we are currently unable to consider candidates who will require visa sponsorship, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates eligible to work in India.

title: Network Operations Center Engineer II
description:
Alation is pioneering the next era of
**data intelligence — powered by AI agents and trusted data**
. Organizations around the world rely on
**Alation**
to drive self-service analytics, cloud transformation, data governance, and AI innovation. Our technology helps enterprises connect people and data to make faster, smarter, and more confident decisions. With more than $340M in funding – valued at over $1.7 billion and more than 650 customers, including 40% of the Fortune 100.
  
  
As data becomes the foundation of every business, Alation is leading the way in helping organizations unlock their full potential. By bringing intelligence, automation, and trust to every interaction, we empower customers to scale data-driven innovation with confidence and speed.
  
  
Joining Alation means being part of a
**winning team shaping the future of AI-powered data intelligence**
. We move fast, think big, and deliver results together.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
We're looking for a hands-on NOC Engineer who can also handle security monitoring and incidents. You'll monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve issues across our AWS and Kubernetes environments, respond to security alerts, and automate repetitive work — thinking clearly under pressure and owning incidents end to end
  
  
**Network / Cloud Operations (NOC)**

* Monitor the health, availability and performance of AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes clusters, applications and networks, 24x7 on a rotational basis.
* Act as L2 escalation point: triage, troubleshoot, debug and resolve incidents escalated from L1 or raised by monitoring tools.
* Analyze logs, metrics and traces to find root causes across compute, network, storage, database and application layers.
* Troubleshoot Kubernetes workloads (pods, deployments, services, ingress, nodes) using kubectl and related tools.
* Escalate to engineering, cloud and vendor teams with clear, complete technical context when needed.
* Tune alerts and dashboards to reduce noise and improve signal quality.
* Support change, maintenance and release windows, including validation and rollback checks.

**Security Operations (SOC)**

* Monitor security alerts from SIEM, cloud security tools (e.g., AWS GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail) and endpoint/network sources.
* Triage, investigate and classify security events; separate false positives from real threats.
* Execute first response on security incidents: containment, evidence collection, escalation and follow-up.
* Identify suspicious activity such as unauthorized access, IAM misuse, unusual network traffic, malware or data exfiltration indicators.
* Follow and improve security incident response playbooks.
* Support vulnerability management, access reviews and audit evidence requests.

**Automation and Continuous Improvement**

* Automate repetitive operational and security tasks using scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell, Go, etc.) or low-code / no-code tools (e.g., n8n, Zapier, Power Automate, SOAR platforms, Lambda, AWS Systems Manager).
* Build auto-remediation, alert enrichment and ticket auto-creation workflows.
* Write and maintain runbooks, SOPs and knowledge base articles.
* Identify recurring issues and drive problem management to permanent fixes.

**Incident, Ticketing and ITIL Process**

* Manage incidents, service requests, problems and changes in ticketing tools (e.g., Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, PagerDuty, Opsgenie).
* Meet SLAs for acknowledgement, response and resolution.
* Lead or support major incident bridges; provide clear status updates to stakeholders.
* Write post-incident reviews / RCAs with action items.
* Provide clean, documented shift handovers.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**
Strong communication and team coordination are mandatory. Security monitoring/incident response, automation, and troubleshooting/debugging are critical. AWS fundamentals, observability tooling, and ITIL/ticketing experience are high priority. Kubernetes is medium-to-high priority; coding in any language is a plus.
  
  
**Specifically, We're Looking For**

* Hands-on security experience (SIEM tools, AWS security services, awareness of MITRE ATT&CK/OWASP Top 10)
* A track record of automating manual work (scripting or low-code/no-code)
* Working AWS knowledge (VPC, EC2, IAM, CloudWatch, etc.) and Kubernetes (EKS preferred)
* Strong troubleshooting ability and comfort with Linux CLI
* 3–6 years in NOC, SOC, cloud ops, or SRE/DevOps support, with ITIL and ticketing experience
* Bachelor's degree in CS/IT/Electronics or equivalent experience

**Good to Have**
AWS/Security certifications (Security+, CEH, CKA), SOAR platform experience, Terraform/Git basics, and exposure to SOC 2/ISO 27001/GDPR.
  
  
**Behavioral Competencies**
Calm under pressure, strong communicator, ownership mindset, quick learner open to cross-training across NOC and SOC, and documents/hands over work cleanly.
  
  
**Shift & Work Conditions**
Rotational 24x5 today, expanding to 24x6/24x7 — includes night/weekend shifts and on-call per roster, with shift allowance and comp-off per policy.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to that individual’s race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for an Engineer II in System Validation Testing with 3 to 5 years of experience to join our cloud network management quality engineering team. The role focuses on hands-on testing of a cloud-hosted platform used to onboard, configure, monitor and manage networking devices such as access points, switches and routers.
  
  
The engineer will work with senior QA engineers, developers and product teams to understand requirements, design and execute tests, automate repeatable workflows, investigate failures and contribute to reliable releases across the device, network, cloud, API and web or mobile application layers.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Cloud Network Management Testing
  
  

* Understand feature requirements and expected customer workflows for cloud-managed access points, switches and routers.
* Test device onboarding, discovery, provisioning, configuration and removal workflows.
* Validate device-to-cloud communication, cloud-to-device operations and configuration synchronization.
* Test device status, statistics, alerts, notifications and basic remote-management workflows.
* Validate firmware upgrade, reconnect, recovery and factory-reset scenarios under guidance.
* Execute tests across common LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and multi-device network setups.

Test Planning and Execution
  
  

* Review user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications with the QA team.
* Create and maintain clear test scenarios and test cases covering positive, negative, boundary and recovery conditions.
* Prepare test data and configure required devices, accounts, subscriptions and environments.
* Execute functional, integration, system, regression, compatibility and end-to-end tests.
* Record results accurately, report coverage gaps and escalate blockers early.
* Retest resolved defects and run focused regression for impacted workflows.

API Cloud and Data Validation
  
  

* Test REST APIs using tools such as Postman and automation libraries.
* Validate request and response data, status codes, authentication, authorization and error handling.
* Verify consistency across APIs, backend services, database records and user interfaces.
* Test asynchronous operations, events and notifications with support from senior engineers.
* Use AWS logs, dashboards and application telemetry to investigate test failures.
* Perform smoke and regression validation in QA and staging environments.

Networking and Troubleshooting
  
  

* Apply networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, IPv4 and IPv6, DHCP, DNS, ARP, ICMP, HTTP and HTTPS, VLANs, routing, switching, NAT, LAN, WAN and Wi-Fi.
* Use ping, traceroute, nslookup or dig, iperf, browser developer tools and device or cloud logs during troubleshooting.
* Capture and perform basic analysis of network traffic using Wireshark or tcpdump.
* Isolate whether a failure is related to the device, network, cloud service, API, backend or application layer, and involve the appropriate team.

Test Automation
  
  

* Develop and maintain Python-based automation for APIs, device workflows and regression scenarios.
* Create or update UI automation using Playwright, Selenium or an equivalent framework.
* Follow existing framework standards and build reusable, readable and maintainable test components.
* Analyze automation failures, distinguish product defects from script or environment issues and fix tests within assigned scope.
* Run automated suites through CI/CD pipelines and report failures with supporting evidence.
* Identify stable, repetitive manual scenarios suitable for automation.

Defect Management and Team Collaboration
  
  

* Log clear defects with reproducible steps, expected and actual behavior, logs, screenshots, API traces and packet captures when applicable.
* Participate in defect triage, daily stand-ups, sprint planning and test-status discussions.
* Collaborate with software, cloud, firmware, networking and mobile teams to reproduce and resolve issues.
* Track assigned defects through retest and closure and communicate risks or delays promptly.
* Maintain test cases, automation and technical notes in the agreed repositories and tools.

Release and Production Support
  
  

* Support release regression, production smoke testing and post-deployment validation as assigned.
* Verify critical customer workflows after deployments and provide accurate test status to the QA lead.
* Assist with reproducing customer-reported or production issues in controlled environments.
* Contribute new regression tests for escaped defects and recurring failure patterns.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3 to 5 years of software QA or system validation experience.
* Hands-on experience in functional, integration, regression and end-to-end testing.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP and core networking concepts.
* Experience testing REST APIs and interpreting JSON request and response data.
* Programming or test-automation experience using Python.
* Exposure to UI automation using Playwright, Selenium or an equivalent tool.
* Ability to analyze logs, reproduce issues and write clear defect reports.
* Experience using Git and working with CI/CD test execution.
* Good written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work in a cross-functional team.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience testing cloud-managed networking or network management platforms.
* Hands-on exposure to access points, switches, routers or Wi-Fi test environments.
* Familiarity with AWS services, microservices, Docker or Kubernetes.
* Experience with Wireshark, tcpdump and basic packet analysis.
* Exposure to mobile application testing, performance testing or API security testing.
* Awareness of Wi-Fi 5, Wi-Fi 6, Wi-Fi 6E or Wi-Fi 7 concepts.
* Responsible use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or GitHub Copilot for test design, automation, debugging or log analysis.

**Company Statement/Values**
At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.
  
  
We're a performance-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the
*Next Gear*
by living our values: we
**Dare to Transform**
the future,
**Connect and Delight**
our customers,
**Communicate Courageously**
with each other and collaborate to
**Win It Together**
. You’ll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture.
  
  
We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity.
  
  
*NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.*

description:
**Description**
We are looking for a seasoned senior developer to design/build massive scale, distributed computing solutions. You will be responsible for driving the team’s technical direction, strategizing and shaping our long-term vision and architecture. You will own major deliverables end-to-end, drive roadmaps, and provide technical leadership to the engineering team. If you're excited by cloud computing, designing highly scalable, fault tolerant systems, and want to be challenged by the toughest computer science problems, then join us to build the next generation distributed systems solving big data problems.
  
  
You should be someone who wants to conceive and design highly scalable, robust software, and wants to see their software thrive in the face of traffic from huge cloud computing services. The candidate should have strong distributed systems and web services design and implementation experience, as well as experience working on high availability production systems.
  
  
Responsible for the overall development life cycle of the solution and manage complex projects with significant bottom line impact
  
  

* Work with product managers in developing a strategy and road map to provide compelling capabilities for our customers.
* Work closely with senior engineers to develop the best technical design and approach for new product development.
* Instill best practices for software development and documentation, assure designs meet requirements, and deliver high-quality work on tight schedules.
* Project management - prioritization , planning of projects and features, Stakeholder management and tracking of external commitments
* Operational Excellence - monitoring & operation of production services

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Systems Administration Senior Specialist
description:
**Req ID:**
384233
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Administration Senior Specialist to join our team in Chennai, Tamil Nādu (IN-TN), India (IN).
  
  
Infrastructure Technology Systems Analyst
  
  
Who are we?
  
  
Citi Technology Infrastructure (CTI) provides the products and services that enable Citi's workforce, along with many of the financial solutions that Citi's customers rely on. We provide the critical technical foundation for Citi's operations through the infrastructure that runs business and general user computing services. We do this by working as one-team to deliver high quality, reliable and modern infrastructure technologies at the right cost. We drive to optimize the functionality and capability of the infrastructure technologies.
  
  
Services functions are responsible for the end-to-end service ownership for their domain, including the total cost of ownership, service quality and responsiveness. Team members within the Services functions will engineer and certify platform builds and capabilities, oversee execution of builds, and break/fix where scripting and automation are not possible. They will manage problems, service improvements and continuity of business/resiliency testing and non-routine move, add and change activities for their service domain.
  
  
Technical Architecture, Development & Planning. The Technical Architecture, Development & Planning team is responsible for enterprise-wide developer tools and automation capabilities, the engineering lifecycle, core product management processes, the Enterprise Analytics Portal (EAP) and defining the strategy around our next generation capabilities.
  
  
In CTI, we are focused on delivering the best for our clients, and we know that to do this we need a talented team with diverse experiences, backgrounds and skills.
  
  
Role Description
  
  
The role of an Infrastructure Technology System Analyst within the High Frequency Trading environment is responsible for activities relating to the implementation, maintenance and migration of platforms which are uniquely configured in support of the High Frequency Markets and Trading applications. You will have the opportunity to work with our global internal and external partners to drive future improvements in the performance of our technology infrastructure platforms, ensuring that we are increasing the reliability and optimizing its capacity. The overall objective is to assist with infrastructure migrations to build a secure, stable and efficient operating environment for our business to function and grow.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Provide sound understanding of technology infrastructure concepts and principles to provide support to supported platforms and sectors within technical domain.
  
  
Apply basic understanding of how multiple areas collectively integrate within technology infrastructure to support the operations environment.
  
  
Build, configure and tune servers as per the application requirement
  
  
Review requirement documents, define hardware requirements and update processes and procedures as necessary.
  
  
Co-ordinate with various teams to resolve issues and deliver project on time.
  
  
Provide Root Cause Analysis (RCA) post restoration of service.
  
  
Design testing approaches, complex processes, reporting streams, and assist with the automation of repetitive tasks.
  
  
Ensure ongoing compliance with regulatory requirements.
  
  
Willing to work after hours and weekends or be on-call if needed
  
  
Conduct project related research
  
  
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
  
  
Handle issues and escalations, as well as resolve production problems, reporting to management on status and technical matters.
  
  
Plan and implement improved processes, backup and recovery plans, and uniform methodologies and standards
  
  
Stakeholder Management and People Responsibilities
  
  
Work effectively with virtual and remote team members exercising critical thinking to resolve issues and presenting technical findings accurately to internal customers and leadership.
  
  
Act as a liaison between various CTI businesses providing direction and support to resolve issues in a timely manner.
  
  
Directly impact the business by ensuring the quality of work provided by self and others; impacts own team and closely related work teams by providing mentoring and training to junior members of the team.
  
  
Actively contribute towards self-development by creating and following development plans based on discussions with management.
  
  
Core Role Competencies
  
  
Technical Knowledge: Has a recognizable area of technical competence. Familiar with appropriate standards. Applies subject domain knowledge to meet organizational need/guide actions. Keeps up with current and possible future technological developments in the field.
  
  
Processes/ Procedures: Ensures processes and procedures are in place for self and others to use. Seeks ways to improve existing processes, making adjustments or recommending reengineering improvements.
  
  
Customer and Industry Knowledge: Consistently applies a business driver and marketplace focus when prioritizing actions.
  
  
Risk Management: Examines and defines factors that could adversely affect task completion, delivery or achievement of customer satisfaction. Evaluates controls to help mitigate negative outcomes through prevention, detection and correction. Identifies the risks of negative outcomes, including inadvertent error or fraud. Ensures ongoing compliance with regulatory requirements.
  
  
Stakeholder Management: Identifies key partners and their influence, implements techniques for communicating/engaging and managing expectations. Has frequent interactions. Finds the appropriate balance of completing claims by various groups of stakeholders, acting fairly and in consideration of cultural and ethical factors.
  
  
Client Centricity: Uses insights from customer relationships to anticipate their needs and provide services beyond their expectations. Actively seeks information to understand client issues, expectations, and needs.
  
  
Problem Solving and Decision Making: Makes sound decisions. Considers relevant factors and uses appropriate decision-making criteria and principles. When making decisions, uses a mix of analysis, wisdom, experience and discernment. Assesses business needs, anticipates problems. Works independently and is self-directed.
  
  
Technical Skills
  
  

* RHEL 7/8 CoreOS, Windows Operating Systems and Openshift.
* Active Directory, KDC and Domain Services (AD, DNS), FTP, Data Protection (Netbackup), Clustering (Veritas)
* Virtualization environment based on VMware, OpenShift
* x86 server hardware Dell \ HP \ Lenovo, Solarflare, SSD and FPGA
* Be able to create simple automation scripts using PowerShell or other scripting language like VBS, Python, Bash, etc.
* Network protocols and tools used to troubleshoot issues
* Familiar with Sysinternals and tools that allow deep system/process troubleshooting
* Good to have and a willingness to learn Microsemi, Ansible, VMware, Windows RDS, Centrify, IBM BigFix, Ansible, PTP\NTP, Splunk, ePo, SCCM, Twistlock, Crowdstrike, SCOM, Dell, ITC, Lenovo, HP \ DELL \ Lenovo servers, and EMC \NetApp storage

**Skills / Experience Levels**
Ability to work with virtual / in-person teams, and work under pressure / to a deadline
  
  
You have good communication skills with the ability to articulate clearly in high stress situations.
  
  
You work independently and are self-directed.
  
  
You are a detail oriented and perseverant individual.
  
  
You have a positive attitude with the drive to get the work done.
  
  
You enjoy collaborating and working as part of a cross discipline team.
  
  
You’re a self-starter with good problem-solving skills, and you continuously look for ways to improve things.
  
  
You understand the importance of prioritization of your work.
  
  
Providing a great experience to the users of your platform is important to you.
  
  
You have skills and proficiency with MS PowerPoint, Excel, Access or other analytical tools.
  
  
You have a Bachelor’s degree (Computer Science or Engineering degree preferred) or equivalent work experience.
  
  
6+ years of experience

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs.
